1.name: Cadino
1.description: This exquisite pullover from Luisa Spagnoli's carded knitwear manufactory embodies a harmonious union of warmth and high fashion. Cut in a Regular fit silhouette, the piece is crafted from a noble wool and cashmere blend enriched with viscose for exceptional softness. The signature stylistic accent is a wide round neckline, finished with a delicate raw-edge lace insert that lends the look a note of aristocratic sensuality. Long sleeves with raw-edge cuffs complete this refined design.
advice: Draw the client's attention to the luxurious composition: the presence of cashmere and wool ensures impeccable thermoregulation and tactile comfort.
Present the piece as the perfect solution for transitioning from a daytime professional look to an evening appearance, thanks to its exquisite lace insert.
Emphasize the contemporary cut: the open cuffs are this season's leading trend, setting this piece apart from classic knitwear.

objections.q: The lace insert seems too delicate for everyday knitwear.
objections.a: The lace is integrated into the structure of the piece using a high-quality polyamide, which guarantees the decoration retains its shape and durability with proper care.

objections.q: Concern that carded wool may feel uncomfortable against the skin.
objections.a: The yarn blend includes 30% viscose and 5% cashmere, giving the knit a silky, pleasant texture even for the most sensitive skin.

objections.q: The model seems too loose-fitting.
objections.a: The Regular fit is specifically designed to create an elegant yet relaxed silhouette that flatters the figure without restricting movement.

objections.q: The beige shade (Tortora) may look pale.
objections.a: This sophisticated shade is a 'Quiet Luxury' classic. It pairs beautifully with contrasting gold-tone accessories, such as bags from the LS1928 line.

objections.q: How should this combined-fabric piece be cared for?
objections.a: We recommend professional cleaning or exclusively gentle hand-washing, to preserve the volume of the wool structure and protect the delicate lace.

2.name: Capire
2.description: This pullover from the Luisa Spagnoli collection is the embodiment of sensuous elegance and gentle comfort. Crafted from a luxurious blend of mohair, wool and polyamide, it offers airy lightness paired with tender warmth. The defining detail is an exquisite collar that reveals the shoulder line, lending the silhouette an aristocratic femininity and refinement. The Regular fit silhouette and flawlessly smooth knit make this piece a versatile addition to any contemporary wardrobe, equally suited to daytime ensembles and evening occasions.

looks.title: Total Look (Bordeaux)
looks.text: Capire 2452 paired with the Fumaiolo 3417 skirt, Niassesi 2449 0002 bracelet and Uragano A 0986 shoes.

looks.title: Total Look (Grigio Melange)
looks.text: Capire 0829 complemented by the Franchezza 0863 skirt, Ustica A 0101 trousers, Neanide 0002 earrings and Xnina A 0101 0002 glasses.

looks.title: Total Look (Nero)
looks.text: Capire 0101 with a stylish Faustin 0101 skirt, Udita 0101 0101 0002 shoes, Necessario 0101 0002 bracelet and Nordici 0068 0002 earrings.

advice: Emphasize the season's key trend of the off-shoulder neckline: this silhouette visually elongates the neck, creating a captivating yet understated look.
Recommend this piece to clients who value tactile sensation: the high mohair content makes the knit remarkably soft and inviting.
Suggest a play of textures: the pullover pairs beautifully with leather, lace, or heavy tweed, as confirmed by our runway looks.

objections.q: Mohair may cause a prickling sensation.
objections.a: The piece is made with high-quality mohair blended with 35% polyamide, which lends the yarn a silky quality and minimizes any skin irritation.

objections.q: Off-the-shoulder styling seems impractical for the cold season.
objections.a: The 'collo rovesciato' (folded collar) design allows the degree of coverage to be adjusted. Moreover, mohair offers excellent thermoregulating properties.

objections.q: The burgundy shade seems too bold.
objections.a: Shade 2452 is a deep, classic wine tone that this season has become the new neutral, pairing beautifully with the core wardrobe palette.

objections.q: The Regular fit cut may look shapeless.
objections.a: It is precisely the emphasis at the shoulders that balances the silhouette, creating an elegant vertical line, while the soft drape of the knit delicately flatters the figure.

objections.q: How should such a delicate fiber blend be cared for?
objections.a: We recommend professional dry cleaning or hand-washing in cool water with specialized wool detergents, to preserve the fibers' plush texture.

3.name: Caprese B
3.description: The Caprese B pullover by Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of refined minimalism and impeccable Italian craftsmanship. This piece is a foundational wardrobe element in the "quiet luxury" aesthetic, striking the perfect balance between tactile comfort and aristocratic refinement. Clean lines and a flawless fit make this pullover a versatile base for layered, runway-inspired looks, underscoring the brand's commitment to the highest standards of quality.

looks.title: Total Look (Cammello)
looks.text: Cremina 2331 2219, Caprese B 2331, Fragolino 3274, Ulisside 2240 0038, Iago 2240 0002, Nagorno 0002.

looks.title: Total Look (Nero)
looks.text: Cremina 0101 0101, Caprese B 0101, Fabula 0101, Ulisside 0101 0038, Neanide 0002.

advice: Emphasize versatility: the Caprese B pullover is the perfect companion to richly textured jackets such as Cremina, creating a harmonious and polished look.
Recommend the piece as an investment in a foundational wardrobe: the classic camel, black, and cream tones are timeless and pair effortlessly with any seasonal arrival.
Suggest a play of contrasts: the understated Caprese B knit pairs beautifully with textured skirts, such as the checked Fragolino, or with leather accessories.

objections.q: The design seems too simple.
objections.a: True elegance lies precisely in simplicity. This model is designed as a flawless canvas that allows the luxury of Luisa Spagnoli's fabrics and accessories to take center stage.

objections.q: Concern that the camel shade may not suit the complexion.
objections.a: Shade 2331 (Cammello) was selected by our stylists as the most universally flattering warm tone, one that refreshes the complexion and lends the look a noble radiance.

objections.q: from official sources regarding the exact composition.
objections.a: Every Luisa Spagnoli piece is crafted from carefully selected natural fibers, undergoing rigorous quality control to ensure durability and comfort.

objections.q: How should this model be styled for an evening occasion?
objections.a: Add statement jewelry, such as the Neanide earrings or the Natalidi necklace, and complete the look with the elegant Ulisside boots for an evening-chic finish.

objections.q: Concern about caring for light shades (Panna).
objections.a: We recommend professional cleaning, which will preserve the fiber's structure and the brightness of the milky 0202 shade for many seasons to come.

4.name: Caserta
4.description: The Caserta pullover is the embodiment of refined comfort and contemporary elegance from Luisa Spagnoli. Cut in a relaxed silhouette from a noble wool and cashmere blend, it offers exceptional tactile sensation and warmth. The design is accentuated by a voluminous turtleneck collar and kimono-cut sleeves that create a striking architectural volume. High ribbed cuffs delicately draw attention to the wrists, lending the look refinement. This pullover strikes a perfect balance between relaxed style and impeccable Italian quality.

looks.title: Total Look 211 (Blu Inchiostro)
looks.text: Caserta 2544 harmoniously combined with Olap 0214 trousers, accessorized with a Navigero 0002 bracelet, Navali 0002 necklace and Usuale A 0901 0002 shoes.

looks.title: Total Look 228 (Grigio Melange)
looks.text: Caserta 0856 paired with Olla 1073 jeans, decorated with a Nabrezina 0068 0001 0002 brooch and completed with Uramaky 0101 loafers.

advice: Emphasize the premium composition: 10% cashmere combined with 90% pure wool delivers extraordinary softness and warmth without unnecessary weight.
Recommend the piece as a cornerstone of a 'quiet luxury' wardrobe — the loose fit and kimono sleeves create a refined and contemporary silhouette.
Suggest a play of contrasts: the voluminous Caserta pullover pairs beautifully with slim-fit Olap trousers or understated Olla denim, creating a balanced daytime look.

objections.q: The model seems too loose and may add volume.
objections.a: The voluminous cut is designed to create an on-trend oversized silhouette. Paired with a slim bottom (such as skinny trousers), the pullover instead accentuates the delicacy of the figure.

objections.q: Concern that the turtleneck collar will be uncomfortable.
objections.a: Thanks to the addition of cashmere, the collar has a particular softness. Its relaxed 'morbido collo dolcevita' shape does not constrict the neck, ensuring comfort.

objections.q: How should such a delicate wool-and-cashmere blend be cared for?
objections.a: The use of high-quality carded wool minimizes pilling. We recommend professional cleaning or gentle hand-washing to preserve the fibers' plush texture.

objections.q: The Blu Inchiostro shade seems too dark.
objections.a: This is a deep, noble shade that this season serves as a status-defining alternative to black. It beautifully illuminates the face, especially when paired with gold-tone accessories.

objections.q: Can this model be adapted for a more formal occasion?
objections.a: Absolutely. Adding statement jewelry, such as the Nabrezina brooch or the Navali necklace, instantly elevates the look's degree of formality.

7.name: Cassina
7.description: This pullover is the quintessence of Italian elegance from Luisa Spagnoli. The Cassina model, crafted from a noble blend of 90% pure wool and 10% cashmere, achieves a perfect balance between exceptional warmth and refined style. The design's highlight lies in its distinctive 'pera'-shaped sleeves and an accent peplum at the waist that flows into a soft flounce, lending the silhouette an inimitable femininity. A 'serafino'-style closure, adorned with the house's signature heraldic LS buttons, underscores status and attention to detail, transforming this carded knitwear into a true object of desire.

looks.title: Total Look 171 (Menta)
looks.text: Cassina 0506 paired with Olivetano 0943 trousers, accessorized with Neanide 0002 earrings and Uramaky 0990 footwear.

looks.title: Total Look 226 (Peonia)
looks.text: Cassina 1802 paired with Olla 1073 jeans, Urbana 0101 shoes, Xnina A 0101 0002 glasses and an Ls1928p A 0101 0038 bag.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the premium composition: cashmere lends unparalleled softness, while virgin wool provides durability and a refined structure.
Emphasize the distinctive cut of the sleeves and peplum: this piece beautifully conceals figure nuances, creating a harmonious and deeply feminine silhouette.
Suggest Cassina as a key layering piece: the heraldic buttons allow the pullover to be worn alone or over a delicate silk blouse.

objections.q: Concern that the peplum (flounce) will visually add volume around the hips.
objections.a: On the contrary, the peplum cut, combined with the fitted waist section, structures the silhouette, creating an 'hourglass' effect and accentuating the waist.

objections.q: How should such a delicate cashmere-blend piece be cared for?
objections.a: We recommend exclusively professional dry cleaning, to preserve the delicate structure of the carded yarn and the flawless appearance of the signature buttons.

objections.q: The heraldic buttons seem overly decorative.
objections.a: These details are a symbol of the Luisa Spagnoli brand's DNA. They take the place of jewelry, allowing the look to remain understated yet status-defining.

objections.q: The model seems too dressy for everyday wear.
objections.a: Paired with denim, as in our Look 226, the Cassina pullover takes on an on-trend casual-chic style, while preserving its note of luxury.

objections.q: Won't the Regular fit be too loose?
objections.a: The Regular fit in this model is designed to ensure freedom of movement, while the peplum guarantees the piece sits precisely on the figure.

8.name: Cavina
8.description: The Cavina cardigan by Luisa Spagnoli is the quintessence of refinement, uniting the warmth of carded wool with the sheen of an evening ensemble. Crafted from an exclusive knit incorporating pure wool and cashmere, delicately illuminated with lurex threads for a soft shimmering effect. The signature stylistic accent is jewel-like 'gioia' buttons that transform the piece into a true objet d'art. Voluminous sleeves with striking high ribbed cuffs underscore a contemporary architectural cut, while the classic Regular fit ensures flawless comfort and elegance of silhouette.

looks.title: Total Look Vetrina 99
looks.text: Cavina 0952 0428 paired with a Latteria 0994 blouse and Opaglio 0927 trousers. The look is completed by an Iri 0970 0002 accessory (Information not available in official sources).

looks.title: Styling suggestion (Luxury Casual)
looks.text: Combining the textured Cavina cardigan with the clean lines of the Maglieria Cardata collection creates a layered look where the shimmer of lurex is balanced by the depth of brown shades (Marrone).

advice: Draw attention to the piece's versatility: thanks to its jewel-like buttons, the cardigan can stand in for a necklace or brooch, becoming the centerpiece of the look.
Emphasize the composition: 7% cashmere and 20% viscose lend the texture remarkable softness, offsetting the traditional stiffness of lurex-blended wool yarns.
Recommend Cavina as the ideal investment for a 'Day-to-Night' wardrobe — refined enough for the office, yet elegant enough for a cocktail occasion.

objections.q: Lurex may cause prickling or discomfort when worn.
objections.a: This model uses a new-generation lurex woven into a base with a high content of viscose and cashmere, guaranteeing absolute smoothness and tactile comfort.

objections.q: The model seems too dressy for an everyday wardrobe.
objections.a: Pair Cavina with wardrobe basics, such as the Opaglio 0927 trousers, as styled in our window display. This lowers the degree of formality while preserving the look's status.

objections.q: Concern that the buttons may tarnish or fall off.
objections.a: The jewel buttons are hand-set to the high standards of Italian craftsmanship. Each detail carries a protective galvanic coating that prevents metal oxidation.

objections.q: How should such a complex, metallic-fiber composition be cared for?
objections.a: We strongly recommend professional dry cleaning only, to preserve the voluminous shape of the balloon sleeves and the lurex's original shimmer.

objections.q: The sleeves seem overly voluminous.
objections.a: The 'bombate' sleeve shape is a key trend of the season, one that visually narrows the waist and balances the silhouette, creating harmonious proportions.

9.name: Cetello
9.description: This cropped cardigan is the true embodiment of refined luxury from Luisa Spagnoli. Crafted from a noble blend of 90% pure wool and 10% cashmere, it delivers unsurpassed softness and warmth. A textured 'flat rib' knit lends the piece contemporary architecture, while exquisite 'gioia' buttons serve as a jewel-like accent, elevating the knitwear into a dressed-up element of the look. The Regular fit silhouette and on-trend cropped length make Cetello the ideal choice for creating elegant, layered ensembles in the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic.

looks.title: Total Look 207
looks.text: Cetello 0637 paired with Olivetano 1251 trousers, accessorized with Neanide 0002 earrings, a Dogale A 0986 0002 belt and Uramaky 0990 footwear.

advice: Emphasize the premium composition: the presence of cashmere makes the cardigan remarkably soft to the touch, instantly earning the trust of the most discerning client.
Recommend the piece as the perfect complement to high-waisted trousers and skirts — Cetello's cropped length flatters the waist and visually elongates the legs.
Highlight the prestige of the hardware: the jewel buttons minimize the need for additional accessories, as they serve as a complete adornment in themselves.

objections.q: The cropped length seems impractical for the cold season.
objections.a: This style is designed for on-trend high-waisted looks, while the high cashmere content guarantees excellent thermoregulation.

objections.q: Concern that the pale Celeste shade will be difficult to style.
objections.a: Sky blue is a 'Quiet Luxury' classic. It beautifully refreshes the complexion and harmonizes perfectly with the blue, grey, and brown palette of our Lookbook.

objections.q: How should a piece with such a delicate composition and decorative buttons be cared for?
objections.a: We recommend exclusively professional cleaning, to preserve the voluminous structure of the wool fibers and the pristine shine of the jewel buttons.

objections.q: A ribbed cardigan may visually add volume.
objections.a: On the contrary, the flat-rib knitting technique in this model creates vertical lines that structure the silhouette, making it appear more composed.

objections.q: The model seems too dressy for everyday wear.
objections.a: Style Cetello with the understated Olivetano 1251 trousers to create a status-defining casual-chic look.

10.name: Cinguettio
10.description: This vest from the Maglieria Cardata line by Luisa Spagnoli is the quintessence of cozy luxury and functional style. Crafted from a noble blend of 90% pure wool and 10% cashmere, it delivers exceptional tactile sensation and gentle warmth. The design, featuring accent dropped shoulders and flat-rib edge finishing, lends the silhouette contemporary architecture. A horn-effect button closure serves as an elegant touch, underscoring the brand's commitment to classic tradition reimagined for today. The Regular fit ensures versatility and comfort, making this piece ideal for creating status-defining layered ensembles.

looks.title: Total Look 181 (Elegant Blue)
looks.text: Cinguettio 1251 paired with a Leila A 0201 shirt, corduroy Olap 1296 trousers and Olivetano 1251 trousers. The look is completed by Urbana 0981 ankle boots, a Navigero 0002 bracelet and a Roboamo 3463 scarf.

looks.text: Cinguettio 0835 paired with a Scalare 0817 jacket, Ferriera 0813 skirt and a classic Lucinda 0201 shirt (Information not available in official sources).

advice: Emphasize the premium composition: 10% cashmere combined with select wool delivers unparalleled softness that the client will appreciate from the very first touch.
Recommend the vest as a key layering piece — it sits beautifully over silk blouses or fine turtlenecks without restricting movement.
Highlight the contemporary design: the dropped shoulder line is a subtle trend that lends the classic vest a modern, statement-making air.

objections.q: A sleeveless waistcoat seems impractical for true winter weather.
objections.a: It is precisely the absence of sleeves that makes it versatile for indoor and office wear, while the high cashmere content guarantees excellent thermoregulation beneath outerwear.

objections.q: Concern that carded wool may feel uncomfortable against the skin.
objections.a: Thanks to the addition of cashmere and the high quality of the wool finishing, the waistcoat has a silky texture and is exceptionally pleasant against the body.

objections.q: The design seems too understated.
objections.a: This is precisely where the true elegance of 'Quiet Luxury' lies. The horn-effect buttons and ribbed trim are details that convey the piece's high status without excess ostentation.

objections.q: How should such delicate knitwear be cared for?
objections.a: We recommend professional cleaning or gentle hand-washing in cool water with specialized wool detergents, to preserve the fibers' plush structure.

objections.q: The model may look too voluminous.
objections.a: The Regular fit is designed to skim the figure delicately. The dropped shoulder creates an on-trend silhouette without overburdening the look with excess volume.

11.name: Cips
11.description: The exquisite Cips polo from the Maglieria Cardata line by Luisa Spagnoli is the quintessence of tactile luxury and contemporary Italian style. Crafted from an exclusive bouclÃ© alpaca blend that lends the piece a distinctive 'grainy' texture and cloud-like softness. The design is defined by its clean lines: short sleeves, an open notched collar and delicate flat-rib edge finishing. The Regular fit ensures flawless comfort, making this polo a foundational wardrobe piece for creating status-defining layered looks.

advice: Emphasize the unique composition: 75% alpaca provides unparalleled thermoregulation and lightness, making the piece comfortable for any season.
Present Cips as the foundation of a layering concept — the open collar allows the polo to be styled beautifully with contrasting shirts or silk blouses.
Draw attention to the bouclé texture: a key trend that adds visual depth and an air of aristocratic ease to the look.

objections.q: Alpaca may cause prickling on the skin.
objections.a: This model uses top-grade alpaca blended with 25% polyamide, which stabilizes the fiber, making the polo tactilely pleasant and silky.

objections.q: A short sleeve seems impractical for a winter collection.
objections.a: The Cips model is specifically designed to be worn beneath jackets, cardigans, or trench coats, providing warmth to the torso without excess bulk at the sleeves.

objections.q: Concern that the bouclé texture may visually add volume.
objections.a: The straight Regular fit silhouette and understated cut conceal the material's volume, creating a structured, contemporary look.

objections.q: The pink shade (0328) may look too dressy.
objections.a: This shade in our collection carries a noble, dusty undertone that harmonizes beautifully with the core grey and beige palette, refreshing the complexion.

objections.q: Concern about caring for such delicate knitwear.
objections.a: We recommend professional cleaning, which will preserve the bouclé's voluminous texture and the alpaca fibers' original softness for a long time to come.

12.name: Cirillo
12.description: The Cirillo cardigan by Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of effortless luxury and Italian craftsmanship. Crafted from an exquisite carded yarn harmoniously combining 90% pure wool and 10% cashmere, delivering exceptional softness and enveloping warmth. The deconstructed, closure-free cut underscores a contemporary pursuit of freedom of movement and layering. The piece's edges are delicately finished in rib, lending the understated design architectural finesse. The Regular fit makes this cardigan a foundational base for creating status-defining everyday looks in the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic.

looks.title: Total Look 194 (Vinaccia)

looks.text: Cirillo 1111 complemented by a Costanzo 1111 top, Olap 1119 trousers and Urbana 0981 footwear. Accents: Ls1928gp A 1158 0038 bag, Nuevitas 0002 0001 necklace, Niccioleta 1120 0002 pendant and Niassesi 1116 0002 bracelet. Navoncella 0002 — Information not available in official sources.

advice: Emphasize the precious composition: 10% cashmere lends the piece that silken softness clients seek in premium knitwear.
Recommend Cirillo as the ideal tool for creating a vertical line in the silhouette — the open design visually elongates the figure and slims the frame.
Suggest pairing the piece with the Costanzo top to create a harmonious twin-set, the very benchmark of elegance within the knitwear collection.

objections.q: The absence of buttons or a closure makes the cardigan impractical.
objections.a: The Cirillo design is inspired by 'effortless chic' aesthetics. The open front allows for playing with volume and accessories, such as accentuating the waist with the Dogale A belt.

objections.q: Carded wool may pill with wear.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli uses the highest quality wool and cashmere. Following gentle care guidelines (professional cleaning), the piece will retain its plush structure for years to come.

objections.q: No price is listed, it seems like too costly a purchase.
objections.a: This cardigan is a long-term investment for the wardrobe. Its premium composition guarantees exceptional thermoregulation and durability, ensuring a flawless appearance in any setting.

objections.q: The Vinaccia (2453) shade seems too particular.
objections.a: This ripened-grape shade is one of the most aristocratic in our palette. It pairs beautifully with grey, blue, and chocolate tones, adding depth and luxury to the look.

objections.q: The model seems too simple in its design.
objections.a: True luxury lies in the quality of the material and the purity of the lines. Cirillo's understated design allows it to be the perfect canvas for statement accessories, such as the Navali necklace or the Neanide earrings.

13.name: Costanzo
13.description: This exquisite short-sleeve top from Luisa Spagnoli is the quintessence of everyday luxury. Styled after the classic T-shirt, it is elevated to the realm of high fashion through the use of a noble blend of 90% pure wool and 10% cashmere. Particular charm is lent by edges finished in contrasting trim, which accentuates the graphic quality of the silhouette and the brand's attention to detail. The Regular fit ensures flawless comfort, transforming this knit top into a foundational wardrobe piece for creating status-defining layered ensembles in the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic.

looks.title: Total Look 194 (Vinaccia)
looks.text: Cirillo 2453 combined with Costanzo 2453, Ottana 3417 trousers and Ustica A 2450 boots. The look is completed with a Navali 0002 necklace, Dogale A 0986 0002 belt and Niassesi 2449 0002 bracelet. Navoncella 0002 — Data not available in official sources.

looks.text: Cirillo 1111 complemented by a Costanzo 1111 top, Olap 1119 trousers and Urbana 0981 ankle boots. Accents: Nuevitas 0002 0001 necklace, Niccioleta 1120 0002 pendant and Niassesi 1116 0002 bracelet.

advice: Embrace the 'set concept': present Costanzo alongside the Cirillo cardigan in matching tones for an impeccable runway-worthy twin-set, synonymous with Luisa Spagnoli elegance.
Draw the client's attention to the premium composition: 10% cashmere lends the knit the very softness that makes the piece indispensable for wear against the skin.
Emphasize versatility: the contrasting trim allows the top to be paired effortlessly with tailored Olap trousers or more relaxed denim, while preserving a note of high style.

objections.q: A short sleeve seems impractical for a winter collection.
objections.a: The top is designed as the ideal base layer beneath jackets and cardigans. The wool-and-cashmere blend ensures excellent thermoregulation even without a long sleeve.

objections.q: Concern that carded wool may feel uncomfortable against the skin.
objections.a: Thanks to the addition of cashmere, the fiber becomes remarkably soft and silky, minimizing any irritation even for those with sensitive skin.

objections.q: The design seems too simple.
objections.a: True luxury lies in the quality of the material and the purity of the lines. The contrasting trim is a subtle styling device that sets the Costanzo model apart from basic knitwear.

objections.q: The Vinaccia (2453) shade is too intense.
objections.a: The 'wine berry' shade is one of the most status-defining of the season. It beautifully illuminates the face and harmonizes perfectly with the neutral grey and brown palette.

objections.q: How should such a delicate combined knit be cared for?
objections.a: We recommend professional cleaning, to preserve the cashmere's voluminous structure and the brightness of the contrasting details for many seasons to come.

14.name: Cremina
14.description: The Cremina vest is the quintessence of contemporary Italian style, uniting sporty dynamism with tactile luxury. Crafted from a noble blend of 90% pure wool and 10% cashmere, it delivers exceptional warmth and softness to the touch. A textured rib knit lends the piece architectural volume, while exquisite eco-leather pocket trims add a note of boldness and status. A functional hood and a secure zip closure make this vest an indispensable element for creating layered ensembles in the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic.

looks.title: Total Look (Luxury Sport)
looks.text: Cremina 2331 2219 combined with a Caprese B 2331 pullover and Ontani 1262 trousers. The look is completed with a Muni 1270 accessory ( Data not available in official sources).

looks.title: Total Look (City Chic)
looks.text: Cremina 0101 0101 complemented by a Mossa G 0101 pullover and tailored Optare 3326 trousers.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the premium composition: 10% cashmere makes the vest remarkably soft, elevating it from a practical piece to an object of true indulgence.
Highlight the statement detail — the eco-leather trim. It sets the piece apart from classic knitwear, lending it a modern and refined appearance.
Recommend Cremina as the ideal layering solution: the vest sits beautifully over fine sweaters and shirts, allowing freedom of movement without compromising style.

objections.q: The absence of sleeves makes the model insufficiently warm for winter.
objections.a: The waistcoat is specifically designed for an active lifestyle and for driving. The wool-and-cashmere blend guarantees flawless thermoregulation across the torso.

objections.q: A ribbed knit may visually add unwanted volume.
objections.a: On the contrary, the vertical knit pattern creates a clean vertical line that elongates the silhouette, while the straight Regular fit cut ensures a perfect fit.

objections.q: The eco-leather pocket trim may crack or lose its appearance.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli uses high-tech eco-leather, resistant to wear and external factors, guaranteeing the aesthetic is preserved for many seasons to come.

objections.q: The hood makes the piece too sporty.
objections.a: Thanks to the noble texture of the cashmere blend, the hood reads as elegant. This is the embodiment of the 'sport-chic' style currently at the height of fashion.

objections.q: How should such combined knitwear be cared for?
objections.a: We recommend professional dry cleaning. This will preserve the softness of the cashmere fibers and the piece's original shape for a long time to come.

15.name: Cremona
15.description: The exquisite Cremona jacquard pullover by Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of tactile luxury and impeccable Italian style. Crafted from a noble blend of pure wool and alpaca, lending the piece exceptional softness and enveloping warmth. The principal aesthetic accent is an intricate jacquard pattern and accent gathered shoulders that create a contemporary, distinctly feminine silhouette. The Regular fit and classic round neckline make this pullover a foundational wardrobe piece for creating status-defining layered ensembles in the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic.

The Cromatura model, crafted from a noble carded yarn harmoniously combining 90% pure wool and 10% cashmere, lends the piece exceptional softness and enveloping warmth. The principal aesthetic accent is a lavish scattering of stones, hand-applied around the collar and shoulders, lending the look an aristocratic sense of occasion. The cropped cut, paired with a round neckline and a concealed snap closure, underscores the silhouette's contemporary architecture, making this cardigan a centerpiece for an evening or status-defining daytime wardrobe.

17.description: This exquisite cropped pullover from Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of contemporary glamour and tactile softness. The Cufra model, crafted from a luxurious blend of mohair and cotton, delicately illuminated with lurex threads that lend the classic rib knit an aristocratic shimmer. A soft turtleneck collar and raglan sleeves ensure flawless comfort and freedom of movement, while the on-trend cropped length allows for striking layered looks in the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic. This piece strikes the perfect balance between cozy everyday knitwear and a status-defining element of the evening wardrobe.

Made in Italy from 100% genuine leather (Vera Pelle), the accessory unites architectural precision with exceptional comfort, thanks to an innovative elastic insert at the back. Entirely made in Italy, this accessory is destined to become the centerpiece of a look in the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic, underscoring its wearer's refined taste.

objections.a: In contemporary luxury aesthetics, such accessories are often used to create contrast within everyday looks, adding a note of refinement to essential pieces.

objections.a: We recommend storing the piece in its signature dust bag and avoiding direct contact with perfume. The high-quality galvanic coating reliably protects the metal from tarnishing.

objections.q: The crystal colour (Topaz) may not suit my colour palette.
objections.a: The topaz tone was selected by the designers as one of the most harmonious and refined shades. It pairs beautifully with both warm beige tones and cool blue or grey knitwear.

objections.q: Concern about the care required for wool-blend fabric.
objections.a: To preserve the fabric's original texture and the precision of the cut, we recommend exclusively professional dry cleaning, ensuring the garment's longevity across many seasons.

45.name: Ferriera
45.description: The Ferriera midi skirt by Luisa Spagnoli is the impeccable embodiment of Italian craftsmanship and classic elegance within the Giorno line. Cut in a flared circle silhouette (ruota), the piece is crafted from a noble wool blend that delivers exceptional softness and structured, gentle folds. The design is defined by architectural clarity: a flat waistband accentuates the delicacy of the silhouette, while a concealed side zip closure guarantees a flawless fit. A mid-calf length and fluid cut transform this skirt into a foundational wardrobe piece for creating status-defining looks in the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic.

Draw attention to the 'ruota' silhouette: the flared cut visually narrows the waist, creating a feminine look with effortless ease.

objections.a: The fabric holds sufficient body for the pleats to fall vertically, without adding volume at the hips. We recommend pairing it with a fitted top, such as the Logge top.

47.name: Fidente
47.description: The Fidente midi skirt by Luisa Spagnoli is a manifesto of contemporary femininity and tactile luxury. Crafted from the finest 100% genuine leather (Vera Pelle), it guarantees a flawless fit and lasting quality. An architectural, panel-constructed cut accentuates the sculptural quality of the silhouette, while a daring, deep front slit lends the look dynamism and runway-worthy edge. Functional details such as side pockets and belt loops, combined with a mid-calf length, make this piece a versatile base for creating status-defining ensembles in the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic.

Draw attention to the 'vertical effect': the deep front slit visually elongates the legs and lends grace to the walk, making the skirt the ideal choice for statement occasions.

objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli uses a specially finished leather known for its exceptional softness and elasticity, moving with the lines of the body and ensuring comfort throughout the day.

objections.q: How should a piece made from 100% natural leather be cared for?
objections.a: We recommend exclusively professional leather cleaning. This preserves the integrity of the fibres and the richness of the Marrone shade for many seasons to come.

objections.q: Concern about styling such a bold material.
objections.a: The Fidente skirt is surprisingly versatile. It pairs beautifully with a classic Loriana 0201 shirt for the office, as well as with an eveningwear top for a formal occasion.

49.name: Fiordaliso
49.description: The elegant Fiordaliso midi skirt by Luisa Spagnoli is the quintessence of textural luxury and flawless Italian style. Crafted from a noble bouclÃ© fabric that lends the piece an inimitable depth and aristocratic softness. The principal aesthetic accent is gold-tone domed buttons (bombati) that illuminate the fabric's texture and lend the look status. A classic pencil silhouette with an exquisite front slit masterfully sculpts the figure while allowing complete freedom of movement, making this piece a foundational wardrobe element in the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic.

Draw attention to the 'vertical effect': the front slit and high waistline visually elongate the legs, creating a runway-worthy silhouette even in everyday wear.

objections.q: Bouclé fabric may appear too voluminous on the figure.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli's designers use a fine-textured bouclé combined with a 'tubino' cut. This creates a clean shape that structures the silhouette without adding bulk.

objections.q: The front slit may seem too bold for an office dress code.
objections.a: Thanks to the midi length and the brand's classic aesthetic, the slit remains understated and functional, adding only a touch of contemporary femininity to a tailored look.

objections.a: The fabric composition is predominantly polyester and acrylic (74%), which provides a dense weave and greater durability compared to traditional tweed.

objections.a: We recommend exclusively professional cleaning. This preserves the pristine loft of the bouclé and the shine of the hardware's galvanic coating for the long term.

objections.a: It is precisely the play of light on the bouclé texture and the gleam of the gold buttons that make the Fiordaliso piece a standalone statement item, distinguishing it from ordinary smooth knitwear.

50.name: Fiorini
50.description: The Fiorini midi skirt by Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of refined textural luxury and impeccable tailoring craftsmanship. Crafted from a unique reinforced fabric, delicately illuminated with micro-sequins and silver lurex, lending the piece an aristocratic sheen. A straight, knee-length silhouette is complemented by a striking side slit finished with passementerie trim that creates the illusion of a wrap closure. Harmoniously combining 50% cotton with noble wool, this piece is the ideal choice for status-defining daytime ensembles and cocktail occasions.

Highlight the craftsmanship of the cut: the straight, knee-length silhouette paired with a passementerie-trimmed slit creates a graceful wrap effect, lending the look a sense of movement.
Recommend the piece as an investment in 'quiet luxury' style: the refined black-and-cream palette (Nero Panna) and premium fabric composition underscore the wearer's status.

objections.a: The high cotton content (50%) in the fabric composition guarantees softness and exceptional tactile comfort against the skin.

objections.a: The designers incorporated a side slit, which serves not only as a stylish accent but also ensures complete freedom of movement.

objections.q: Concern that the sequins may shed over time.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli pieces employ advanced technology to secure the decoration within the fabric structure, guaranteeing exceptional durability.

55.name: Fondazione
55.description: The Fondazione maxi skirt is a true masterpiece of the Luisa Spagnoli evening collection, embodying aristocratic grace and runway-worthy chic. The piece features a multi-tiered construction (balze), with each tier artfully accented by delicate tulle, framed with exquisite scalloped lace (pizzo smerlato). An ankle-grazing length and flawless cut create striking dynamism in movement, transforming this skirt into the centerpiece of a formal look. Uniting the fragility of lace with architectural precision of line, this piece is designed to underscore its wearer's exceptional status.

advice: Emphasize the distinctive finish: the combination of tulle and scalloped lace is a mark of exceptional craftsmanship that instantly elevates the look into the realm of exclusive evening wear.
Recommend the piece as the ideal choice for Black Tie occasions — Fondazione requires no elaborate styling, standing as a powerful statement piece in its own right.
Highlight the functionality of the fabric: premium 100% polyester ensures the tiers and lace retain their impeccable shape throughout the entire evening.

objections.q: A tiered maxi length may visually add weight to the figure.
objections.a: Thanks to the use of weightless tulle and a thoughtful distribution of volume, the Fondazione skirt creates a fluid, ethereal silhouette. We recommend pairing it with a fitted top, such as the Lunetta 0101, to harmonise the proportions.

objections.q: Lace and tulle may seem too delicate and short-lived.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli employs contemporary lace-treatment technology, which enhances its durability. With proper care, the pristine aesthetic can be preserved for years to come.

objections.q: Concern that the polyester content may be uncomfortable.
objections.a: In eveningwear, polyester is prized for its ability to hold its shape impeccably and resist creasing. This ensures you will look flawless throughout the entire event.

objections.q: Monochrome black may appear too severe.
objections.a: The interplay of textures — matte tulle and shimmering lace — lends the black colour extraordinary depth and dimension, eliminating any sense of monotony.

objections.q: Concern about caring for such a multi-layered piece.
objections.a: For pieces of this level of intricacy, we strongly recommend exclusively professional dry cleaning to guarantee the integrity of the lace structure and all tiers.

56.name: Fragolino
56.description: The Fragolino midi skirt by Luisa Spagnoli is the quintessence of classic elegance within the Giorno line. Crafted from a noble wool-blend fabric in a timeless pied-de-poule pattern. The architectural design is accentuated by a deep central pleat that lends the piece runway-worthy volume and movement. A mid-calf length and concealed back zip closure ensure a flawless silhouette, making this skirt a foundational investment in the 'quiet luxury' wardrobe.

Highlight the craftsmanship of the cut: the deep center pleat creates the essential vertical line that visually elongates the silhouette and lends the walk a particular grace.
Recommend Fragolino as the foundation for layered 'Urban Luxe' looks — paired with tall leather Ulisside boots and cashmere knitwear.

objections.q: The houndstooth print may seem too conservative.
objections.a: The brand's designers reimagined this classic, giving the Fragolino skirt a fashion-forward midi length and a deep pleat. This creates a contemporary, dynamic look, particularly when styled with the Renno cap.

objections.q: A mid-calf length seems challenging when it comes to choosing footwear.
objections.a: This is, in fact, the most prestigious length. We recommend pairing it with low-heeled Ulisside boots or ankle boots on a sturdy heel to achieve perfect proportions.

objections.q: Concern that the fabric may lose its shape and the pleat may open.
objections.a: The wool blend (59% wool, 29% polyester) guarantees the piece retains its architectural shape and the pleat its crisp definition, even with active wear throughout the day.

objections.q: How should such a textured fabric be cared for?
objections.a: To preserve the pristine structure of the wool fibres and the contrast of the pattern, we recommend exclusively professional cleaning, ensuring the longevity of the piece.

objections.a: Shade 3274 has sufficient depth thanks to its contrasting thread weave. It serves as a refined, neutral backdrop that can be brightened with a bold top or accessories.

57.name: Franchezza
57.description: The elegant Franchezza midi skirt by Luisa Spagnoli is the quintessence of romantic chic and flawless Italian style. Crafted from exquisite floral lace with a tonal lining, creating a mesmerizing depth of texture. A classic pencil silhouette, paired with a below-the-knee length, masterfully sculpts a feminine silhouette. A concealed back zip closure ensures perfect purity of line, transforming this piece into a foundational element of both the formal and status-defining daytime wardrobe.

objections.q: Concern that the lace may lose its shape or stretch.

objections.q: A midi length may visually shorten the frame.
objections.a: Thanks to the tapered cut and the vertical lace pattern, the Franchezza skirt creates an unbroken line that, paired with heeled footwear such as the Ustica A 101, visually elongates the legs.

objections.q: Concern about caring for such a delicate material.
objections.a: We recommend exclusively professional cleaning, which will preserve the pristine beauty of the floral pattern and the richness of the colour for years to come.

objections.q: The lace may be sheer.
objections.a: The piece is fully lined with a soft lining that matches the garment, guaranteeing complete comfort, opacity, and a flawless fit.

60.name: Frazione
60.description: The Frazione midi skirt is a manifesto of contemporary femininity and architectural perfection from Luisa Spagnoli. Cut in a flared circle silhouette (ruota), the piece is crafted from an exquisite mÃ©lange bouclÃ© enriched with 10% natural silk, lending it aristocratic softness and a delicate play of light. A mid-calf length makes this piece a foundational investment in the wardrobe for creating status-defining ensembles in the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic.

objections.q: Bouclé fabric may appear too voluminous and visually add bulk.
objections.a: The melange fabric in this piece has an optimal density and weight. Thanks to the circle cut, the fabric falls in vertical folds, creating a slender, fluid silhouette.

objections.q: Concern that the fabric may quickly deform or lose its shape.
objections.a: The use of high-technology fibres (35% polyester) combined with wool and silk guarantees the stability of the fabric structure and prevents creasing throughout the day.

objections.q: A mid-calf length seems challenging when it comes to choosing footwear.
objections.a: This is, in fact, the most prestigious length. We recommend pairing it with tall Ustica A boots or heeled shoes to visually elongate the frame.

objections.q: Melange seems too casual for formal occasions.
objections.a: Thanks to its noble silken sheen and the ability to style it with fine jewellery-inspired knitwear (the Cromatura piece), the Frazione skirt transitions effortlessly into an evening look.

objections.q: Concern about caring for such a multi-fibre composition.
objections.a: To preserve the pristine bouclé texture and the sheen of the silk threads, we recommend exclusively professional dry cleaning, ensuring the longevity of your wardrobe investment.

64.name: Fumaiolo
64.description: An exquisite midi skirt in a wool blend, embodying Luisa Spagnoli's philosophy of fine tailoring artistry. objections.q: The decoration seems too delicate for everyday wear.
objections.a: The beaded and velvet embroidery is executed to the very highest quality standards. With proper professional care, the piece will retain its flawless appearance for years to come.

objections.q: The herringbone pattern may look too formal.
objections.a: In this piece, the classic austerity of the fabric is softened by artisanal embroidery and deep wine tones, making it suitable for both the office and social occasions.

objections.q: A mid-calf length may visually shorten the frame.
objections.a: The skirt's high-waisted cut, in fact, creates a slender vertical line and elegant proportions, particularly when paired with our heeled shoes or Ulisside boots.

objections.a: The blended composition, with the addition of acetate and polyester, makes the fabric pleasant to the touch and ensures a comfortable lightness, while preserving all the warmth-retaining properties of natural wool.

66.name: Galalite
66.description: An embodiment of evening luxury and jewel-like precision: the exquisite Galalite mini dress, crafted from precious macramÃ© lace. The piece enchants with an intricate interplay of raised patterns and the delicate shimmer of metallic threads, creating an effect of noble radiance. A classic round neckline and elegant raglan sleeves with scalloped edges underscore the brand's refined aesthetic, while a concealed back zip guarantees flawless purity of silhouette.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the richness of the macramé texture: the three-dimensional lace effect with a metallic shimmer makes this dress a true showpiece of the collection.

Showcase the craftsmanship of the edge finishing: the scalloped hem and cuffs reflect a couture level of execution.

objections.q: A mini length may seem insufficiently formal.
objections.a: Thanks to the rich texture of macramé lace and understated raglan sleeves, the piece maintains an aristocratic balance, fully in keeping with cocktail-event etiquette.

objections.q: It's difficult to find footwear to match such a striking gold shimmer.
objections.a: The 'Oro' gold shade is a classic neutral within the eveningwear wardrobe. We recommend pairing it with understated matching shoes or accessories, such as the Iroise 0212 0002.

objections.q: This dress is only suitable for a single occasion.
objections.a: Galalite is a timeless Luisa Spagnoli classic. By varying the accessories and hairstyle, you can create fresh looks for a range of social occasions across many seasons.

67.name: Gallerie
67.description: A flawless sleeveless midi dress, crafted from a luxurious wool-blend tweed. The piece is defined by a finely wrought cut that gently traces the silhouette before flowing into striking godet inserts at the hem, creating graceful movement. An elegant round neckline and a concealed back zip closure underscore purity of line. The look is completed with a stylish eco-leather belt in crocodile-effect embossing that draws precisely the right accent at the waist.

objections.q: A complex fabric composition makes care more difficult.
objections.a: The use of premium-quality fibres guarantees the longevity of the piece. Professional dry cleaning preserves the structure of the tweed and the vibrancy of the colour for many seasons.

objections.q: A below-the-knee length may call only for a high heel.
objections.a: Thanks to the godet cut, which visually softens the lower portion, this dress looks equally harmonious with classic pumps or our cylindrical-shaft Ulisside boots.

68.name: Gardana
68.description: The quintessence of evening elegance: the exquisite Gardana mini dress, crafted from precious lace with a delicate floral motif. The piece is defined by a flawless cut with a round neckline and long sheer sleeves that highlight the airiness of the fabric's texture. A couture accent in the form of a scalloped edge (smerlato) at the hem and sleeves lends the look finish, while a concealed back zip guarantees perfect purity of silhouette.

looks.title: Look 1 (Total Black Elegance)
looks.text: A luxurious evening ensemble combining a Gardana 0101 lace dress and a cropped jacket made of soft Svista 0101 faux fur. The look is finished with a concise Iroise 0101 0002 clutch.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the timeless aesthetic of floral lace: an investment for the wardrobe that will remain relevant for social occasions for seasons to come.
Recommend the piece as the ideal choice for cocktail events, highlighting the balance between its mini length and refined, covered neckline.
Draw attention to the play of textures: the combination of the dress's fitted base and sheer sleeves creates a striking and refined look.

objections.q: A length above the knee seems insufficiently formal.
objections.a: Thanks to the high quality of the lace and the long sleeves, the piece retains an aristocratic appearance, fully in keeping with the dress code of elegant evening events.

objections.q: Lace requires overly delicate care.
objections.a: The complex fabric composition, with the addition of polyamide, makes Gardana lace more durable and resistant to deformation, while preserving its visual delicacy.

objections.q: Will it be comfortable to wear a lace dress all evening?
objections.a: The piece is fully lined with a soft lining, ensuring perfect comfort against the skin and a flawless fit.

objections.q: A black lace look may seem too severe.
objections.a: The floral lace pattern lends the fabric volume and softness. We recommend completing the dress with gold Luisa Spagnoli accessories to add brightness and shine.

objections.q: It's difficult to find outerwear to match such a texture.
objections.a: The brand's designers recommend pairing the dress with our Svista 0101 fur jacket, which beautifully accentuates the luxury of the lace.

70.name: Genialita
70.description: An exquisite midi dress, crafted from fluid viscose satin with a striking animal print. The piece embodies a contemporary interpretation of classic femininity through a lavalliÃ¨re collar that can be tied in a bow, and voluminous sleeves with high fitted cuffs. A fitted silhouette with an elasticated waist detail and a delicate teardrop back neckline underscore the refinement of the look, making it the ideal choice for both daytime occasions and social events.

looks.title: Look 1
looks.text: A bold combination of a Genialita 3350 dress with a cropped Scalare 0101 jacket and high Ulisside 0101 0038 boots.

looks.title: Look 1
looks.text: A bold combination of a Genialita 3350 dress with a cropped Scalare 0101 jacket and high Ulisside 0101 0038 boots.

advice: Emphasize the status of the animal print, which, as rendered by Luisa Spagnoli, reads as noble and luxurious thanks to the deep Nero Marrone palette.
Showcase the client the versatility of the bow collar: it can be tied crisply or left relaxed, shifting the character of the look from professional to romantic.
Highlight the comfort of the fabric: viscose satin offers a pleasant cooling effect and the noble sheen characteristic of silk, while being more practical to wear.

objections.q: The animal print seems too bold for me.
objections.a: In this piece, the print is rendered in understated classic tones (black and brown), making it timeless. Paired with the structured Scalare jacket, it creates a highly elegant and balanced look.

objections.q: I'm not sure a mid-calf length will suit me.
objections.a: The dress features an exceptional cut with an emphasis on the waist, which visually elongates the silhouette. Paired with our Ulisside boots or heeled shoes, the proportions will look ideal.

objections.q: Viscose satin may crease heavily.
objections.a: The premium viscose used, with the addition of elastane (3%), gives the fabric greater flexibility and resistance to creasing compared to standard satin, while maintaining a flawless appearance throughout the day.

objections.q: The dress looks suitable only for evening wear.
objections.a: Thanks to its midi length and covered neckline, this dress can easily be adapted for daytime wardrobes, paired with understated outerwear and flat shoes.

objections.q: It's difficult to find accessories to match such a bold pattern.
objections.a: We recommend keeping to minimalism or choosing accessories in a tone that echoes the print. A black leather belt or gold hoop earrings will provide the perfect finishing touch without overwhelming the look.

74.name: Ghedi
74.description: An embodiment of contemporary elegance and flawless comfort: the Ghedi midi dress, crafted from innovative stretch technical jersey. The piece is defined by a fitted silhouette, masterfully accentuated by vertical seam lines that flow into striking godet inserts at the hem, creating refined movement. Three-quarter sleeves and subtly structured shoulders lend the look sculptural quality, while a matching eco-leather belt finely accentuates the waist. The design is completed by a concealed back zip, guaranteeing flawless purity of line.

looks.title: Look 3 (Elegant Everyday)
looks.text: A combination of the Ghedi 0101 dress with a Recapito 3439 scarf ( Data not available in official sources) and an Ippolita 0101 0002 bag (Data not available in official sources).

looks.title: Look 2 (Urban Chic)
looks.text: Luxurious duo of the Ghedi 0101 dress and Stenografo 0101 shawl-collar coat, complemented by the Ls1928p A 0101 0038 bag.

looks.title: Look 3 (Elegant Everyday)
looks.text: A combination of the Ghedi 0101 dress with a Recapito 3439 scarf ( Data not available in official sources) and an Ippolita 0101 0002 bag (Data not available in official sources).

advice: Draw the client's attention to the distinctive properties of technical jersey: the fabric offers a shaping effect, ensuring an impeccable fit and comfort throughout the day.
Showcase the couture-level godet cut at the hem, which visually lightens the silhouette and creates a flowing walk, elevating the dress from essential to statement-making.
Highlight the piece's versatility: thanks to its understated design and included accessories, the dress transitions effortlessly from a professional look to an evening ensemble.

objections.q: The cut seems too fitted.
objections.a: The dense technical jersey, with the addition of elastane (5%), does more than simply cling — it gently sculpts the figure, while the structural seams visually slim the silhouette.

objections.q: Viscose may be impractical to wear.
objections.a: The premium viscose used, combined with polyamide, makes the fabric resistant to creasing, making it ideal for women with demanding schedules.

objections.q: A mid-calf length may visually shorten the frame.
objections.a: The vertical cutting lines and godet effect, in fact, elongate the proportions. Paired with our Uragano A 0101 shoes or Ulisside boots, the look will appear beautifully balanced.

objections.q: The design seems too simple.
objections.a: The strength of the Ghedi dress lies in its understatement. It is the perfect canvas for the brand's fine jewellery, such as the Narsete 2 necklace.

objections.q: Black seems too severe.
objections.a: The 'Nero' black in this texture carries a refined matte sheen. You can add brightness to the look with contrasting accessories or a scarf from our collection.

75.name: Ghiglia
75.description: An embodiment of aristocratic chic and evening elegance: the exquisite Ghiglia midi dress, creating a flawless silhouette. The piece enchants with a contrast of textures: a finely wrought lace top with long sheer sleeves and a scalloped edge (smerlato) is paired with a clean-lined, straight-cut skirt in noble wool blend. A jewel-like accent is provided by an elegant belt with a radiant gummy buckle, while a back slit lends the gait grace and lightness.

looks.title: Look 1 (Luxurious Evening)
looks.text: A combination of the Ghiglia 0101 dress with a cropped Svista 0101 soft eco-fur jacket and a minimalist Iroise 0101 0002 clutch.

looks.title: Look 1 (Luxurious Evening)
looks.text: A combination of the Ghiglia 0101 dress with a cropped Svista 0101 soft eco-fur jacket and a minimalist Iroise 0101 0002 clutch.

advice: Emphasize the 'complete set' effect: the pairing of a lace top with a fitted skirt creates a finished look that requires no additional styling effort.
Recommend this piece as the ideal investment for Cocktail or Black Tie dress codes, where understated status is essential.
Draw the client's attention to the jeweled belt buckle: a ready-made styling solution that removes the need to source a separate statement accessory for the waist.

objections.q: The lace top looks too delicate for wear.
objections.a: The use of premium synthetic fibres in the lace composition (53% polyester) provides the necessary strength and shape retention, while visually remaining airy and couture in feel.

objections.q: A mid-calf length may visually shorten the frame.
objections.a: The straight cut of the skirt and the high waistline, accentuated by the belt, in fact create a slender vertical line. We recommend pairing this dress with our classic pumps or Udita heeled sandals.

objections.q: Black may seem too formal.
objections.a: The deep 'Nero' black in this piece is softened by the interplay of textures and the delicate sheerness of the lace sleeves, lending the look femininity and mystery.

objections.q: The dress seems suitable only for festive occasions.
objections.a: Thanks to the understated design of the wool skirt, when paired with a structured jacket, this dress can be adapted for even the most formal business meetings.

objections.q: Will it be comfortable to wear such a fitted skirt?
objections.a: The 4% elastane content in the fabric, together with the thoughtfully placed back slit, guarantees a flawless fit without restricting movement throughout the evening.

79.name: Gotica
79.description: An aristocratic chemisier-style midi dress, embodying the timeless elegance of Luisa Spagnoli. Crafted from soft wool flannel and completed with a luxurious detachable collar in contrasting lace, secured with delicate buttons. A fitted bodice and godet skirt create a feminine, flowing silhouette, while full elbow-length sleeves with high cuffs add runway-worthy chic to the look. The finishing touch is buttons bearing a raised gold logo, underscoring the exclusivity of the piece.

looks.title: Look 1 (Total Look)
looks.text: Gotica 1034 0202 dress paired with Neanide 0002 earrings, Danielina 0101 0002 belt, Uranio A 0101 pumps and Ls1928p A 0101 0038 bag.

looks.title: Look 1 (Total Look)
looks.text: Gotica 1034 0202 dress paired with Neanide 0002 earrings, Danielina 0101 0002 belt, Uranio A 0101 pumps and Ls1928p A 0101 0038 bag.

advice: Draw attention to the detachable lace collar: it allows the dress to transform from strict professional attire into a romantic evening look within seconds.
Present the client with the godet cut as the ideal solution for a slender silhouette and an effortless walk.
Emphasize the quality of the flannel: the natural wool content guarantees warmth and comfort in the cooler season, while the elastane ensures an impeccable fit.

objections.q: The lace collar seems too high-maintenance.
objections.a: The collar is detachable, which greatly simplifies the piece's care and allows it to be washed separately, keeping the look fresh.

objections.q: Wool flannel may feel stiff.
objections.a: The premium wool used, combined with polyester and elastane, makes the fabric soft, supple, and resistant to creasing throughout the day.

objections.q: The design looks too traditional.
objections.a: Contrasting buttons with the gold logo and a fashion-forward skirt cut lend this classic piece a modern, luxury character in line with global trends.

objections.q: A below-the-knee length calls only for a high heel.
objections.a: Thanks to its vertical structural lines and godet shape, this dress looks equally beautiful with classic pumps or our stylish Ulisside boots.

80.name: Gradis
80.description: A masterpiece of evening fashion from Luisa Spagnoli: the majestic Gradis long dress, created for the most momentous occasions. The sleeveless piece enchants with an exquisite geometric embroidery that finely adorns the bodice and flows seamlessly into a fluid skirt. An elegant bateau neckline at the front creates a striking contrast with a deep V-back dÃ©colletage, crafting a silhouette that is both aristocratic and sensuous. A multi-layered skirt of the finest tulle lends the look regal volume and noble airiness, transforming every movement into an act of pure grace.

looks.title: Look 1 (Evening Luxury in Black)
looks.text: An evening ensemble featuring the Gradis 0101 dress and a cropped Svista 0101 eco-fur jacket. The look is completed by Norico 0202 0001 0002 earrings, Ialofane 0101 0002 clutch and Ullano A 0002 pumps.

looks.title: Look 2 (Aristocratic Gianduia)
looks.text: Gradis 0966 dress paired with a Richiesta 0910 eco-fur stole. Jewelry accents: Notabili 0069 0001 0002 earrings, Invitata D 0001 0002 clutch and Ullano A 0002 sandals.

advice: Draw attention to the couture finishing: the geometric embroidery lends Gradis a contemporary edge while preserving its classic formality.
Highlight the piece's status for Black Tie and Gala-level events: the combination of a covered front and a deep back décolletage creates an intriguing and refined look.
Emphasize the exclusivity of the palette: the Gianduia shade is a luxurious alternative to black, underscoring the distinctiveness of the choice and enhancing the radiance of the client's skin.

objections.q: Tulle and embroidery may seem too fragile for a formal evening.
objections.a: The Gradis 0101 dress is crafted to the very highest Luisa Spagnoli standards. The multi-layered tulle has the necessary resilience, and the embroidery is securely fastened, guaranteeing the longevity of the piece with proper professional care.

objections.q: The dress looks too formal for my occasion.
objections.a: Thanks to its contemporary geometric pattern and the lightness of its materials, this piece feels thoroughly current. It is designed to make you feel confident and fashionable at any significant event.

objections.q: Concern that the multi-layered skirt may visually add volume.
objections.a: The skirt is constructed so that the tulle falls in soft, vertical lines. Paired with the accentuated waist and fitted bodice, this creates a harmonious, slender silhouette.

objections.q: An open back may make it difficult to choose the right undergarments.
objections.a: The dress's structured bodice provides the necessary support. Our stylists are always on hand to suggest specialised accessories that make wearing open-back pieces effortlessly comfortable.

objections.q: A floor-length hem may restrict movement.
objections.a: The length of the dress is designed to be worn with a high heel. Paired with our Ullano A 0002 shoes, the hem will float elegantly above the floor, creating the effect of a graceful, flowing stride.

82.name: Graffiti
82.description: An exquisite mini dress in mÃ©lange bouclÃ©, embodying a contemporary interpretation of Luisa Spagnoli's aristocratic style. The piece captivates the eye with an oversized Peter Pan collar with softly rounded edges and a contrasting chiffon lavalliÃ¨re bow. Structured shoulders and long sleeves create a crisp, graphic silhouette, while the fabric's noble texture, combined with an above-the-knee length, strikes the perfect balance between classic heritage and runway-worthy boldness.

looks.title: Look 1
looks.text: An overall ensemble uniting the Graffiti 3331 0201 0101 dress, high Ustica A 0101 boots and an Ls1928p A 0101 0038 bag. Completed with Norico 0001 0002 earrings ( Data not available in official sources).

looks.title: Look 1
looks.text: An overall ensemble uniting the Graffiti 3331 0201 0101 dress, high Ustica A 0101 boots and an Ls1928p A 0101 0038 bag. Completed with Norico 0001 0002 earrings ( Data not available in official sources).

advice: Draw the client's attention to the distinctive statement collar: a ready-made styling solution that removes the need for additional neck jewelry.
Showcase the richness of the bouclé texture — a material always associated with status and the superior quality characteristic of Italian craftsmanship.
Recommend pairing the Graffiti piece with our bags from the LS1928 line to highlight both the brand's heritage and its contemporary chic.

objections.q: A mini length may seem insufficiently serious for a business meeting.
objections.a: Thanks to its high neckline with long sleeves and dense bouclé texture, the Graffiti piece maintains an impeccable level of elegance, in keeping with daytime dress codes.

objections.q: The light-coloured collar and bow seem impractical.
objections.a: The chiffon details and collar trim are crafted from premium-grade materials. With proper professional care, the piece will retain its colour contrast and freshness for years to come.

objections.q: Concern that the bouclé will visually add bulk.
objections.a: The design features structured shoulders that balance the proportions, while the straight cut of the dress creates a slender vertical line, gracefully concealing any figure concerns.

objections.q: The contrasting bow feels too restrictive when it comes to accessorising.
objections.a: On the contrary, the lavallière bow is the centrepiece accessory of the look. We recommend completing the dress with understated earrings and a bag in a matching tone, as seen in our runway looks.

objections.q: The dress looks too warm.
objections.a: The bouclé texture provides gentle warmth and comfort during the transitional season, while remaining breathable and lightweight, allowing you to feel confident throughout the day.

84.name: Gray
84.description: An embodiment of evening luxury and neoclassical style: the elegant Gray midi dress, exquisitely crafted from precious silk velvet. The piece enchants with a deep, sculptural C-shaped dÃ©colletage and graceful short puff sleeves with high fitted cuffs. An exquisite accent of enamelled buttons lends the look couture finish, while a flawless cut underscores the grace and status of its wearer.

looks.title: Look 1 (Evening Ruby)
looks.text: A combination of the Gray 2446 dress with a shimmering Norreni 0001 0002 bracelet and Ullano A 0002 pumps. Completed with an Iglesias B 2422 0002 bag ( Data not available in official sources).

advice: Emphasize the distinctive texture of silk velvet: this material is synonymous with luxury and lends the color (Blu or Rubino) remarkable depth and a noble sheen.
Recommend the dress as the ideal choice for formal occasions (Gala, Black Tie) thanks to its combination of a tailored midi silhouette and a sensual décolletage.
Highlight the craftsmanship of the details: the enameled buttons and the puffed sleeve shape reflect the superior tailoring artistry of Luisa Spagnoli.

objections.q: A deep neckline may seem too bold.
objections.a: The 'C' neckline is designed to softly accentuate the bustline while preserving elegance and refinement. We recommend completing it with one of our necklaces to add a note of restraint.

objections.q: Velvet is a challenging material to care for.
objections.a: The Gray dress is crafted from the finest silk-and-viscose velvet, ensuring the piece's longevity when cared for through professional dry cleaning.

objections.q: Short sleeves are not entirely practical for a winter evening.
objections.a: This piece is designed for indoor formal occasions. As a complement for your evening out, we suggest our luxurious Richiesta stoles from the collection.

objections.q: A below-the-knee length may call for a certain height.
objections.a: Thanks to its fitted silhouette and emphasis at the neckline, the Gray dress visually elongates the proportions. Paired with our Ullano A heeled pumps, the look will be flawless for any figure type.

objections.q: The dress looks suitable only for evening wear.
objections.a: This is indeed a statement piece for special occasions. However, its classic midi silhouette also lends itself to cocktail events, simply by exchanging the accessories for something more understated.

88.name: Guizzante
88.description: An embodiment of absolute evening grace and couture mastery: the majestic Guizzante long dress, created for the most triumphant entrances. The sleeveless piece enchants with an exquisite bodice of the finest point d'esprit tulle (plumetis), finely adorned with embroidery and scalloped lace inserts. A deep black hue underscores the nobility of the texture, while a teardrop back neckline lends the look an aristocratic sensuality. A multi-layered skirt with a wide, flowing floor-length hem guarantees flawless dynamism with every movement.

looks.title: Look 1 (Total Black Gala)
looks.text: An impeccable evening ensemble uniting the Guizzante 0101 dress with jewelry accents — Notazione 0068 0001 0002 earrings and a shimmering Norreni 0001 0002 bracelet. The look is finished with a luxurious Ialofane 0101 0002 clutch and Unica A 0101 0002 pumps.

advice: Emphasize the distinctive point d'esprit tulle texture and the hand-embroidered detailing: this dress moves beyond mere apparel into the realm of a collectible Luisa Spagnoli masterpiece.
Recommend this piece for Black Tie or Gala dress codes, highlighting how the combination of a covered front and an open back detail creates an intriguing and statuesque look.
Showcase the client the lightness of the hem — the dress is constructed to create a 'floating walk' effect, elevating the grandeur of the moment.

objections.q: Tulle and lace seem too delicate for a long evening.
objections.a: The Guizzante piece is crafted from premium-grade materials with a densely woven structure, and the embroidery is securely fastened, guaranteeing the piece's longevity with professional care.

objections.q: The absence of sleeves may be uncomfortable in a cool room.
objections.a: This piece pairs beautifully with our fur Richiesta stoles, which add warmth and luxury to your evening look.

objections.q: A floor-length hem seems too impractical for movement.
objections.a: The cut of the dress is designed to be worn with a high heel, such as our Unica A shoes, allowing the hem to glide elegantly and create a slender vertical silhouette.

objections.q: Concern that the dress may appear too sheer.
objections.a: The piece is fully lined with an opaque under-slip, ensuring absolute comfort and impeccable propriety even under the brightest lighting.

objections.q: Black may seem too dull for a celebration.
objections.a: In this instance, black serves as a canvas for the interplay of textures: the contrast between matte tulle, textured lace, and shimmering embroidery lends the look depth and dimension.

90.name: Ialofane
90.description: The true crowning touch of an evening look from Luisa Spagnoli: the luxurious Ialofane clutch bag, a true jewel-like work of art. The piece is entirely encrusted with dazzling crystals that create an inimitable play of light. An elegant frame clasp is crowned with a majestic cabochon, underscoring the accessory's status. The interior finish includes a functional pocket with a personalized metal plaque, while a detachable chain allows this evening masterpiece to be instantly transformed into an elegant shoulder bag.

looks.title: Look 1 (Evening Sapphire)
looks.text: A combination of the Gray 1221 velvet dress with an Ialofane 1227 0002 clutch to create a monochromatic aristocratic ensemble.

looks.title: Look 2 (Modern Luxury)

advice: Draw the client's attention to the fact that the Ialofane crystals are set to couture standards, ensuring maximum sparkle and lasting durability.
Highlight the versatility: the detachable chain transforms this statement evening piece into a convenient accessory for cocktail parties, freeing the wearer's hands.
Showcase the cabochon clasp — a signature mark of Luisa Spagnoli luxury that elevates the clutch to a collectible object.

objections.q: Crystals and glass may be too fragile for everyday use.
objections.a: The use of premium tempered glass and a sturdy metal base guarantees the durability of the accessory. Each crystal undergoes rigorous quality control to ensure it is securely set.

objections.q: The bag seems too small for essential belongings.
objections.a: The Ialofane clutch is designed around what matters most: there is ample room inside for a smartphone, lipstick, and keys, while preserving an elegant silhouette.

objections.q: The crystals may damage the delicate fabric of a dress.
objections.a: Every embellishment is polished to a flawless smoothness, and the settings are recessed into the body of the bag, minimising any risk of snagging even on the finest silk.

objections.q: The accessory seems too restrictive to style.
objections.a: On the contrary, Ialofane is a true statement piece, capable of instantly elevating even the most understated look and lending it occasion-ready polish with no extra effort.

objections.q: The bag may be heavy given the abundance of embellishment.
objections.a: The weight of the accessory reflects the density of the crystals, which is precisely what gives them their noble sparkle. For comfort, a detachable chain is provided that evenly distributes the weight when worn on the shoulder.

96.name: Iroise
96.description: The elegant Iroise clutch is the quintessence of evening chic from Luisa Spagnoli. Crafted from noble textile with an exquisite matte finish, the model is distinguished by its clean design and impeccable lines. The flap is adorned with the signature gold-tone LS metal appliquÃ©, underscoring its place in the world of haute couture. Draw attention to the palette: refined tones such as Verde Pino or Champagne allow for exclusive color pairings with the collection's evening dresses.

objections.q: Textile material may be less durable than leather.
objections.a: The high-technology polyester used is exceptionally resistant to wear and has been specially engineered to preserve its flawless matte finish even with intensive use.

objections.q: The clutch seems too compact.
objections.a: The dimensions of the Iroise model have been calibrated to the millimetre to accommodate essential accessories (smartphone, lipstick, keys), while preserving an elegant profile and avoiding an overloaded silhouette.

objections.a: This is precisely where true luxury lies: the purity of the lines showcases the quality of the material, while the gold-tone LS detail provides just the right jewellery-inspired accent.

objections.q: The chain may look less formal.
objections.a: The chain is rendered in a classic style with a noble sheen. When desired, it can be tucked inside, transforming the bag into an especially refined, sleek clutch.

objections.q: It's difficult to find footwear to match such a matte material.
objections.a: The matte finish is highly versatile. It pairs harmoniously with patent leather as well as satin shoes, such as our Udita model.
