101.name: Latteria
101.description: An embodiment of romantic elegance for the everyday wardrobe: the exquisite Latteria blouse, crafted from a noble blend of cotton and silk. The model enchants with a delicate striped print and a contemporary Korean-style stand collar. The centrepiece is the layered flounces at the cuffs, lending the silhouette movement and femininity, while genuine mother-of-pearl buttons underscore the impeccable quality and couture status of the piece.

looks.title: Look 1 (Aristocratic beige)
looks.text: A combination of the Latteria 0218 blouse with the Micologia 1117 1118 jacket and the Minia 1117 1118 skirt, complemented by the Narsete 0002 necklace.

looks.title: Look 2 (Daytime luxe)
looks.text: An elegant duet of the Latteria 2417 blouse and the Fumaiolo 3417 skirt, completed by Uragano A 0986 shoes.

looks.title: Look 3 (Urban chic)
looks.text: A composition featuring the Latteria 2290 blouse, the Seduta 3417 jacket and the Ottana 3417 trousers.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the distinctive fabric composition: the blend of cotton and silk delivers exceptional softness, a refined matte sheen, and comfort throughout the day.
Showcase the striking ruffled cuffs: a ready-made styling detail that allows the Latteria blouse to become the centerpiece even of the most understated look.
Recommend the stand collar as a modern and more refined alternative to the classic collar, ideal for layered looks with the collection's jackets.

objections.q: The blouse seems too delicate given its silk content.
objections.a: The addition of premium-quality cotton (76%) makes the fabric more durable and practical to wear, while preserving all the aesthetic qualities of natural silk.

objections.q: Ruffled sleeves may be cumbersome under outerwear.
objections.a: The ruffles are crafted from a lightweight, fluid material that fits easily within the sleeves of our coats and jackets, creating a beautiful, layered accent at the wrist.

objections.q: A striped print may visually add width.
objections.a: On the contrary, the fine vertical stripe, combined with the understated cut and stand collar, visually elongates the silhouette, lending the figure a slender line.

objections.q: It's difficult to pair bottoms with such an eye-catching sleeve design.
objections.a: The Latteria blouse pairs beautifully with pencil skirts or classic trousers from our collection. We recommend styling it with the Fumaiolo piece to create a truly statement-worthy ensemble.

objections.q: Mother-of-pearl buttons require special care.
objections.a: The use of natural mother-of-pearl is a hallmark of superior quality. With proper care — whether delicate hand-washing or professional cleaning — the hardware will retain its sheen for decades.

105.name: Leonidas
105.description: An embodiment of contemporary romance and impeccable Italian style: the exquisite Leonidas blouse, crafted from a noble blend of cotton and silk. The model enchants with a delicate striped print and a refined Korean-style stand collar. The principal decorative accent is the layered cascading flounces at the cuffs, lending the silhouette a soaring dynamism and couture charm. Genuine mother-of-pearl buttons underscore the piece's exclusive status and the brand's attention to every detail.

looks.title: Look 1 (Urban chic)
looks.text: A combination of the Leonidas 3173 blouse with the plaid Serieta 3274 blazer and the Overt 0978 leather trousers. The look is complemented by the Nanterre 0002 0001 brooch and Uramaky 0990 loafers.

looks.title: Look 2 (Layering)
looks.text: An ensemble featuring the Leonidas 3173 blouse, the Merende 2234 knit cardigan and the Onega 1204 jeans under the Socio 0963 1161 reversible coat.

advice: Emphasize the composition: 24% natural silk lends the fabric a refined matte sheen and an exceptionally pleasant feel against the skin, while the cotton ensures comfort and easy care.
Showcase the client the ruffled cuffs — the ideal solution for creating a focal point in a layered look, as the ruffles peek out playfully from beneath the sleeves of a jacket or coat.
Recommend the Korean collar as a contemporary alternative to the classic style, visually elongating the neck and lending the face a fresh appearance.

objections.q: Silk content may make the blouse too demanding to care for.
objections.a: Thanks to the predominance of cotton (76%), the Leonidas fabric is more practical and resistant to wear than pure silk, while preserving a luxurious appearance.

objections.q: Ruffled sleeves may look too voluminous under a jacket.
objections.a: The ruffles are crafted from a lightweight material that drapes softly. They are designed specifically to make a stylish 'appearance' from beneath a jacket sleeve, without creating any discomfort.

objections.q: Stripes may seem too casual for a brand of this calibre.
objections.a: In this piece, the delicate graphic pattern and the distinctive 'Panna Ruggine' colourway, combined with mother-of-pearl hardware, elevate the blouse into the realm of luxury casual.

objections.q: A stand collar may not be entirely comfortable.
objections.a: The Leonidas stand collar has been calibrated to a precise height with a soft fit, ensuring freedom of movement and a contemporary, understated look without the need to tie restrictive bows.

objections.q: Light-coloured fabric may be sheer.
objections.a: The density of the cotton-and-silk weave has been carefully calibrated to achieve the noble translucency characteristic of fine fabrics, while preserving the necessary discretion of the look.

113.name: Liquorosa
113.description: The quintessence of evening allure and aristocratic femininity: the exquisite Liquorosa blouse, crafted from the finest Chantilly lace. The model captivates with generous flounces at the collar, creating a romantic and statuesque silhouette. A matte satin lining lends a delicate lingerie-inspired effect while preserving impeccable restraint. Covered buttons and sheer sleeves finished with delicate ruffles at the hem underscore the couture craftsmanship and attention to detail that define Luisa Spagnoli's Italian style.

looks.title: Look 1 (Evening luxe)
looks.text: A luxurious combination of the Liquorosa 0101 blouse with the elegant Faustin 0101 skirt, complemented by the Svista 0101 cropped cape.

looks.title: Look 3 (Formal Black Tie)
looks.text: A monochrome black set with the Liquorosa 0101 blouse, the Faustin 0101 skirt and the Udita 0101 0101 0002 sandals. Jewelry accents: the Dedicata 0101 0002 0001 belt and the Invitata D 0001 0002 bag.

looks.title: Look 2 (Aristocratic outing)
looks.text: An ensemble consisting of the Liquorosa 0101 blouse and the Faustin 0101 skirt under the Situazione 0101 cape, with the Iroise 0101 0002 clutch.

advice: Emphasize the prestige of Chantilly lace: this material embodies the finest tailoring artistry and lends the look a timeless elegance.
Recommend Liquorosa as an ideal piece for building layered looks: the collar's full ruffles emerge strikingly from beneath the lapels of a tailored jacket or a cashmere coat.
Highlight the functionality of the design: the satin lining resolves any concern over sheerness, making the blouse suitable for even the most formal evening occasions.

objections.q: The lace top seems too sheer and bold.
objections.a: The designers incorporated a built-in lining of dense matte satin that fully conceals undergarments and provides confidence, while preserving the airiness of the lace.

objections.q: Chantilly lace looks too delicate for frequent wear.
objections.a: The high-technology polyamide-based fabric used offers superior durability and shape retention, all while remaining remarkably soft to the touch.

objections.q: Concern that the ruffles at the neck may be cumbersome under outerwear.
objections.a: Liquorosa lace has exceptional flexibility. The ruffles sit easily beneath a jacket or coat, becoming a refined decorative element that frames the face.

objections.q: Such a blouse seems suitable only for the most formal occasions.
objections.a: Thanks to its understated black colour and versatility when paired with classic trousers, this piece can become a luxurious accent within an evening business wardrobe.

objections.q: Caring for such a piece seems overly complex.
objections.a: Professional dry cleaning will preserve the delicate structure of the lace and the sheen of the satin trim in pristine condition for years to come.

125.name: Lucentezza
125.description: An exquisite lingerie-inspired top, inspired by boudoir-chic aesthetics and impeccable femininity. The model is crafted from a noble silk blend that lends the skin a cooling sensation and soft sheen. Delicate insertions of sculpted (smerlato) lace along the neckline and a graceful bow at the centre create a romantic accent, while adjustable slender straps guarantee a perfect fit, accentuating the fragility and grace of the silhouette.

looks.title: Look 2 (Modern luxury)
looks.text: A minimalist combination of the Lucentezza 0101 top with the Offida 0101 trousers and the shimmering Invitata D 0001 0001 clutch. Jewelry accent — Notazione 0068 0001 0002 earrings ( Data not available in official sources).

looks.title: Look 1 (Evening Black Tie)
looks.text: A dramatic ensemble combining the Lucentezza 0101 top with the velvet Offida 0101 trousers under the luxurious Situazione 0101 cape. The look is completed by the Udita 0101 0101 0002 sandals and the Notazione 0068 0001 0002 necklace (

advice: Emphasize the layering potential: this top is ideal for creating contrasting looks beneath tailored jackets or voluminous cardigans, adding a note of sensuality to the professional wardrobe.
Showcase the client the quality of the materials: the blend of viscose and silk ensures durability and easy care while preserving a premium appearance.
Draw attention to the adjustable straps — allowing the depth of the neckline to be tailored to the occasion and the client's preference.

objections.q: The top too closely resembles lingerie.
objections.a: This reflects the current 'underwear as outerwear' trend. Paired with classic trousers or a structured blazer, the Lucentezza piece reads as a refined evening element rather than an item of lingerie.

objections.q: Silk content may be impractical.
objections.a: Thanks to the predominance of viscose (79%) in the composition, the fabric is more resistant to creasing and wear than pure silk, while retaining a noble texture.

objections.q: The lace trim looks delicate.
objections.a: The lace used is crafted using Luisa Spagnoli's contemporary techniques with a reinforced edge, guaranteeing the pattern retains its shape and integrity with proper care.

objections.q: The top seems too revealing for daytime occasions.
objections.a: We recommend wearing it beneath a lightweight coat or jacket. This creates a statement look in which the lace serves merely as a delicate accent.

objections.q: Concern that thin straps may dig into the shoulders.
objections.a: The straps are crafted from soft silk satin and feature adjusters, allowing the weight to be distributed and the length fine-tuned for maximum comfort on any figure.

128.name: Lunotto
128.description: An impeccable interpretation of daytime elegance: the Lunotto blouse, masterfully crafted from silk satin with an exquisite print. The fluidity of the lines and the noble matte sheen of the fabric underscore the piece's status. A classic collar and refined genuine mother-of-pearl buttons complete the look, making it the ideal choice for the modern woman who values luxury in the details.

looks.title: Look 1 (Total Look)
looks.text: A combination of the Lunotto 3418 blouse with the Salve A 1789 jacket and the Odini 1789 trousers. Complemented by Ulisside 2240 0038 boots, the Neanide 0002 earrings and the Nolanite A 0002 brooch.

looks.title: Look 2 (Urban chic)
looks.text: A layered ensemble consisting of the Lunotto 3418 blouse, the Merende 1736 cardigan and the Olap 1119 trousers under the Scrittoio 1729 0992 jacket.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the distinctive composition: the blend of natural silk and viscose (34%/66%) guarantees the material's noble sheen and exceptional durability.
Showcase the genuine mother-of-pearl buttons — this hand-finished detail underscores the authenticity of Luisa Spagnoli's Italian tailoring artistry.
Recommend Lunotto as a versatile wardrobe staple: thanks to its fluid drape, it sits beautifully beneath structured jackets without adding unwanted volume.

objections.q: The print seems too bold for a business wardrobe.
objections.a: In the Lunotto piece, the print is rendered in an aristocratic colour palette, allowing it to fit harmoniously into a business context when paired with the structured Salve A jacket.

objections.q: Silk fabric requires demanding professional care.
objections.a: The addition of viscose to the composition makes the fabric more practical and resistant to creasing, while preserving all the aesthetic qualities of natural silk.

objections.q: Mother-of-pearl buttons look fragile.
objections.a: The use of natural mother-of-pearl is a marker of superior quality. The buttons are securely fastened to the brand's couture standards.

objections.q: The blouse may look too loose.
objections.a: The regular fit is designed to ensure comfort and freedom of movement, while the fluidity of the material elegantly accentuates the silhouette.

objections.q: It's difficult to find footwear to match such a bold pattern.
objections.a: Our stylists recommend pairing this piece with understated leather Ulisside boots in neutral tones to balance the look.

131.name: Mabels
131.description: The elegant Mabels pullover is the embodiment of refined comfort and contemporary Italian style. The model is crafted from dense, high-quality 100% virgin wool using the "punto stoffa" technique, guaranteeing impeccable shape retention and a noble texture. A high turtleneck and classic ribbed pattern lend the look an aristocratic air, while a distinctive detail »” open slits at the sleeves, embellished with signature gold-tone LS buttons »” imparts runway chic and allows for the perfect placement of jewellery accents.

looks.title: Look 1 (Intellectual blue)
looks.text: The Mabels 1270 pullover combined with wide-leg Ontani 1262 trousers and Urbana 0981 leather ankle boots. The ensemble is completed by the Nolanite A 0002 brooch and the Nagorno 0002 earrings.

looks.title: Look 2 (Noble bordeaux)
looks.text: The Mabels 2435 pullover with Modine B 2435 trousers ( URL data not available in official sources) and sophisticated Ustica A 2450 boots. The highlight of the look is the Nuevitas 0002 0001 necklace.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the distinctive sleeve construction with gold buttons — a ready-made styling embellishment that underscores the piece's status.
Highlight the thermoregulating properties of 100% virgin wool: the dense knit provides warmth without excess bulk, while preserving an impeccable fit to the figure.
Recommend Mabels as the ideal foundational piece for building layered outfits with our parkas, such as the Strumento.

objections.q: Wool may cause prickling or discomfort.
objections.a: Mabels is crafted exclusively from the finest virgin wool (Vergine), prized for its exceptional softness. It rests gently against the skin, offering a sense of complete comfort throughout the day.

objections.q: Slits on the sleeves may be impractical in cold weather.
objections.a: This is a decorative, high-fashion detail. Paired with outerwear, the slits create striking layering, allowing cuffs or wrist jewellery to become a stylish accent.

objections.q: Gold-tone buttons may tarnish over time.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli hardware is crafted to the highest standards using a durable coating. With proper care, the gold-tone shine of the LS-logo buttons will delight you for many seasons to come.

objections.q: The pullover seems too simple for its price.
objections.a: This is an example of 'quiet luxury.' The value of Mabels lies in the impeccable quality of its material (100% wool) and the jewellery-like precision of its details, making it a timeless investment piece.

objections.q: A ribbed knit may visually add volume.
objections.a: The vertical orientation of the pattern and the regular fit visually elongate the silhouette, lending the figure a slender, graceful line.

133.name: Macaria
133.description: An impeccable embodiment of "quiet luxury" aesthetics and Italian knitwear mastery: the elegant Macaria polo, crafted from 100% high-quality virgin wool (Merinfleur). The model enchants with its understated simplicity, complemented by status-defining details »” flat gold-tone buttons that lend the look a jewel-like gleam. Long sleeves with elegant slits at the cuffs underscore the piece's contemporary character, while the classic Regular fit guarantees perfect comfort and a noble fit.

looks.title: Look 1 (Urban Luxe)
looks.text: A combination of the Macaria 0970 polo with a Scanio 2219 0908 leather jacket and Overt 0101 nappa leather trousers. The ensemble is completed by an Ls1928gp 0101 0038 bag and a Renno 0930 cap.

looks.title: Look 2 (Modern Classic)
looks.text: An elegant duo of a Macaria 0101 polo and a Sarmoneta 2445 leather jacket. The look is completed by Ornago 2422 corduroy trousers, an Iago 0101 0002 bag and a Rotterdam 2439 cap.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the Merinfleur material: 100% pure virgin wool delivers not only exceptional warmth but also a remarkable softness comparable to cashmere.
Showcase the jewel-like finishing — the gold buttons and cuff slits allow the Macaria polo to stand as a self-sufficient statement piece that transitions effortlessly from day to evening.
Recommend this piece as a key layering element: thanks to its texture, the polo sits beautifully beneath our signature jackets and coats without adding unwanted volume.

objections.q: Wool may cause skin irritation.
objections.a: For the Merinfleur line, we use only the most delicate, premium-quality virgin wool, prized for being hypoallergenic and silky to the touch, ensuring comfort even for the most sensitive skin.

objections.q: The polo looks too casual for attending an event.
objections.a: Thanks to its gold-tone hardware and distinctive cuff design, the Macaria piece is a study in 'intelligent fashion.' Paired with a silk scarf or our Ialofane bag, the look becomes truly occasion-ready.

objections.q: I'm concerned the knitwear will lose its shape after washing.
objections.a: The use of a dense-knit technique and premium-quality yarn allows the piece to retain its structure. We recommend professional dry cleaning so that Macaria continues to delight you for many seasons.

objections.q: Gold-tone buttons may tarnish over time.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli hardware undergoes rigorous quality control and features a special protective coating that preserves its original shine and resists external wear.

objections.q: What can such a rich Bordeaux shade be paired with?
objections.a: This shade is a brand classic, pairing beautifully with a neutral palette (grey, beige) or creating a luxurious monochrome look with our Ornago corduroy trousers.

134.name: Madelin
134.description: The epitome of refinement and contemporary knitwear artistry: the Madelin midi dress, masterfully crafted from 100% Merinfleur merino wool. The dense "punto stoffa" knit technique ensures an impeccably fitted silhouette and lasting shape retention. A clean boat neckline accentuates the grace of the shoulder line, while long sleeves adorned with openwork lace insertions and high, close-fitting cuffs lend the model couture charm, transforming it into a versatile masterpiece for both day and evening occasions.

looks.title: Look 1 (Intellectual Beige)
looks.text: A combination of the Madelin 1163 1122 dress with a status Ls1928gp 1158 0038 bag or a minimalist Ls1928p 0221 0038 model for creating an impeccable daytime ensemble.

looks.title: Look 2 (Graphic Black)
looks.text: Madelin 0101 0101 dress paired with a delicate Mantisia 0101 0101 silk scarf and an Ls1928p 0101 0038 bag.

looks.title: Look 3 (Evening Out)
looks.text: A dramatic ensemble consisting of a Madelin 0101 0101 dress, exquisite Udita 0101 0101 0002 sandals and an Iroise 0101 0002 clutch. Jewelry accents: Notazione 0068 0001 0002 earrings and a Noematica 0101 0001 0002 brooch.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the quality of Merinfleur wool: 100% pure wool delivers the softness and comfortable thermal exchange characteristic of premium knitwear.
Showcase the lace inserts on the sleeves — this detail lends the look a festive air and makes the dress an ideal choice for cocktail events.
Recommend the fitted cut as a tool for creating a feminine, confident silhouette that underscores the wearer's status.

objections.q: A fitted silhouette may accentuate figure concerns.
objections.a: The dense 'punto stoffa' knit offers a gentle shaping effect, softly supporting the silhouette. We also suggest completing the look with one of our structured jackets for added confidence.

objections.q: Wool may be scratchy or cause discomfort.
objections.a: The Madelin piece uses the finest merino wool with an exceptionally fine fibre, making it remarkably smooth and pleasant even for the most sensitive skin.

objections.q: Lace on the sleeves looks too formal for daytime wear.
objections.a: Thanks to the matte texture of the wool, the lace serves as a delicate accent. Paired with our Ulisside boots, the look becomes understated and stylish.

objections.q: A below-the-knee length may visually shorten the frame.
objections.a: The classic midi length, paired with the boat neckline, in fact elongates the vertical line. We recommend heeled footwear, such as our Udita model, for perfect proportions.

objections.q: Knitwear may stretch out with wear.
objections.a: The distinctive feature of Luisa Spagnoli's 'punto stoffa' technique is the enhanced density and stability of the fabric, which guarantees the dress retains its original shape for many seasons.

136.name: Maestosita
136.description: The majestic Maestosita pullover is a triumph of Luisa Spagnoli's fine knitwear artistry. Crafted from the exclusive 100% virgin wool Merinfleur line, it combines a noble ribbed texture with couture embellishment. The highlight of the model is a delicately wrought floral motif, laid out in shimmering sequins upon a fine lace insertion. Raglan sleeves with open cuffs lend the silhouette a soaring lightness, while a stand ("lupetto") collar completes the aristocratic, status-defining look.

looks.title: Look 1 (Intellectual Grey)
looks.text: A combination of a Maestosita 0802 0863 pullover with an elegant Ferriera 0813 skirt and minimalist Uranio A 0101 shoes.

looks.title: Look 2 (Aristocratic Cream)
looks.text: An ensemble featuring a Maestosita 0202 0202 pullover and Olap 0214 trousers, completed by Norico 0202 0001 0002 earrings, an Ls1928p A 0221 0038 bag and Uranio A 2233 footwear.

advice: Highlight the distinctiveness of the Merinfleur material: 100% pure virgin wool of the highest quality, offering the softness of cashmere alongside impeccable thermoregulation.
Draw the client's attention to the handcrafted detailing: the sequin embroidery over lace is a Haute Couture-level touch that makes the Maestosita pullover a collectible piece.
Recommend the piece as the foundation for layered looks: the stand collar and textured knit pair beautifully with the collection's classic jackets and cashmere coats.

objections.q: Sequins may shed or catch on other garments.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli pieces employ a reinforced fixing technique on a lace base. With proper care, the sequins will retain their sparkle and placement for years to come.

objections.q: Wool may cause skin irritation.
objections.a: Merinfleur wool is prized for the exceptional softness of its fibres. It is hypoallergenic and pleasant to the touch, ensuring comfort even when worn directly against the skin for extended periods.

objections.q: Slits on the sleeves seem impractical for winter.
objections.a: This is a refined styling detail that allows wrist jewellery or a blouse cuff to be showcased. The pullover remains warm thanks to its dense knit, which compensates for the open detailing.

objections.q: The pullover looks too dressy for everyday wear.
objections.a: On the contrary, paired with denim or our Olap corduroy trousers, the shimmer of the sequins becomes a refined accent in a luxury-casual style.

objections.q: Caring for a combined material (wool and lace) seems complex.
objections.a: We recommend professional dry cleaning. This is an investment in the piece's longevity, preserving the structure of the 100% wool and the delicacy of the embroidery in pristine condition.

137.name: Maggiolone
137.description: The exquisite Maggiolone blouse from the exclusive Merinfleur line is the quintessence of aristocratic minimalism and impeccable Italian knitwear artistry. The model is masterfully crafted from 100% pure virgin wool, offering a noble texture and ideal thermoregulation. A deep V-neckline is complemented by the signature lavalliÃ¨re collar, allowing the styling to range from strictly business to refined romantic. Slightly gathered shoulders lend the silhouette a soaring lightness and contemporary character, making Maggiolone an indispensable masterpiece for the daytime wardrobe.

looks.title: Look 1 (Deep Amethyst)
looks.text: A monochromatic composition featuring a Maggiolone 0759 pullover and classic Ostiolo 0733 trousers. The look is completed by a status Necessario 0101 0002 bracelet, a Dogale A 0101 0002 belt and Nordici 0068 0002 earrings.

looks.title: Look 2 (Contrast Classic)
looks.text: A Maggiolone 0202 0101 pullover paired with a minimalist Florina 0101 skirt. Accents: Neanide 0002 earrings, a Necessario 0101 0002 bracelet and a Dedizione 0002 necklace.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the lavaliere collar: a ready-made styling solution that removes the need for additional accessories and allows the character of the look to shift with a single gesture.
Highlight the exclusivity of the Merinfleur material — the use of 100% pure virgin wool guarantees a remarkable softness and comfort comparable to cashmere.
Recommend Maggiolone as the ideal foundational layering piece: thanks to its smooth knit, the blouse sits beautifully beneath structured jackets and coats without adding unwanted volume.

objections.q: Wool may cause skin irritation.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli pieces use the finest Vergine wool with exceptionally fine fibres, making it hypoallergenic and silky to the touch.

objections.q: The bow collar seems too complicated for everyday wear.
objections.a: On the contrary, the collar ties are crafted from a flexible knit that holds its knot beautifully and requires no adjustment throughout the day.

objections.q: The V-neckline looks too revealing.
objections.a: The lavallière collar design allows the depth of the neckline to be adjusted: the ties can be fastened higher for a more formal look, or left loose for an evening out.

objections.q: Gathered shoulders may visually widen the upper body.
objections.a: The delicate gathering at the shoulders of the Maggiolone piece is designed to create a soft vertical line that, in fact, harmonises the proportions and lends the posture an aristocratic bearing.

objections.q: It's difficult to find footwear to match such an unusual knitwear silhouette.
objections.a: This piece is remarkably versatile. It pairs flawlessly with our classic Uramaky loafers for the office, as well as with statement Ulisside boots for a day in the city.

138.name: Magnesite
138.description: The elegant, contemporary Magnesite pullover from the exclusive Merinfleur line is the embodiment of refined comfort and Italian craftsmanship. The model is crafted using the dense "punto stoffa" knit technique from high-quality 100% virgin wool, ensuring impeccable shape retention and a noble texture. A high turtleneck lends the look an aristocratic air, while functional side slits and flat-ribbed edge finishing underscore the piece's contemporary character. The signature round gold-tone LS logo appliquÃ© serves as a jewel-like accent, completing this status-defining piece for the daytime wardrobe.

looks.title: Look 1 (Urban Luxe)
looks.text: A combination of a Magnesite 3568 pullover with a Spareggio 0996 leather bomber and a Fidente 0996 leather skirt.

looks.title: Look 2 (Refined Layering)
looks.text: An ensemble featuring a Magnesite 3568 pullover under a Squadratura 0101 0988 denim jacket paired with Overt 0978 leather trousers.

looks.title: Look 3 (Intellectual Casual)
looks.text: A Magnesite 3423 pullover with wide-leg Olla 1248 jeans and Uramaky 0990 loafers, completed by Nagorno 0002 earrings.

advice: Emphasize the distinctive quality of virgin wool (Vergine): the material is remarkably soft and lightweight, while offering exceptional insulating properties.
Showcase the gold LS appliqué — this detail elevates the essential pullover into the realm of premium pieces, removing the need for additional adornment.
Recommend the piece as the ideal foundation for layered looks: the side slits allow the pullover to drape beautifully over trousers or skirts without adding bulk beneath outerwear.

objections.q: Wool may be scratchy or cause irritation.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli pieces use only select, highly refined virgin wool. It is hypoallergenic and has a silky texture, ensuring comfort even in contact with sensitive skin.

objections.q: A high collar may feel too tight.
objections.a: The turtleneck collar of the Magnesite piece is crafted in an elastic knit that gently hugs the neck, providing warmth without any sense of constriction.

objections.q: Side slits may look careless.
objections.a: On the contrary, the slits are designed to enhance the fit to the figure and ensure freedom of movement. This is a contemporary design detail that lends the silhouette dynamism.

objections.q: A light shade (Celeste Polvere) may be impractical.
objections.a: This noble dusty-blue shade is one of the most on-trend colours of the season. Thanks to the quality of the wool, the piece cleans easily with professional care and retains its original vibrancy for a long time.

objections.q: The pullover looks too simple for its price.
objections.a: The true value of Magnesite lies in the impeccable quality of the Merinfleur material and the 'punto stoffa' knitting technique. This is an investment in a lasting wardrobe staple that will never go out of style.

140.name: Maizena
140.description: The elegant Maizena sheath mini dress is the embodiment of refined minimalism and Luisa Spagnoli's impeccable Italian craftsmanship. The model is masterfully crafted from 100% pure virgin wool using the exclusive dense "punto stoffa" knit technique, guaranteeing an impeccable silhouette and exceptional durability. The clean sleeveless cut accentuates the grace and delicacy of the feminine figure, making this dress the perfect foundation for creating status-defining, layered looks in the "quiet luxury" aesthetic.

looks.title: Look 1 (Runway Style)
looks.text: A luxurious layered ensemble combining a Maizena 0101 dress with a textured Mantes 3390 jacket under an elegant Stenografo 0101 wool coat. The look is finished with a status bag in hammered leather, the Iago 0101 0002.

advice: Emphasize the distinctive composition: 100% pure virgin wool (Vergine) delivers remarkable softness and ideal thermoregulation throughout the day.
Showcase the client the advantages of the 'punto stoffa' knit — a highly technical knitted fabric with a shaping effect that preserves the garment's original form even with frequent wear.

Recommend the Maizena dress as an ideal 'investment' wardrobe piece: thanks to its understated design, it transitions effortlessly from a professional look to an evening ensemble through a change of accessories and the addition of the collection's statement jackets.

objections.q: Wool may cause tingling or skin irritation.
objections.a: For the Merinfleur line, we use only the most delicate, highly refined virgin wool. It is hypoallergenic and has a silky texture comparable in softness to cashmere.

objections.q: The length seems too short for serious meetings.
objections.a: This is a classic Italian length that, paired with dense matte tights and a structured jacket, looks aristocratic and fully in keeping with business etiquette.

objections.q: The absence of sleeves limits the piece's seasonality.
objections.a: On the contrary, this is the ideal foundation for layering. The Maizena dress pairs beautifully with our silk blouses or fine turtlenecks, allowing for stylish ensembles in any season.

objections.q: Black looks too plain.
objections.a: Black in this piece serves as a flawless canvas. It showcases the quality of the knit and allows the focus to fall on our signature jewellery, such as the Narsete necklace or the Nolanite brooch.

141.name: Malvia
141.description: An embodiment of aristocratic comfort and impeccable Italian taste: the elongated Malvia cardigan, created from 100% purest virgin wool. The model enchants with the graphic quality of its contrasting trim, which accentuates the architectural precision of the cut and the elegance of its lines. Signature buttons bearing the LS heraldic emblem lend the look a note of noble heritage, while functional patch pockets with flaps harmoniously combine practicality and high aesthetics, making this piece the ideal choice for creating layered ensembles in the "quiet luxury" style.

looks.title: Look 1 (Classic Contrast)
looks.text: A harmonious combination of a long Malvia 0101 2246 cardigan with a Mantecare 0101 2246 turtleneck and a Marsica 0101 skirt (Data not available in official sources). The look is completed by a status Iago 2240 0002 bag.

Highlight the prestige of the hardware: the heraldic LS buttons are a symbol of belonging to the exclusive world of Italian high fashion and stand in for jewelry.
Recommend Malvia as a versatile alternative to a light coat or jacket: the length and density of the knit allow the piece to be worn as a standalone outerwear item during the transitional seasons.

objections.q: Wool pieces may quickly lose their shape.
objections.a: The use of premium-quality virgin wool and a dense knit guarantees that the Malvia cardigan will retain its structure and impeccable fit for many seasons.

objections.q: Contrasting trim may seem too bold for a business wardrobe.
objections.a: On the contrary, the graphic lines of the trim accentuate the precision of the silhouette, transforming classic knitwear into a structured, statement-worthy element of business dressing.

objections.q: Pure wool requires overly demanding care.
objections.a: Thanks to the high quality of the fibre's finishing, the piece is less prone to pilling. We recommend professional dry cleaning, which is an investment in the longevity of your luxury wardrobe.

objections.q: A long cardigan may visually shorten the frame.
objections.a: The vertical contrasting bands along the front edges and the elongated cut of the Malvia piece create an unbroken line that, on the contrary, visually elongates the silhouette and slims the figure.

objections.q: The piece seems too lightweight for the cold season.
objections.a: Virgin wool has unique thermal-insulation properties. The Malvia cardigan is ideal for layered looks, offering comfort both indoors and outdoors.

144.name: Mancante
144.description: The aristocratic Mancante midi dress from the exclusive Merinfleur line is a harmony of bold animal print and impeccable Italian tailoring. Crafted from a noble wool jacquard, the model enchants with a soft, high contrasting collar that lends the look graphic quality and contemporary chic. The fitted silhouette and delicate below-the-knee length accentuate femininity and status, making this piece the perfect masterpiece for creating a refined daytime look with strong character.

objections.a: The high virgin-wool content and the distinctive jacquard-weave structure guarantee excellent durability and preserve the dress's original shape for many seasons.

146.name: Manografo
146.description: The embodiment of intellectual style and impeccable Italian craftsmanship: the elegant Manografo turtleneck from the exclusive Merinfleur line. 148.name: Mantecare
148.description: An impeccable embodiment of aristocratic minimalism and Italian craftsmanship: the sleeveless Mantecare turtleneck top from the exclusive Merinfleur line. 149.name: Mantes
149.description: An embodiment of aristocratic comfort and impeccable Italian style: the long, deconstructed Mantes cardigan from the exclusive Merinfleur line. The model is masterfully crafted from a noble blend of 71% virgin wool and 12% delicate mohair, lending exceptional softness and warmth. A bold animal print, reinterpreted by Luisa Spagnoli, achieves a status-defining restraint through the exquisite Var Maculato Marrone colourway. An integrated belt allows the waist to be accentuated, creating a feminine silhouette, while patch pockets with clean, solid-toned profiles underscore the couture attention to detail.

The edges of the accessory are adorned with delicately wrought scalloped (smerlato) floral lace trim, lending the look a note of aristocratic romanticism. The model is masterfully crafted from a noble blend of 70% virgin wool and high-tech fibres using the "punto stoffa" dense knit technique. The principal decorative accent is the luxurious long fringe along the hem, which lends the look runway chic and soaring lightness with every movement. The classic high collar and long sleeves harmoniously balance the avant-garde detail, making this piece the ideal choice for creating status-defining, layered ensembles.

looks.title: Look 1 (Runway Contrast)
looks.text: A combination of the Matri 0101 turtleneck with the Marsan 0101 skirt under a Scansione 0961 coat. The ensemble is complemented by the Limana 3411 shirt and Iago 2240 0002 bag.

looks.text: An elegant composition featuring the Matri 0202 turtleneck, Mira 0202 cape and Marsan 0202 skirt. The look is finished with the Importante 0986 0002 bag (Data not available in official sources).

looks.title: Look 3 (Urban Luxe)
looks.text: Matri 0101 turtleneck combined with the Marsan 0101 skirt and Idilliaco A 0101 0002 bag.

advice: Highlight the exceptional composition: a high content of virgin wool (70%) guarantees outstanding softness and comfortable thermal regulation.
Present the fringe as a high-fashion element: this ready-made styling statement turns the knitwear piece into the architectural focal point of the outfit.
Recommend Maurilia as the ideal investment for a layered wardrobe: thanks to its relaxed cut, the cardigan drapes beautifully over our signature dresses and blouses without restricting movement.

objections.q: Fringe may look too informal.
objections.a: On the Matri piece, the fringe is crafted from a noble wool yarn matched to the garment, transforming it from a boho-style element into a high-fashion detail, entirely fitting for an evening or statement daytime wardrobe.

objections.q: Wool may cause skin irritation.
objections.a: For the Merinfleur line, we use only the most delicate, highly refined virgin wool (Lana Vergine). It is hypoallergenic and has a silky texture comparable in softness to cashmere.

objections.q: The composition includes acrylic (30%).
objections.a: The addition of premium-quality acrylic is essential to achieving the dense-knit technique and ensuring the stability of the fringe. This guarantees the piece will not deform or lose its lustre, even with professional care.

objections.q: I'm concerned the fringe may tangle or lose its appearance.
objections.a: The fringe on Luisa Spagnoli pieces is crafted to couture standards with a reinforced base. We recommend professional dry cleaning, which preserves the crisp definition of every strand.

objections.q: How should this piece be styled with such a striking hemline?
objections.a: Our stylists recommend pairing it with understated straight-cut skirts (such as Marsan) or classic trousers, allowing the fringe to serve as the silhouette's principal architectural accent.

160.name: Maurilia
160.description: Aristocratic comfort in a contemporary interpretation: the Maurilia cardigan from the exclusive Merinfleur line. The model is masterfully crafted using a voluminous "chunky rib" knit technique from a noble blend of virgin wool and high-tech fibres, guaranteeing a sculptural silhouette and impeccable shape retention. The principal couture accent is the shawl collar, accentuated by luxurious long fringe that lends the look runway dynamism. The relaxed Oversize cut and absence of fastenings make this piece the perfect embodiment of the "quiet luxury" aesthetic.

looks.title: Look 1 (Aristocratic Cream)
looks.text: Maurilia 0202 cardigan combined with the Manos 0204 pullover and Osten 0101 trousers, complemented by the Medoro 0202 cap.

looks.title: Look 2 (Urban Chic in Camel Tones)
looks.text: An elegant ensemble featuring the Maurilia 2246 cardigan, complemented by the Manos 2246 turtleneck and Olap 0214 trousers.

looks.title: Look 3 (Tonal Luxury in Menta Color)
looks.text: A tandem of the Maurilia 0506 cardigan and Manografo 0506 turtleneck combined with Opaglio 0927 trousers and Iago 2240 0002 bag.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the exceptional quality of the Merinfleur line's virgin wool (Lana Vergine): it delivers the outstanding softness and comfort characteristic of the finest knitwear.
Showcase the heraldic LS buttons — this runway-inspired signature of Luisa Spagnoli elevates the status of the piece and removes the need for additional jewellery.
Recommend Meduna as the ideal choice for layered dressing: the dense 'punto stretto' knit allows the dress to sit flawlessly beneath our fitted coats and jackets without adding bulk.

objections.q: Fringe may look too informal for a business context.
objections.a: On Luisa Spagnoli pieces, the fringe is crafted from a noble yarn matched to the garment, transforming it from a boho-style detail into a couture element, entirely fitting for a statement daytime wardrobe.

objections.q: An oversize cut may visually add volume to the figure.
objections.a: The vertical texture of the ribbed knit and the elongated lines of the shawl collar create a strong vertical line that, on the contrary, visually elongates the silhouette and lends the posture an aristocratic bearing.

objections.q: The absence of fastenings makes the piece less practical in cold weather.
objections.a: This design highlights an effortless elegance. We recommend completing the cardigan with one of our leather belts from the collection to define the waist and achieve a closer fit.

objections.q: The composition includes acrylic (30%).
objections.a: The addition of a high-technology fibre is essential to achieving the dense, textured-knit technique. This guarantees the piece retains its sculpted volume and resists deformation over time.

objections.q: Wool may cause tingling in contact with the skin.
objections.a: The Merinfleur line uses only the most delicate, highly refined virgin wool, prized for being hypoallergenic and silky to the touch.

162.name: Meduna
162.description: The exquisite Meduna midi dress is the embodiment of aristocratic elegance and Luisa Spagnoli's impeccable Italian craftsmanship. The model is crafted from the finest 100% pure virgin wool using the "punto stretto" dense knit technique, guaranteeing perfect shape retention and a sculptural silhouette. A refined boat neckline accentuates the grace of the shoulder line, while 3/4-length kimono sleeves and signature LS heraldic buttons lend the dress a status-defining, timeless character. The classic below-the-knee length and Regular fit transform this piece into an investment masterpiece for the daytime wardrobe.

looks.title: Look 2 (Urban Chic)
looks.text: Meduna 2544 dress paired with the edgy Scalare 0101 jacket and Ippolita 0101 0002 bag (URL data not available in official sources).

advice: Draw the client's attention to the distinctive volcano collar: beyond providing warmth, this detail creates a striking vertical line, visually elongating the neck and elevating the overall look.

Showcase the intricate textured knit: the central interlaced pattern speaks to the exceptional craftsmanship of Luisa Spagnoli's Italian artisans, making the Meleti pullover a statement piece in its own right.

Recommend this piece as the perfect base for layering in a 'quiet luxury' aesthetic: with its dropped shoulder and regular fit, the pullover sits impeccably beneath our signature car coats and coats from the collection.

objections.q: The dress seems too simple for its price.
objections.a: The true luxury of the Meduna piece lies in the 'punto stretto' technique and its 100% natural composition. This is an example of 'quiet luxury' that will remain relevant and impeccable for decades to come.

objections.q: Wool may cause tingling or skin irritation.
objections.a: This collection uses only select, highly refined virgin wool. It has a silky texture and is hypoallergenic, ensuring absolute comfort.

objections.q: 3/4-length sleeves may be impractical for the winter season.
objections.a: This sleeve length is a refined styling detail, allowing statement bracelets or long gloves to be showcased, lending the look runway-inspired polish.

objections.q: A knit dress may quickly lose its shape.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli's special dense-knit technology prevents deformation of the piece. The dress reliably holds its structure and does not stretch out with wear.

objections.q: It's difficult to find footwear to match this style.
objections.a: Thanks to its classic silhouette, Meduna is highly versatile: it pairs beautifully with statement Ulisside boots as well as with elegant Uragano pumps.

164.name: Meleti
164.description: The embodiment of intellectual knitwear style and impeccable Italian comfort: the Meleti pullover from the exclusive Merinfleur line. The model enchants with its architectural simplicity, where the central accent is a noble volcano collar and a delicately wrought textured knit with a central braided motif. A dropped shoulder line lends the silhouette a contemporary ease, while the high-quality virgin wool blend guarantees a soft touch and impeccable thermoregulation, making this piece a true masterpiece for the cold season.

looks.title: Look 1 (Sky Azure)
looks.text: A combination of the Meleti 0620 pullover with Sigilli 1294 0235 trousers and Olla 1248 jeans. The ensemble is complemented by the Leila 0201 classic shirt and Renno 0930 cap.

looks.text: An elegant duo of the Meleti 0970 pullover and Odrisi 3274 trousers. The look is finished with Uramaky 0990 loafers, Navigero 0002 bracelet and Leila 0201 classic shirt.

looks.title: Look 3 (Urban Layering)
looks.text: A tandem of the Meleti 0970 pullover worn under a Scanio 2219 0908 jacket paired with Olivetano 0943 trousers and Lucinda 0201 shirt.

advice: Highlight the fabric: 100% pure virgin wool (lana vergine) guarantees warmth without weight, a key criterion for discerning clients.
The heraldic LS buttons are a symbol of belonging to an elite fashion house, serving as a powerful visual selling point.
Versatility: show the client how the open cuff allows blouse or shirt sleeves to peek through, creating a stylish layered look.

objections.q: The composition includes acrylic (30%).
objections.a: The addition of a high-technology fibre is essential to preserving the stability and volume of such an intricate textured knit. This guarantees the piece retains its shape and pristine appearance even after repeated cleaning.

objections.q: Wool may cause discomfort or tingling.
objections.a: For the Merinfleur line, we use only select, highly refined virgin wool. It is hypoallergenic and has a silky texture, ensuring exceptional softness in contact with the skin.

objections.q: The pullover looks too voluminous.
objections.a: The Meleti design is engineered to accentuate the delicacy of the female figure through a play of volumes. The dropped shoulder and ribbed knit create a harmonious silhouette that never weighs the look down.

objections.q: The funnel-neck collar may be uncomfortable when worn with outerwear.
objections.a: On the contrary, the softness of the knit allows the collar to drape delicately beneath a coat's lapels or a jacket's collar, providing additional comfort and warmth without the need for a scarf.

objections.q: How should such an intricate knit be cared for?
objections.a: We recommend professional dry cleaning. This is an investment in the longevity of your wardrobe, preserving the knit structure and the unique softness of the 100% Merinfleur wool.

169.name: Merina
169.description: An exquisite textured cardigan embodying Luisa Spagnoli's philosophy of "quiet luxury." The model is crafted from 100% pure natural wool of the highest quality, ensuring exceptional comfort and longevity. Particular attention has been paid to detail: signature LS heraldic buttons add an aristocratic accent to the piece, while patch pockets and open sleeve hems lend the look contemporary dynamism. The Regular fit underscores the impeccable cut, suited to every figure type.

looks.title: Total Look (Vetrina 88)

advice: Emphasise the composition: 100% merino wool guarantees superior thermal regulation and softness, both essential qualities for premium knitwear.
Draw attention to the cut: the circle skirt (gonna a ruota), paired with a stand collar, strikes a balance between structure and romance, flattering the figure while accentuating the waist.
Styling versatility: the dress is equally suited to a business office dress code and an elegant evening occasion, simply by adding leather or silk accessories.

objections.q: The button design is too classic.
objections.a: Explain that heraldry is a current 'heritage' trend that lends the look a sense of status. Suggest styling the piece with bolder trousers, such as leather or denim, to create balance.

objections.q: Wool may feel scratchy.
objections.a: Clarify that the piece uses premium-quality 'lana vergine' with a special textured treatment that minimises discomfort and ensures softness.

objections.q: Uncomfortable open sleeves for outerwear.
objections.a: Emphasise that this is a designer detail for an elegant occasion. Indoors, this sleeve style looks more graceful and allows freer movement, while showcasing accessories rather than concealing them.

objections.q: Difficulty caring for natural wool.
objections.a: Remind the client that natural wool has self-cleaning properties and requires only occasional airing and delicate cleaning, which preserves the piece for years.

objections.q: The colour seems too dark.
objections.a: Verde Bottiglia and Blu Inchiostro are foundational colours of the luxury winter wardrobe. They pair more easily with accessories than classic black and appear more refined under artificial lighting.

173.name: Met
173.description: An exquisite midi dress, crafted from the finest merino wool with a delicate ribbed texture. The flared, sun-ray skirt silhouette (gonna a ruota) embodies femininity and timeless elegance. The stand ("lupetto") collar is finished with an elegant fastening of signature LS heraldic buttons, serving as the key aristocratic accent. The long-sleeved model, with its impeccable Regular fit, ensures exceptional comfort and warmth for the winter season.

advice: Highlight the versatility of this buttonless design: it can be worn open as a light jacket, or cinched at the waist with a leather belt from the collection for a more structured silhouette.
Draw the client's attention to the composition: 85% natural wool provides warmth and softness, while the addition of acrylic ensures durability and helps the jacquard pattern retain its shape.
Recommend pairing with the Minia skirt in the same shade to create a flawless total look, which visually elongates the figure through the continuity of pattern.

objections.q: Wool may lose its shape after washing.
objections.a: Explain that the 'punto stoffa' (dense knit) construction is known for its structural stability. Recommend delicate care to preserve the skirt's elasticity and shape for years to come.

objections.q: The stand collar may seem too closed.
objections.a: Point out the functional heraldic buttons, which allow the depth of the neckline to be adjusted and add a note of noble sophistication to the look.

objections.q: The dress seems too heavy due to the volume of the skirt.
objections.a: Merino wool combines lightness with a high level of warmth. The volume of the skirt creates dynamic movement without weighing down the overall silhouette.

objections.q: Knitwear may accentuate figure irregularities.
objections.a: This piece is crafted in a ribbed knit with a regular fit, which visually elongates the silhouette and conceals figure concerns, unlike a thin, smooth knit.

objections.q: The colour is too classic.
objections.a: Nero, Tabacco, and Verde Militare form the foundation of 'quiet luxury.' Suggest enlivening the look with a contrasting silk scarf or a belt with gold-tone hardware from the LS collection.

174.name: Micologia
174.description: An elegant knit jacket in high-quality wool blend, embodying Luisa Spagnoli's aesthetic of contemporary classicism. The model is crafted using an exquisite jacquard technique with a two-tone herringbone pattern (disegno spinato), which lends the fabric depth and a noble texture. Impeccable lapels, contrasting edge trim, and functional patch pockets underscore the structured silhouette. The absence of buttons and the semi-fitted cut ensure ease of styling and a comfortable Regular fit, transforming the jacket into an indispensable element of the winter wardrobe in the "quiet luxury" style.

Draw the client's attention to the composition: 85% wool lends a noble texture and warmth rarely found in evening dresses of such an elegant cut.
Recommend this piece for occasions with a cocktail or black-tie dress code, where the black hue and the delicate sparkle of the stones will underscore the wearer's status.

objections.q: The absence of buttons makes the jacket non-functional.
objections.a: Explain that this is a designer choice, made to create a more contemporary, relaxed look. The jacket is ideal for layering, and can be secured with an elegant brooch or belt when needed.

objections.q: The herringbone pattern seems too traditional.
objections.a: Emphasise that the classic 'spinato' weave is the season's key Heritage trend. The Micologia piece's contrasting edge detailing lends it a contemporary, dynamic look, setting it apart from ordinary knitwear.

objections.q: The blended material composition.
objections.a: Clarify that the foundation of the jacket is premium natural wool (85%). The small percentage of technical fibre is essential specifically for the jacquard knit, ensuring the piece does not deform and retains the crispness of its pattern after cleaning.

objections.q: An unlined jacket may let a draught through.
objections.a: This piece is crafted in a dense knit that retains warmth exceptionally well. The absence of a lining makes the jacket more supple, allowing it to drape softly over the figure and move freely beneath outerwear.

objections.q: The colour combinations seem unusual.
objections.a: Nero/Tabacco and Beige/Beige are foundational colours in the Luisa Spagnoli palette. They integrate easily into a wardrobe, pairing as beautifully with classic denim as with pastel silk blouses.

175.name: Mimesia
175.description: An exquisite midi dress, crafted from premium wool blend, embodies Luisa Spagnoli's concept of evening elegance. The fitted (aderente) cut and below-the-knee length create an impeccable, feminine silhouette, ideal for festive occasions in the winter season.

objections.q: Black Nero 0101 leather looks too severe.
objections.a: Demonstrate the possibilities of 'soft-luxury' styling: pair the trousers with soft Manos knitwear or cashmere to soften the leather's texture and create a refined, casual look.

objections.q: The trousers may quickly lose their shape and stretch out at the knees.
objections.a: Point out the high density and resilience of the fabric. The technical polyester base guarantees the Oneta trousers will retain the intended volume of the leg and crisp lines throughout the season.

256.name: Ontani
256.description: The Ontani trousers offer a flawless reading of contemporary urban style with an aristocratic undertone from Luisa Spagnoli. The loose-fit piece is crafted from high-quality denim, in which cotton is harmoniously blended with lyocell (30%), lending the fabric exceptional softness, lightness and a noble fluidity. The design is accentuated by open pintucks (pinces), creating architectural volume, and an exquisite flap coin pocket â€” a detail that nods to the archives of classic tailoring craftsmanship. The wide silhouette, combined with a high waist, visually slims and elongates the legs, elevating denim into a piece of high fashion.

objections.q: Denim looks too casual for a statement wardrobe.
objections.a: Point out the premium composition featuring lyocell and the archival design details (pleats, flap pocket), which elevate the style from basic denim into the category of 'luxury denim' in a 'quiet luxury' spirit.

objections.q: A wide cut may visually add volume to the figure.
objections.a: Explain that the high waist and the vertical lines of the pleats, on the contrary, elongate the silhouette and create correct proportions, particularly when paired with heeled or platform footwear.

objections.q: The trousers seem too long.
objections.a: Clarify that this length is specifically designed to create the effect of endlessly long legs. Style them with the high-heeled Urbana ankle boots to achieve a runway-worthy effect.

objections.q: The fabric may quickly lose its shape.
objections.a: Lyocell in the composition not only lends softness but also improves the material's durability. The trousers hold their shape beautifully and crease less than standard 100% cotton.

objections.q: Caring for denim with added lyocell seems complex.
objections.a: Reassure the client that lyocell simplifies care: the fabric irons more easily and retains its colour vibrancy for longer. Simple, delicate-wash care is all that's needed.

265.name: Ortesi
265.description: The Ortesi trousers are the embodiment of refined classicism and Luisa Spagnoli's flawless tailoring artistry. The straight Regular fit piece is crafted from a noble viscose-based blend with delicate virgin wool (lana vergine), lending the fabric a status-defining texture and softness. Meticulously pressed creases visually elongate the silhouette, underscoring the architectural discipline of the lines. The understated design is completed with a concealed zip closure and functional side pockets, making Ortesi the ideal foundation for creating evening and formal ensembles in the 'quiet luxury' style.

looks.title: Total Look (Look 132)
looks.text: Trousers Ortesi 0101 in a flawless evening ensemble with jacket Soana 0101 and bustier Lunetta 0101.

looks.title: Total Look (Look 132)
looks.text: Trousers Ortesi 0101 in a flawless evening ensemble with jacket Soana 0101 and bustier Lunetta 0101.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the premium composition: the blend of viscose and virgin wool guarantees not only a noble appearance but also exceptional comfort, whether worn indoors or at formal occasions.
Emphasise the versatility of the Regular fit cut with pressed creases: a time-tested solution for visually correcting the figure, lending the legs a slender, elongated appearance.

Recommend Ortesi as an investment wardrobe piece: with its understated design and classic black hue, these trousers adapt effortlessly from a tailored business dress code to a black-tie evening occasion.

objections.q: The trousers seem too formal for frequent wear.
objections.a: Demonstrate the styling possibilities with soft knitwear or a silk blouse. Ortesi can serve as the foundation of an elegant everyday look when the structured jacket is replaced with a more relaxed top.

objections.q: Wool content may cause skin irritation.
objections.a: Clarify that the primary component (83%) is premium-quality viscose, which lends the material its silkiness and softness. Virgin wool is added only to help the piece hold its shape and achieve a noble sheen.

objections.q: Caring for creased trousers seems complex.
objections.a: Point out the exceptional Italian quality of the fabric. Thanks to the 3% elastane and professional seam finishing, the crease holds its definition significantly longer, requiring only minimal, delicate care.

objections.q: Black looks too predictable.
objections.a: Emphasise that Luisa Spagnoli's Nero 0101 has real depth and richness. It is the perfect backdrop for bold accessories or intricate textures, such as Lunetta lace.

objections.q: The trousers may crease quickly due to the viscose.
objections.a: Reassure the client that the technical combination of wool and elastane in the Ortesi composition prevents significant fabric deformation, allowing the piece to remain flawless throughout the evening.

268.name: Osiglia
268.description: The Osiglia trousers are the quintessence of flawless classicism and aristocratic restraint from Luisa Spagnoli. The straight Regular fit piece is crafted from a noble natural-wool-based blend, ensuring exceptional comfort, softness and flawless thermoregulation. Meticulously considered details, such as the zip-and-hook closure and functional side pockets, underscore the high quality of Italian tailoring craftsmanship. These trousers will serve as the ideal foundation for creating elegant everyday ensembles in the 'quiet luxury' style, underscoring their wearer's status and refined taste.

looks.title: Total Look 60
looks.text: Trousers Osiglia 0813 in an exquisite combination with shirt Ladulas 0813, pullover Manos 0821 and bag Elegante Intuito 0903 0002 (URL data missing in official sources).

looks.title: Sophisticated Heritage (Look 64)
looks.text: A combination of Osiglia 0813 with shirt Ladulas 0813, cap Renno 0814 and bag Idilliaco 0101 0002.

looks.title: Urban Elegance (Look 65)
looks.text: Osiglia 0813 complemented by pullover Meritare 0823, shirt Ladulas 0813 and bag Idilliaco 0101 0002.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the fabric composition: 60% natural wool guarantees not only a noble appearance but also lasting durability, making it a worthwhile wardrobe investment.
Emphasise the versatility of the Regular fit and straight silhouette: a time-proven solution that visually slims the legs and suits any figure type.
Recommend the Grigio Melange shade as a flawless foundation: this nuanced grey is a symbol of 'quiet luxury' and pairs effortlessly with both the pastel and richly saturated tones of the collection.

objections.q: Wool may be demanding to care for and may crease.
objections.a: Clarify that the addition of 38% polyester is specifically intended to help the trousers hold their shape better, crease less throughout the day, and offer greater durability.

objections.q: A classic straight cut may look too formal.
objections.a: Demonstrate contemporary styling options from the lookbook, such as pairing them with the Renno cap and soft knitwear, to lend the look a dynamic, urban character.

objections.q: The trousers may seem too thin for winter.
objections.a: Point out the high wool content (60%), which offers excellent thermal-insulation properties, ensuring comfort in the cold season without unnecessary bulk.

objections.q: Difficulty finding suitable footwear.
objections.a: Thanks to the classic regular-fit leg width, the Osiglia style pairs beautifully with both elegant heeled ankle boots and more masculine loafers.

objections.q: The Grigio Melange colour seems insufficiently dressy.
objections.a: Explain to the client that the melange texture lends the fabric depth and a luxurious sheen, transforming grey trousers into a refined piece suitable even for evening occasions when paired with a silk blouse.

271.name: Ottana
271.description: The Ottana trousers are the flawless embodiment of classic style and aristocratic elegance from Luisa Spagnoli. The straight-cut piece is crafted from a noble blend fabric in a traditional herringbone pattern (spigato), lending the look depth and textural expressiveness. The meticulously calibrated Regular fit silhouette, with its classic cut, completed with belt loops and a secure zip-and-hook-and-bar closure, makes Ottana an indispensable foundation for creating status-defining winter ensembles in the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic. The fabric's natural wool content guarantees comfort and flawless thermoregulation.

looks.title: Total Look (Look 192)
looks.text: Trousers Ottana 3417 in a flawless combination with jacket Seduta 3417, blouse Latteria A 2290 and footwear Uranio A 2233.

looks.title: Winter Heritage (Vetrina 35)
looks.text: Ottana 3417 complemented by pullover Mabels 2435, shirt Lucinda 0201, cap Rotterdam 2439 and bag Idilliaco 0986 0002.

looks.title: Sophisticated Office (Vetrina 36)
looks.text: A harmonious ensemble consisting of Ottana 3417, jacket Seduta 3417, blouse Latteria A 2417 and bag Idilliaco 0986 0002.

advice: Draw attention to the timeless herringbone pattern (spigato): this classic print is a symbol of impeccable taste and remains relevant regardless of shifting seasonal trends.
Emphasise the benefits of the Regular fit: the straight silhouette skilfully structures the figure's proportions, visually lengthens the legs, and delivers exceptional all-day comfort.

Recommend this piece as the foundation for a luxurious Heritage look: the blend of wool and acetate guarantees warmth and longevity, making the Ottana trousers an investment piece for the winter wardrobe.

objections.q: Wool trousers may crease with extended wear at the office or while travelling.
objections.a: Clarify that thanks to the technical blended composition (40% polyester and 25% acetate), the fabric has enhanced resilience, holds its shape beautifully, and is far less prone to deformation than pure wool.

objections.q: The herringbone pattern in Bordeaux may look too formal for everyday wear.
objections.a: Demonstrate the possibilities of eclectic styling: suggest pairing the trousers with cosy knitwear, such as the Mabels 2435 pullover, to add a note of relaxed chic to the look.

objections.q: The material may seem insufficiently dense for a cold winter.
objections.a: Point out the high quality of the natural wool content. It offers excellent thermal-insulation properties, while the addition of acetate lends the fabric the necessary density, protecting against the wind without unnecessary bulk.

objections.q: Difficulty finding footwear to match the straight-leg cut.
objections.a: Thanks to the classic width, the Ottana style pairs beautifully with both elegant heeled Uranio A 2233 ankle boots and more masculine loafers, accentuating the aristocratic quality of the cut.

objections.q: Classic creased trousers require demanding care.
objections.a: Reassure the client that the use of premium-quality Italian fabrics is the key to longevity. Professional dry cleaning will preserve the crispness of the crease and the noble texture of the herringbone pattern for many seasons.

293.name: Salottino
293.description: The Salottino winter coat is the embodiment of refined femininity and aristocratic comfort from Luisa Spagnoli. Crafted from a noble pure wool cloth that delivers exceptional warmth and flawless softness. The 'robe coat' silhouette (vestaglia), with gently dropped shoulders and an accentuated waist, creates a harmonious, statuesque look. The design's principal accent is a shirt collar, decorated with long, striking fringe tassels that lend the piece dynamism and an exclusive character. A fitted, flared cut (sfiancata e svasata), combined with functional side pockets, makes this piece the quintessence of 'Made in Italy' style for the cold season.

looks.title: Total Look (Look 27)
looks.text: Coat Salottino 0202 in a luxurious ensemble with cardigan Malvia 0202 0846, top Mantecare 0846 0202, trousers Olibis 1088 and cap Renno 0814.

looks.title: Sophisticated Urban (Look 47)
looks.text: The Salottino 0916 model complements the look with pullover Mirko 1781, shirt Localita 0201, trousers Opaglio 0927, bag Iago 2240 0002 and gloves Uboldo 0971 0002.

looks.title: Heritage Chic (Look 74)
looks.text: Salottino 0916 combined with jacket Serafica 0733, shirt Lindas 0202 0202 and trousers Ostiolo 0733.

looks.title: Monochrome Luxe (Look 94)
looks.text: A flawless white ensemble with Salottino 0202, pullover Mano H 0202 and trousers Ortolano 0202 (Data missing in official sources).

advice: Draw the client's attention to the striking fringe: this decorative element is a key trend of the season, lending the classic robe coat a note of contemporary luxury and bohemian chic.
Emphasise the versatility of the vestaglia silhouette: the ability to adjust the fit with the belt allows the piece to be perfectly tailored to any figure, creating a flawless feminine silhouette.
Lead with the 100% pure wool fabric: this guarantees the highest level of thermal regulation and durability, making the Salottino coat a long-term investment in a status wardrobe.

objections.q: Fringe may seem impractical and demanding to care for.
objections.a: Point out the exceptional quality of craftsmanship: the fringe is securely fastened and crafted from durable wool. Regular professional cleaning will preserve its pristine appearance for many years to come.

objections.q: A button-free wrap coat may not be warm enough in strong wind.
objections.a: Explain that the deep wrap closure and dense pure-wool cloth provide reliable protection. Recommend pairing the style with voluminous knitwear, such as the Mano H pullover, for maximum comfort.

objections.q: The light Panna 0202 shade seems impractical for the winter season.
objections.a: Emphasise that a light winter palette is a marker of high status in a 'quiet luxury' style. Pure wool has natural properties that help it stay clean for longer with proper care.

objections.q: Fringe on the collar may visually add weight to the upper body.
objections.a: Clarify that the V-neckline and fitted silhouette, on the contrary, elongate the vertical line, while the fringe creates a soft dynamic movement, lightening the overall look.

objections.q: The style looks too relaxed for a formal dress code.
objections.a: Demonstrate the styling possibilities: paired with the structured Serafica jacket and classic trousers, the Salottino coat transforms into a refined, statement-worthy element of business dressing.

294.name: Salve A
294.description: The Salve A jacket is the quintessence of contemporary elegance and flawless Italian style from Luisa Spagnoli. The piece is a masterfully cut blazer that harmoniously unites architectural discipline of line with refined femininity. This is a key piece of the collection, created for the woman who values the aesthetic of 'quiet luxury' and seeks to build status-defining yet comfortable looks. Pairing perfectly with classic trousers, the Salve A jacket forms a flawless suiting ensemble, equally suited to high-level business meetings and formal social occasions.

looks.title: Total look Military Heritage (Look 48)
looks.text: Salve A 1789 combined with the Liceali 3200 shirt and Odini 1789 trousers.

looks.title: Sophisticated Power Suit (Look 62)
looks.text: Salve A 0326 in an ensemble with the Lezioni 0101 top and Odini 0326 trousers.

looks.title: Urban Layering (Look 49)
looks.text: Salve A 1789 over the Manos 0970 pullover with the Leila A 0201 shirt.

advice: Draw attention to the two-piece suit concept: offer the Salve A jacket paired with the Odini trousers, emphasising that this is the perfect investment in a long-lasting core wardrobe.
Showcase the versatility of the Verde Militare 1789 shade as a refined alternative to classic navy or black, perfectly suited to the autumn-winter season.
Lead with the emotional appeal of the Rosa 0326 shade: this hue brings freshness to the complexion and lends the look a more feminine, exclusive edge within a business dress code.

objections.q: Жакет выглядит слишком строго для повседневной носки
objections.a: Предложите стилизацию в духе casual chic: сочетание жакета с денимом или мягким трикотажем Manos, что позволит снизить градус формальности и сделает образ более расслабленным.

objections.q: Цвет Rosa 0326 кажется непрактичным для жакета
objections.a: Уточните, что в коллекции Luisa Spagnoli используются материалы высочайшего качества, которые долго сохраняют первозданный вид. Розовый цвет в данном исполнении — это маркер высокого статуса и уверенности в себе.

objections.q: Я опасаюсь, что приталенный крой будет сковывать движения
objections.a: Обратите внимание на выверенные лекала итальянских мастеров: конструкция жакета разработана таким образом, чтобы обеспечивать безупречную посадку по фигуре, сохраняя при этом полную свободу движений.

objections.q: Зеленый оттенок (Verde Militare) сложно сочетать с другими вещами
objections.a: Продемонстрируйте готовые решения из лукбука: этот цвет идеально гармонирует с палитрой коричневых, бежевых и кремовых тонов, выступая в роли универсальной базы.

objections.q: Классический блейзер быстро выйдет из моды
objections.a: Подчеркните, что Salve A — это изделие вне времени. Его лаконичный дизайн и премиальное исполнение гарантируют актуальность модели на протяжении многих сезонов.

299.name: Sauris
299.description: This magnificent winter coat from Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of contemporary luxury and ethical fashion. Crafted from high-quality sheared eco-fur (faux fur) with an exquisite texture that visually recalls natural fur. The architectural cut is accentuated by wide pointed lapels and a classic double-breasted closure, creating a status-defining, elegant silhouette. Slightly voluminous sleeves lend the look femininity, while a decorative back strap (martingale) ensures a perfect fit. Fabric composition: 67% acetate, 21% polyester, 12% polyamide.

looks.title: 'Urban Elegance' look (Vetrina 49)
looks.text: Coat combined with a pullover, shirt, and trousers.

looks.title: 'Contemporary Mix' look (Look 97)
looks.text: Coat with a basic Manos 0970 pullover and striking leather trousers. A cap completes the ensemble.

advice: Highlight the sustainability and premium quality of the faux fur, which rivals its natural counterparts in both tactile feel and visual appeal.
Recommend Sauris as a key piece for layered winter looks, emphasising its versatility when paired with knitwear and leather.
Draw the client's attention to the architectural details: the pointed lapels and back belt are signature touches of Luisa Spagnoli, making the piece both recognisable and timeless.

objections.q: Я боюсь, что эко-мех не будет греть в сильные морозы.
objections.a: Объясните, что сложная структура волокон ацетата и полиэстера в данной модели обеспечивает превосходную терморегуляцию и защиту от ветра, сохраняя легкость изделия.

objections.q: Двубортное меховое пальто может визуально увеличивать фигуру.
objections.a: Продемонстрируйте работу хлястика на спинке, который собирает объем и гармонизирует силуэт, предотвращая эффект излишней громоздкости.

objections.q: Искусственный мех требует сложного ухода.
objections.a: Подчеркните износостойкость материала. В отличие от натурального меха, этот состав менее подвержен истиранию и воздействию влаги, сохраняя безупречный вид шоколадного оттенка 0985 годами.

objections.q: Широкие лацканы выглядят слишком театрально.
objections.a: Стилизуйте пальто с лаконичными брюками

objections.q: Это пальто только на выход.
objections.a: Покажите, как легко Sauris трансформируется в повседневную вещь при сочетании с кепи

300.name: Scalare
300.description: This striking winter car coat embodies the aesthetic of 'utility chic', reimagined through the lens of Luisa Spagnoli's high fashion. Crafted from a dense wool-blend cloth (80% wool, 20% polyester), guaranteeing flawless shape retention and protection from the cold. The ultra-contemporary 'boxy' silhouette is balanced by classic double-breasted lapels and the luxurious heraldic buttons that have become the collection's signature. The principal structural feature is an integrated belt at the hem, allowing the volume of the piece to be transformed, underscoring the architectural quality of the look.

looks.title: Total Look 'Sophisticated Noir' (Vetrina 14)
looks.text: Scalare 0101 jacket combined with the Lusia 3406 1740 shirt and Foligno 3402 skirt. Complete the look with a Rotterdam 0101 cap.

looks.title: Total Look 'Urban Grey' (Vetrina 21)
looks.text: Scalare 0817 jacket over the Loggiate 4575 blouse with the Ferriera 0813 skirt and Idilliaco 0986 0002 bag.

looks.title: Total Look 'Autumn Spice' (D - Look 82)
looks.text: mustard Scalare 1928 jacket with the Mascate 0759 tunic and Morolo 0759 skirt.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the versatility of the boxy silhouette: the Scalare jacket is perfect for both relaxed city looks with denim and elegant ensembles with midi skirts.
Emphasise the prestige of the piece through its details: the heraldic buttons and striking lapels lend a note of aristocratic refinement to an everyday wardrobe.
Showcase the functionality of the integrated belt — an excellent tool for personalising the fit and creating a variety of visual effects.

objections.q: Мне кажется, что бокси-силуэт будет выглядеть слишком громоздко на моей фигуре.
objections.a: Предложите отрегулировать объем с помощью встроенного пояса. Это позволит собрать изделие по нижнему краю, создавая более аккуратный и структурированный силуэт.

objections.q: Это скорее куртка, чем полноценное пальто, будет ли в ней достаточно тепло?
objections.a: Объясните, что высокое содержание шерсти (80%) и плотное плетение сукна обеспечивают отличную теплоизоляцию, характерную для зимней верхней одежды.

objections.q: Геральдические пуговицы обязывают к определенному стилю.
objections.a: Напротив, эти детали являются декоративным акцентом, который позволяет сочетать куртку даже с самыми простыми базовыми вещами, мгновенно повышая градус стиля всего образа.

objections.q: Боюсь, что ткань будет слишком жесткой.
objections.a: Ткань прошла специальную обработку, чтобы сохранить плотность, необходимую для поддержания формы кабана, оставаясь при этом приятной на ощупь.

objections.q: Я не уверена в выборе цвета, черный кажется скучным.
objections.a: Покажите модель в оттенках 'Mattone' (1547) или 'Senape' (1928) — это благородные, глубокие цвета, которые освежают зимний гардероб и прекрасно сочетаются с природной гаммой.

302.name: Scansione
302.description: A flawless double-breasted winter coat, crafted from a dense wool-blend cloth (80% wool, 20% polyester) that holds its shape beautifully and protects against the cold. The architectural cut is accentuated by slightly voluminous 'bombÃ¨' sleeves and an accent waist seam, creating a silhouette that is both feminine and disciplined. Striking piping and tone-matched buttons underscore the exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail characteristic of the Luisa Spagnoli aesthetic. The piece has a classic Regular fit, ensuring comfort in everyday wear.

looks.title: 'Urban Chic' look (Vetrina 36)
looks.text: Scansione 0961 coat combined with the Capire 2452 pullover and Fumaiolo 3417 skirt.
