looks.title: 'Natural Tones' look (Vetrina 38)
looks.text: Scansione 2046 coat complemented by the Casistica 1151 1181 pullover and Festone 2046 skirt. Accent — Idilliaco 0986 0002 bag.

looks.title: 'Sophisticated Contrast' look (Look 74)
looks.text: Scansione 2046 coat over the Lusia 3406 1740 shirt.

advice: Emphasise the relevance of the bombé sleeve silhouette — a key trend of the season that lends the look softness and modernity without compromising the structure of a classic coat.
Draw attention to the high wool content (80%), which guarantees comfort even on the harshest winter days while keeping the garment lightweight.
Recommend Scansione as the ideal choice for monochromatic looks, using the tonal buttons as an element of minimalist luxury.

objections.q: Боюсь, что рукава 'bombè' добавят мне ненужный объем в плечах.
objections.a: Объясните, что крой пальто имеет отрезную талию и четкие линии нервюр, которые визуально вытягивают силуэт, гармонизируя объем рукавов.

objections.q: Меня смущает полиэстер в составе за такую цену.
objections.a: Уточните, что 20% технологичных волокон необходимы именно для того, чтобы пальто сохраняло свою архитектурную форму и было устойчиво к деформации и пиллингу.

objections.q: Будет ли это пальто сочетаться с брюками?
objections.a: Продемонстрируйте Look 180 из официального стайлинга, где пальто Scansione 0961 идеально дополняет повседневный комплект с брюками.

objections.q: Ткань кажется слишком плотной и жесткой.
objections.a: Это плотное сукно специально разработано для защиты от ветра. В процессе носки оно становится более пластичным, сохраняя при этом безупречный 'дорогой' вид.

objections.q: Зеленый цвет 2046 слишком сложный для сочетаний.
objections.a: Предложите сочетать его с аксессуарами шоколадного оттенка, как в Look 75, что создаст благородную природную палитру.

304.name: Sciantal
304.description: This flawless 'bon ton' jacket from Luisa Spagnoli is the quintessence of femininity and aristocratic chic. Crafted from an exquisite mÃ©lange bouclÃ© fabric that creates a rich visual and tactile texture. The piece's edges are artfully finished with decorative passementerie trim, adding graphic quality and polish to the look. Framed welt pockets and a concealed hook closure ensure a perfect fit and purity of line in the Regular fit silhouette. Fabric composition: 50% cotton, 42% polyester, 5% wool, 3% other fibers.

looks.title: Total Look 'Classic Elegance' (Vetrina 56)
looks.text: Sciantal 3285 jacket in an ensemble with the Fiorini 3285 skirt and a minimalist Limonaia 0101 shirt. The look is completed with an Iago 0101 0002 bag.

looks.title: Total Look 'Classic Elegance' (Vetrina 56)
looks.text: Sciantal 3285 jacket in an ensemble with the Fiorini 3285 skirt and a minimalist Limonaia 0101 shirt. The look is completed with an Iago 0101 0002 bag.

looks.title: Total Look 'Classic Elegance' (Vetrina 56)
looks.text: Sciantal 3285 jacket in an ensemble with the Fiorini 3285 skirt and a minimalist Limonaia 0101 shirt. The look is completed with an Iago 0101 0002 bag.

advice: Recommend Sciantal as a timeless wardrobe investment: the classic bouclé aesthetic never falls out of favour and is perfectly suited to occasions with a smart casual or business formal dress code.
Draw the client's attention to the details — concealed hooks in place of buttons give the jacket a more modern, minimalist look, without detracting from the rich texture of the fabric.
Suggest purchasing the jacket together with the Fiorini 3285 skirt to create a luxurious two-piece suit, visually slimming thanks to its unified colour palette.

objections.q: Букле может полнить или выглядеть слишком объемно.
objections.a: Уточните, что данная модель имеет выверенную посадку regular fit и потайную застежку на крючки, что позволяет сохранить плоский и четкий силуэт, в отличие от моделей на крупных пуговицах.

objections.q: Ткань содержит полиэстер.
objections.a: Объясните, что 42% технологичных волокон в сочетании с хлопком и шерстью необходимы для сохранения формы букле, предотвращения деформации и обеспечения долговечности этой деликатной фактуры.

objections.q: Застежка на крючки кажется неудобной.
objections.a: Продемонстрируйте, как легко они застегиваются, и подчеркните, что такое решение создает эффект «бесшовного» фасада, делая жакет более элегантным и подходящим для вечерних выходов.

objections.q: Меланж сложно сочетать с другими вещами.
objections.a: Меланж 3285 в черно-белой гамме является нейтральной базой. Он идеально гармонирует с любыми однотонными вещами черного, белого или пастельных оттенков, как в предложенных нами Total Looks.

305.name: Scolpito
305.description: This majestic winter coat from Luisa Spagnoli is a triumph of architectural cut and textural contrast. Crafted from a dense, high-quality wool cloth (80% wool, 20% polyester), which holds its shape beautifully. The principal stylistic accent is striking pointed lapels, masterfully trimmed with exquisite faux fur in a contrasting shade. A single-breasted closure with exclusive flat, square-shaped buttons and graphic piping underscore the discipline and aristocratic character of the Regular fit silhouette, transforming the coat into a true art object of the winter wardrobe.

looks.title: 'Urban Aristocracy' look (Look 51)
looks.text: Scolpito 0101 0913 coat in an impeccable combination with the Met 2234 knit dress. The ensemble is complemented by an elegant Idilliaco A 0101 0002 bag and a felt Renno 0930 cap.

looks.title: 'Wild Elegance' look (Look 81)
looks.text: Scolpito 0101 0913 coat over a minimalist Manos F 0101 pullover. The animal-print Idasola 3407 0101 0002 bag adds a bold accent. A Renno 0930 accessory completes the look.

looks.title: 'Classic Heritage' look (Look 55)
looks.text: A combination of the Scolpito 0101 0913 coat with the Festone 0101 skirt and Caprese B 0101 pullover. The final touch — an Iago 0101 0002 bag.

advice: Draw the client's attention to the 'sculptural' nature of both the name and the cut: the eco-fur trim on the lapels visually broadens the shoulder line, making the waist appear more slender.
Offer Scolpito as an investment piece that unites the warmth of traditional wool cloth with the current trend for decorative fur.
Emphasise the prestige of the hardware: the square buttons serve as a jewel-like accent, removing the need to select additional statement jewellery.

objections.q: Меня смущает использование искусственного меха в такой дорогой модели.
objections.a: Сделайте акцент на концепции осознанного потребления и высочайшем качестве faux fur от Luisa Spagnoli — он не только этичен, но и превосходит натуральный мех по износостойкости в условиях влажной зимы.

objections.q: Контрастные лацканы могут визуально перегружать образ.
objections.a: Продемонстрируйте Look 81 с монохромной базой Manos F 0101, где пальто становится единственным и гармоничным центром композиции.

objections.q: Будет ли это пальто греть при низких температурах?
objections.a: Обратите внимание на состав ткани: 80% натуральной шерсти в сочетании с плотным плетением сукна обеспечивают превосходную терморегуляцию.

objections.q: Квадратные пуговицы кажутся слишком авангардными для классики.
objections.a: Объясните, что это авторский штрих бренда, который переводит модель из категории базовых вещей в разряд эксклюзивного дизайнерского гардероба.

objections.q: Меховая отделка требует сложного ухода.
objections.a: Успокойте клиентку: в отличие от натурального меха, ворс эко-меха в оттенке 0913 не желтеет и не деформируется, сохраняя безупречный вид изделия на долгие годы.

306.name: Scoprire
306.description: Data not available in official sources.

looks.title: Total Look 'City Winter' (Look 164)
looks.text: Striking Scoprire 0101 0989 down jacket complemented by a basic Manos F 0101 pullover and Olibis 1088 jeans. The look is finished with Ulisside 0101 0038 boots, Nagorno 0002 earrings, Uboldo 0101 0002 leather gloves and Xnina A 0101 0002 glasses.

looks.title: Total Look 'Elegant Dove' (Look 198)
looks.text: Down jacket in a noble shade Scoprire 2712 2712 in an ensemble with the Costanzo 1111 top, corduroy Olap 1119 trousers and Urbana 0981 ankle boots. Exquisite accent — Nuevitas 0002 0001 necklace.

advice: Highlight the luxurious mink-effect trim (Visone) in the 0101 0989 colourway, which elevates the down jacket from sportswear into the realm of urban luxury.
Recommend the Tortora shade (2712) for creating status-affirming monochromatic looks, perfectly suited to the winter season.
Demonstrate how accessories, such as the Uboldo 0101 0002 gloves, can instantly transform an everyday down jacket into an elegant evening option.

objections.q: Я опасаюсь, что пуховик будет выглядеть слишком громоздко.
objections.a: Модель Scoprire обладает выверенным кроем, который сохраняет архитектурность силуэта, обеспечивая тепло без лишнего объема.

objections.q: Светлый оттенок Tortora может быть марким для зимы.
objections.a: Ткани Luisa Spagnoli проходят специальную обработку, которая повышает их износостойкость и облегчает уход за изделием.

objections.q: Эта модель кажется слишком молодежной.
objections.a: Благодаря использованию премиальной отделки под норку и классической палитры, этот пуховик выглядит аристократично и подходит для любого возраста.

objections.q: Будет ли он достаточно теплым для морозов?
objections.a: Данная модель piumino разработана с учетом низких температур, сочетая в себе современные теплоизоляционные технологии и защиту от ветра.

objections.q: Черный пуховик — это слишком просто.
objections.a: Обратите внимание на контрастную отделку Visone (0989), которая добавляет изделию уникальный дизайнерский штрих и визуальную глубину.

314.name: Serenella
314.description: The cropped double-breasted Serenella blazer is the embodiment of contemporary classicism from Luisa Spagnoli. The piece is defined by a flawless architectural cut with accentuated shoulders and traditional lapels, creating a silhouette that is both commanding and feminine. Crafted from high-quality wool blend, the jacket is completed with exquisite framed welt pockets and a straight hem that sits perfectly on the figure. Fabric composition: 55% wool, 41% polyester, 4% elastane.

looks.title: 'Monochrome Power' look (Look 91)
looks.text: Serenella 1547 jacket combined with classic Odini 1547 trousers to create a striking monochrome suit.

looks.title: 'Sophisticated Bluette' look (Look 218)
looks.text: Serenella 2527 jacket with Odini 2527 trousers. Accents: Nantilde 2 necklace, Navigero 2 bracelet and Nagorno 2 earrings.

looks.title: Layered winter look (Look 89)
looks.text: Serenella 2527 jacket under the Scansione 0961 coat with the Mossa 0970 pullover and a silk Remige 4648 scarf.

advice: Point out that the cropped length of the Serenella jacket visually lengthens the legs, particularly when paired with high-waisted trousers such as Odini 1547.
Draw attention to the piece's versatility: structured shoulders make it ideal for an office dress code, while vibrant colours allow the jacket to be worn to formal occasions.
Highlight the fabric composition: the addition of elastane ensures comfort of movement, while polyester helps the jacket retain its shape and resist creasing.

objections.q: Я боюсь, что укороченный фасон мне не подойдет.
objections.a: Предложите примерить жакет с брюками Odini. Крой Serenella доходит до линии бедра, что в паре с высокой талией брюк создает гармоничный и стройный силуэт.

objections.q: В составе есть полиэстер, я предпочитаю 100% шерсть.
objections.a: Объясните, что 41% технологичных волокон необходим именно для этого фасона: они позволяют жакету держать четкую архитектурную форму и предотвращают деформацию ткани в локтях и на спине.

objections.q: Этот цвет Bluette (2527) кажется мне слишком вызывающим.
objections.a: Продемонстрируйте Look 89, где жакет Serenella 2527 приглушается более спокойными оттенками пальто Scansione 0961, добавляя лишь благородный цветовой акцент.

objections.q: Плечи выглядят слишком объемными.
objections.a: Это ключевой тренд сезона — 'power dressing'. Структурированные плечи Serenella уравновешивают линию бедер, создавая идеальный силуэт 'песочные часы'.

objections.q: Жакет кажется слишком формальным для повседневной носки.
objections.a: Посоветуйте сочетать его с базовым трикотажем, например Mossa 0970, чтобы смягчить строгость и перевести образ в стиль Smart Casual.

315.name: Serieta
315.description: The double-breasted Serieta blazer by Luisa Spagnoli is the quintessence of neoclassical style and flawless Italian taste. Crafted from high-quality wool fabric in an exquisite check pattern in a noble beige-and-hazelnut palette. The architectural cut is accentuated by rounded peaked lapels (revers a lancia arrotondati) and functional flap pockets, lending the look structure and aristocratic chic. Side vents at the back ensure a perfect Regular fit and freedom of movement. Fabric composition: 59% wool, 29% polyester, 9% polyamide, 3% other fibers.

looks.title: 'Power Suit' look (Look 140)
looks.text: Serieta 3274 blazer combined with matching textured Odrisi 3274 trousers and a cashmere Manos F 2246 pullover. Accent — Iago 2240 0002 bag.

looks.title: 'Contemporary Preppy' look (Look 156)
looks.text: Serieta 3274 blazer over a white Lucinda 0201 shirt (Data missing in official sources for URL) in an ensemble with the Fatalita 3274 skirt (Data missing in official sources for URL).

looks.title: 'Urban Layers' look (Look 146)
looks.text: Serieta 3274 blazer paired with a Manos F 2435 pullover to create a soft color contrast.

advice: Emphasise the versatility of the 3274 check print: the neutral beige-and-brown palette allows the blazer to integrate seamlessly into a tailored office dress code as well as relaxed everyday looks with denim.
Draw attention to the cut's details: the rounded lapels soften the blazer's structured, masculine silhouette, adding a note of femininity and individuality.
Recommend building a complete suit with the Odrisi 3274 trousers — the monochromatic vertical pattern visually slims and elongates the silhouette.

objections.q: В составе ткани есть синтетические волокна, я предпочитаю 100% шерсть.
objections.a: Объясните, что добавление полиэстера и полиамида необходимо для сохранения архитектурной формы блейзера и предотвращения деформации ткани, что особенно важно для двубортных моделей.

objections.q: Клетка может визуально полнить.
objections.a: Укажите на мелкий масштаб рисунка 'quadretto' и выверенный крой regular fit с боковыми разрезами, которые гармонизируют пропорции и не создают лишнего объема.

objections.q: Двубортная застежка кажется мне слишком формальной.
objections.a: Продемонстрируйте стайлинг с пуловером Manos F. Это снизит градус формальности и превратит Serieta в стильный элемент 'smart casual' гардероба.

objections.q: Закругленные лацканы выглядят необычно для классического блейзера.
objections.a: Подчеркните, что это эксклюзивная дизайнерская деталь бренда, которая выделяет владелицу и подчеркивает ее осведомленность в модных трендах сезона.

objections.q: Этот цвет кажется сложным для сочетания.
objections.a: Покажите, как гармонично блейзер сочетается с базовыми цветами: белым, кремовым или шоколадным, представленными в коллекции пуловеров Manos F.

316.name: Sigilli
316.description: This striking cropped car coat from Luisa Spagnoli is a bold union of urban style and luxurious textures. Crafted from durable cotton denim and fully lined with soft faux fur in an exquisite astrakhan (persian lamb) effect. The architectural cut is accentuated by wide lapels, while the antiqued finish of the domed buttons adds a note of vintage chic to the look. Functional patch pockets and framed welt pockets, alongside a central back vent, ensure a perfect balance between practicality and elegance in the Regular fit silhouette. Composition: 86% cotton, 14% polyester.

looks.title: Total Look 'Urban Explorer' (Vetrina 5)
looks.text: Sigilli 1294 0235 coat combined with the Meleti 0620 pullover, white Leila 0201 shirt and wide-leg Olla 1248 jeans. A Renno 0930 cap and Idoneo bag (Data missing in official sources for URL) complete the look.

looks.title: Total Look 'Chic Sand' (Vetrina 9)
looks.text: Sigilli 1294 0235 coat over the Mascate 0204 tunic with corduroy Olap 1168 trousers.

looks.title: Look 204 'Autumn Velvet'
looks.text: Sigilli 1294 0235 coat with a basic Mano H 0202 pullover and Olap 0214 trousers. Footwear: Ustica A 2240.

advice: Highlight the distinctive texture: the combination of rugged denim and delicate astrakhan-style fur creates an on-trend contrast that sets this piece apart from classic winter garments.
Emphasise the '2-in-1' functionality: thanks to its fur lining, the Sigilli car coat provides the warmth of a down jacket while retaining the stylish look of a classic car coat.
Recommend pairing this piece with corduroy or denim in other shades to create luxurious layered looks in a 'casual luxury' spirit.

objections.q: Деним кажется слишком холодным материалом для зимы.
objections.a: Обратите внимание клиентки на плотную внутреннюю отделку из эко-меха (astrakan effect), которая обеспечивает превосходную теплоизоляцию, сопоставимую с шерстяным пальто.

objections.q: Искусственный мех может быстро потерять вид.
objections.a: Уточните, что эко-мех Luisa Spagnoli обладает высокой износостойкостью и, в отличие от натурального меха, более устойчив к влаге и городским условиям, сохраняя текстуру астрахани долгие годы.

objections.q: Накладные карманы могут визуально увеличивать бедра.
objections.a: Крой кабана Sigilli имеет выверенную длину и центральную шлицу сзади, что гармонизирует пропорции и обеспечивает свободу движений, не утяжеляя силуэт.

objections.q: Этот стиль слишком спортивный для меня.
objections.a: Продемонстрируйте детали: антикварные пуговицы и меховые лацканы придают изделию аристократичный вид, позволяя носить его даже с классическими брюками Olap.

objections.q: Я не уверена в сочетаемости синего денима и белого меха.
objections.a: Это классическая зимняя палитра. Белоснежный мех освежает лицо, а темно-синий деним служит идеальной базой, подходящей практически к любому гардеробу.

319.name: Sindi
319.description: The exquisite Sindi double-breasted coat is a true masterpiece of Luisa Spagnoli's Italian craftsmanship, embodying the 'quiet luxury' aesthetic. Crafted from 100% pure virgin wool in a classic herringbone pattern, ensuring exceptional warmth and flawless shape retention. The architectural silhouette, with a fitted bodice and an elegant flared hem, underscores the femininity of the figure. Luxurious contrasting velvet details at the collar and the back strap (martingale), combined with the signature heraldic LS buttons, lend the coat status and polish.

looks.title: 'British Heritage' look (Vetrina 13)
looks.text: Sindi 3414 0917 coat ( Data missing in official sources) paired with Mossa 0117 pullover ( Data missing in official sources) and Renno 0814 cap.

looks.title: 'Chic Accessories' look (Look 196)
looks.text: Sindi 3414 1792 coat ( Data missing in official sources), complemented by Nagorno 0002 earrings, Nanterre 0002 0001 brooch and Uragano A 0986 footwear.

advice: Direct the client's attention to the composition: 100% pure virgin wool — a guarantee of longevity and premium comfort during the cold season.
Highlight the value of the trim: velvet details on the collar and martingale are couture touches that make the piece truly unique.
Recommend Sindi as a versatile foundation for a 'Day-to-Night' look: the coat is equally suited to a formal office dress code and elegant evening occasions.

objections.q: Я боюсь, что 100% шерсть может быть колючей.
objections.a: Успокойте клиентку, объяснив, что девственная шерсть (pure virgin wool) от Luisa Spagnoli проходит специальную обработку, делающую волокна невероятно мягкими и нежными при соприкосновении с кожей.

objections.q: Расклешенный силуэт может визуально добавить объема.
objections.a: Продемонстрируйте, как приталенный крой и вертикальный ряд пуговиц структурируют фигуру, создавая гармоничные пропорции и визуально вытягивая силуэт.

objections.q: Бархатные детали требуют сложного ухода.
objections.a: Уточните, что в данной модели используется плотный высококачественный бархат, устойчивый к износу. Правильное хранение на плечиках обеспечит безупречный вид воротника на долгие годы.

objections.q: Это пальто выглядит слишком классическим и формальным.
objections.a: Предложите современную стилизацию с кепи Renno 0814, как показано в Lookbook бренда, чтобы придать образу динамичность городского стиля.

objections.q: Серый узор 'елочка' кажется мне слишком строгим.
objections.a: Обратите внимание на игру фактур: мерцание бархата и блеск геральдических пуговиц LS 'подсвечивают' классический принт, делая его современным и выразительным.

320.name: Sinuosita
320.description: The Sinuosita parka by Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of winter comfort and refined style. The piece, filled with natural goose down (piuma d'oca), guarantees exceptional warmth while remaining lightweight. The design is accentuated by luxurious eco-fur trim at the hood and cuffs, lending the look a note of 'urban luxury'. Considered details, such as the gold-tone zip closure with the signature logo on the pull tab, a dropped shoulder line, and exterior drawcords for adjusting the waist and hood volume, allow the silhouette to be tailored to any mood. Fabric composition: 58% polyester, 42% cotton.

looks.title: Total Look 'Classic Winter' (Look 86)
looks.text: Sinuosita 0101 0101 parka combined with a white Lucinda 0201 shirt, a basic Manos 0101 pullover and Minuccio 0101 trousers.

looks.title: Total Look 'Urban Explorer' (Look 87)
looks.text: Sinuosita 0101 0101 parka worn over a Selettivo 1224 denim vest, Leila 0201 shirt and Onirico 1224 jeans. Accent — Iago 0101 0002 bag.

advice: Emphasize the filling: natural goose down is the gold standard of insulation for the coldest winter days.
Demonstrate the functionality of the drawstrings — a key selling point for clients wary of puffer volume: the parka can be worn comfortably relaxed or elegantly fitted.
Draw attention to the details: gold-tone hardware and eco-fur trim elevate this parka from sportswear into the 'high-end casual' category.

objections.q: Парка выглядит слишком объемной.
objections.a: Покажите, как работают внешние кулиски на талии. Они позволяют мгновенно изменить силуэт, подчеркнув фигуру и убрав лишний объем.

objections.q: Меня смущает эко-мех в составе.
objections.a: Подчеркните высочайшее качество используемого Luisa Spagnoli меха, который визуально неотличим от натурального, но при этом более устойчив к влаге и легок в уходе.

objections.q: Ткань содержит хлопок, не будет ли она промокать?
objections.a: Смесовая ткань с полиэстером специально разработана для зимних условий; она обладает водоотталкивающими свойствами и надежно защищает пуховой наполнитель от внешней среды.

objections.q: Эта модель только для прогулок?
objections.a: Вовсе нет. Благодаря аристократичному черному цвету и золотым деталям, Sinuosita прекрасно дополняет даже офисные образы с брюками Minuccio.

objections.q: Пух может выбиваться через швы.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli использует специальные пуховые пакеты и технологию двойного шва, что гарантирует сохранение наполнителя внутри изделия на протяжении многих сезонов.

321.name: Situazione
321.description: The elegant Situazione cape by Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of refined winter comfort and a contemporary reading of a classic silhouette. The piece, styled after a robe coat and crafted from a soft wool-blend cloth (80% wool, 20% polyester), is defined by a relaxed yet status-defining cut. The shawl collar flows seamlessly into soft lines, while a detachable, tone-matched belt allows the waist to be accentuated, creating a feminine silhouette. Particular luxury is lent by cuffs trimmed with high-quality tone-matched faux fur, making Situazione the ideal choice for both status-defining daytime outings and formal evening occasions.

looks.title: 'Perla Elegance' look (Vetrina 32)
looks.text: Situazione 0809 cape in an impeccable ensemble with a Latteria 1005 blouse and Fattura 0809 skirt. The look is completed with an Idilliaco 0101 bag.

looks.title: 'Monochrome Chic' look (Look 131)
looks.text: Situazione 0101 cape over an elegant Ghisalba 0101 dress combined with an Iglesias 0101 evening bag.

looks.title: 'Urban Sophistication' look (Look 82)
looks.text: Situazione 0101 cape complemented by a Manos 0101 pullover and a Roaschia 3359 silk accessory.

advice: Emphasize the versatility of the robe-style cut: the Situazione model adapts beautifully to any figure, allowing the client to define her own degree of fit with the belt.
Highlight the functionality of the dropped shoulder line: this design detail makes the cape perfect for layered winter looks, comfortably accommodating even bulky knitwear or jackets underneath.
Draw attention to the premium finish: matching fur cuffs are a couture touch that instantly elevates the style and removes the need for elaborate accessories.

objections.q: Мне кажется, что свободный крой капы будет выглядеть слишком громоздко.
objections.a: Продемонстрируйте работу съемного пояса. Он позволяет мягко собрать объем на талии, создавая гармоничный и стройный силуэт «песочные часы».

objections.q: Я опасаюсь, что искусственный мех на манжетах быстро потеряет вид.
objections.a: Уточните, что Luisa Spagnoli использует эко-мех высочайшего качества, который отличается повышенной износостойкостью и сохраняет свою фактуру даже в условиях городской зимы.

objections.q: Будет ли эта модель достаточно теплой для холодной погоды?
objections.a: Сделайте акцент на составе: 80% натуральной шерсти обеспечивают превосходную терморегуляцию. Кроме того, фасон позволяет надеть под низ теплый пуловер Manos.

objections.q: Открытый шалевый воротник кажется непрактичным.
objections.a: Предложите дополнить образ шелковым платком Roaschia 3359. Это не только защитит от ветра, но и добавит образу утонченности, как показано в Look 82.

objections.q: Эта вещь кажется слишком нарядной для повседневной носки.
objections.a: Покажите варианты стилизации с денимом или базовыми брюками. Благодаря лаконичному дизайну, Situazione легко трансформируется из вечернего предмета гардероба в элемент роскошного стиля 'casual luxury'.

322.name: Soana
322.description: The elegant Soana blazer by Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of refined minimalism and flawless Italian style. The piece is defined by clean lines and an understated architectural cut, underscoring the status of the look. A single-breasted closure with a fabric-covered button and classic framed welt pockets create a disciplined yet feminine silhouette. The piece is crafted from a high-quality blend fabric containing natural wool and viscose, ensuring a perfect fit and exceptional comfort. Composition: 83% viscose, 14% natural wool, 3% elastane.

looks.title: Total Look 'Tailored Elegance' (Look 132)
looks.text: Soana 0101 blazer combined with a Lunetta 0101 lace bustier and classic Ortesi 0101 trousers.

looks.title: Total Look 'Tailored Elegance' (Look 132)
looks.text: Soana 0101 blazer combined with a Lunetta 0101 lace bustier and classic Ortesi 0101 trousers.

advice: Direct the client's attention to the versatility of the 'quiet luxury' concept: Soana's minimalist design allows it to be worn equally well to business meetings and formal evening events.
Highlight the value of the fabric composition: the predominance of viscose combined with natural wool makes the blazer exceptionally pleasant to the touch and hard-wearing.
Suggest pairing Soana with the Ortesi 0101 trousers to create a status-defining monochrome suit that visually elongates the silhouette.

objections.q: Дизайн кажется слишком простым и лишенным декоративных деталей.
objections.a: Объясните, что в этом и заключается истинная роскошь — безупречный крой и высокое качество материала Soana говорят сами за себя, не требуя лишних украшений.

objections.q: Застежка на одну пуговицу кажется мне непрактичной.
objections.a: Такой конструктивный прием выбран специально для акцентирования линии талии и придания образу легкости, что делает силуэт более современным и изящным.

objections.q: Меня смущает вискоза в составе, боюсь, что блейзер будет мяться.
objections.a: Наличие 14% высококачественной шерсти и 3% эластана помогает ткани сохранять свою структуру и быстро восстанавливаться после носки, сохраняя безупречный вид.

objections.q: Этот блейзер выглядит слишком официально для моего гардероба.
objections.a: Покажите варианты стайлинга с денимом. Минимализм Soana позволяет легко вписать его в расслабленный городской стиль, добавляя ноту элегантности.

objections.q: Черный цвет слишком консервативен для праздничного выхода.
objections.a: Продемонстрируйте сочетание с кружевным топом Lunetta 0101. Игра контрастных фактур мгновенно переводит классический черный блейзер в разряд эффектной вечерней моды.

323.name: Socio
323.description: This reversible 'aviator'-style jacket is a triumph of functionality and high fashion from Luisa Spagnoli. Crafted from innovative eco-leather with a shearling (montone) effect, offering two radically different yet equally status-defining looks in a single piece. One side presents a smooth texture in a rich chocolate hue, while the reverse reveals a cozy, luxurious beige-toned eco-fur. The architectural double-breasted cut is completed with authentic details: genuine horn buttons, shoulder epaulettes, and contrasting seam finishing that underscores the geometry of the Regular fit silhouette. Composition: 100% polyurethane.

looks.title: 'Urban Aviator' look (Vetrina 9)
looks.text: Socio 0963 1161 jacket combined with a Mity 3374 cardigan, Mano 0202 pullover and wide-leg Olla 1248 jeans.

looks.title: 'Contemporary Chic' look (Look 45)
looks.text: Socio 0963 1161 jacket over an elegant Met 1781 dress to create a play of contrasts between rough leather and soft knitwear.

looks.title: 'Heritage Layers' look (Look 90)
looks.text: Combination of the Socio 0963 1161 jacket with a Merende 2234 jacket, Leonidas 3173 shirt and Onega 1204 trousers.

looks.title: Winter accent look (Look 137)
looks.text: Socio 0963 1161 jacket complemented by Olap 1168 trousers, Urial 0952 gloves and Uragano A 0986 ankle boots. Final touch — Xariel A 3307 0002 glasses.

advice: Emphasize the 'two-in-one' concept: the reversible design of Socio allows the client to invest in a single piece while gaining two complete looks — a bold leather aesthetic and a soft fur one.
Highlight the relevance of the military-aviator style. This is a timeless trend of the winter season, which in Luisa Spagnoli's interpretation gains an aristocratic refinement.
Recommend Socio for layered looks: the relaxed regular fit comfortably accommodates jackets such as Merende, or voluminous knitwear, underneath.

objections.q: Это полностью синтетический материал (100% полиуретан).
objections.a: Объясните, что современные высокотехнологичные материалы от Luisa Spagnoli превосходят натуральную овчину по износостойкости, легкости и устойчивости к влаге, обеспечивая при этом великолепную теплоизоляцию.

objections.q: Двубортный крой «авиатор» может выглядеть слишком массивно.
objections.a: Продемонстрируйте Look 45, где Socio сочетается с женственным платьем Met. Вертикальные линии застежки и отточенные детали швов структурируют силуэт, предотвращая эффект громоздкости.

objections.q: Будет ли удобно носить его меховой стороной внутрь?
objections.a: Уточните, что лекала разработаны специально с учетом реверсивности. Ворс эко-меха обладает антистатическим эффектом, что гарантирует комфорт при соприкосновении с любой одеждой.

objections.q: Светлый мех на воротнике и манжетах быстро испачкается.
objections.a: Материал прошел специальную обработку, которая облегчает чистку. В отличие от натурального меха, этот состав не боится влажной уборки и сохраняет яркость оттенка 1161.

objections.q: Этот фасон подходит только для спортивного стиля.
objections.a: Покажите детали: пуговицы под рог и геральдическую точность отделки. Это позволяет сочетать Socio даже с классическими брюками Olap, создавая образ в стиле 'luxury casual'.

327.name: Solvente
327.description: This exquisite Solvente blazer from Luisa Spagnoli is the true embodiment of evening elegance and flawless Italian style. Crafted from a luxurious blend of silk and viscose with a soft, velvety texture that creates a deep play of light. Particular refinement is lent by flat contrasting piping, which graphically underscores the architecture of the cut. A single-breasted closure with a fabric-covered button, classic revers a lancia lapels, and flap pockets form a status-defining, feminine Regular fit silhouette. Fabric composition: 79% viscose, 18% silk, 3% elastane.

looks.title: 'Sapphire Night' look (Look 120/121)
looks.text: Solvente 1221 1221 blazer in an impeccable monochrome ensemble with a Logge 1221 top and Offida 1221 trousers. Accent — Ialofane 1227 0002 bag or Iglesias B 0244 0001 0001.

looks.title: 'Ruby Power' look (Look 121A/122/124)
looks.text: Solvente 2446 2446 jacket combined with a Lezioni 2446 top and matching Offida 2446 trousers. Final touch — Iglesias B 0244 0001 0001 bag or Ialofane 2446 0002.

advice: Direct the client's attention to the exceptional composition: the noble blend of silk and viscose delivers a luxurious appearance and the incredible softness of the velvet texture.
Suggest creating a complete monochrome ensemble with the Offida trousers — this styling trick visually elongates the silhouette and embodies the 'Quiet Luxury' concept.
Focus on the details: the contrast piping is a hallmark of fine tailoring that sets the Solvente model apart from ordinary blazers.

objections.q: Silk and viscose velvet may be too delicate to care for.
objections.a: Reassure the client by explaining that the use of high-tech viscose combined with silk makes the fabric more resistant to abrasion, while preserving its couture-level sheen.

objections.q: The blazer looks too dressy for everyday wear.
objections.a: Demonstrate how effortlessly Solvente adapts to Smart Casual: simply swap the silk top for a clean, minimal base, and the blazer becomes a striking accent to an urban wardrobe.

objections.q: The single-button closure may not provide adequate hold.
objections.a: Clarify that this design was chosen specifically to create a light, contemporary silhouette. The fabric-covered button accentuates the waist without adding bulk to the front of the garment.

objections.q: I'm afraid this type of fabric will wrinkle badly.
objections.a: The 3% elastane in the composition helps the velvet recover its shape more quickly after wear, preventing deep creases from forming.

objections.q: Ruby shade 2446 seems too bold.
objections.a: Showcase the play of texture in the velvet: this deep hue, rendered in the Solvente fabric, unfolds with noble, luxurious depth, becoming the focal point of any look.

329.name: Soppalco
329.description: This luxurious car coat from Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of contemporary classicism and flawless Italian taste. Crafted from a dense, warm wool-blend cloth (80% wool, 20% polyester), providing perfect protection from the winter chill. The architectural cut is accentuated by raglan sleeves, which soften the shoulder line and allow for comfortable layered looks. Understated flat buttons in genuine horn and functional patch pockets lend the piece refinement, while sleeves that flare toward the cuff add dynamism and femininity to the silhouette. The Regular fit ensures flawless elegance in any setting.

looks.title: 'Urban Sand' look (Look 1)
looks.text: Soppalco 1153 caban combined with a Linosa 3286 shirt and classic Optare 3326 trousers. The ensemble is completed by an Iago 2240 0002 bag.

looks.title: 'Sophisticated Eggplant' look (Vetrina 9 / Look 80)
looks.text: Soppalco 0733 caban with a Messier 1936 pullover and Opaglio 0927 trousers. Details: Uboldo 0752 0002 gloves.

looks.title: 'Bluette Layers' look (Look 88)
looks.text: Soppalco 2527 caban over a Caserta 2544 pullover with a Fabula 0101 skirt. Addition — Rotterdam 0101 cap.

advice: Emphasize the raglan sleeves: this structural feature ensures a perfect fit on any shoulder type, allowing freedom of movement even when worn over a warm jacket.
Suggest the vibrant shades 2527 and 0733 as the perfect way to refresh a winter wardrobe, underscoring status through the premium texture of the wool cloth.
Draw attention to the details: buttons crafted from natural horn are a mark of quality and a testament to Luisa Spagnoli's commitment to tradition.

objections.q: I feel that the cropped kaban style won't be warm enough for winter.
objections.a: Explain that the dense wool cloth (80% wool) offers excellent thermal insulation, and the relaxed cut allows for layering underneath with a voluminous pullover, such as Caserta 2544, for extra warmth.

objections.q: The wide-cuffed sleeves seem impractical — they may let in the wind.
objections.a: Suggest completing the look with the Uboldo 0752 0002 long gloves. This not only guards against the cold but also creates a luxurious, aristocratic silhouette.

objections.q: I prefer a fully natural composition without polyester.
objections.a: Clarify that the 20% technical fibers were added specifically to help the coat retain its architectural shape, resisting deformation and pilling with wear.

objections.q: Cornflower blue shade 2527 is too bright for outerwear.
objections.a: Showcase Look 88, where this shade is balanced by the neutral black Fabula 0101 skirt, turning the kaban into an elegant accent to the outfit.

objections.q: The patch pockets may visually add bulk to the figure.
objections.a: Point out that the pockets sit at the optimal height and are balanced by the raglan sleeves, which harmonizes the proportions and preserves a slender silhouette.

330.name: Soresina
330.description: The quilted Soresina down coat from Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of contemporary winter luxury, uniting functionality with high aesthetics. Crafted from a high-tech blend of polyester and polyamide, ensuring perfect protection from the elements and lasting durability. A refined accent is lent by a detachable, tone-matched soft eco-fur collar, which instantly elevates the practical piece into a status-defining wardrobe item. Particular attention is drawn to the couture finishing: buttons covered in woven eco-leather and a concealed lining with an animal-print motif, adding a note of boldness and individuality to the look. Side vents underscore the dynamic character of the Regular fit silhouette.

looks.title: Total Look 'Urban Elegance' (Look 152)
looks.text: Soresina 0101 0101 down jacket paired with a Manos 0101 pullover and wide-leg Oneta 0101 trousers. Accent — Damiana 0101 0002 belt.

looks.title: Total Look 'Sophisticated Casual' (Look 83/84)
looks.text: Soresina 0101 0101 model combined with a white Lucinda 0201 shirt (Data missing in official sources), a basic Manos 0101 pullover and Overt 0101 leather trousers.

looks.title: Total Look 'Modern Heritage' (Look 87)
looks.text: Soresina 0101 0101 down jacket over a Marius 3426 pullover with a Bacche 0201 shirt and Opacita 1268 trousers.

advice: Direct the client's attention to the details: buttons wrapped in braided eco-leather are a hallmark of fine tailoring that sets Soresina apart from ordinary down jackets.
Demonstrate the functionality of the detachable fur collar: it allows the piece to be adapted for both casual daytime outings and elegant evening occasions.
Focus on 'hidden luxury': the animal-print lining is a secret touch of the collection that reflects the client's fashion-savvy sensibility.

objections.q: I feel that the quilted down jacket will visually add extra volume.
objections.a: Point out the side slits and the carefully considered regular-fit silhouette, which structure the figure and allow ease of movement without weighing down the look.

objections.q: I prefer 100% natural fur.
objections.a: Explain that the eco-fur used, by Luisa Spagnoli, is not only ethical but also outperforms natural fur in durability, retaining its flawless texture even in high humidity.

objections.q: The synthetic fabric composition may be less durable.
objections.a: Emphasize that the polyester-and-polyamide blend is the technical standard for premium outerwear, guaranteeing wind resistance and shape retention over many seasons.

objections.q: This down jacket looks too plain in black.
objections.a: Highlight the play of textures: the matte quilted fabric contrasts with the sheen of the eco-fur and the woven button details, creating a rich, multi-dimensional look.

objections.q: Would this style be appropriate with a business suit?
objections.a: Thanks to its aristocratic details and detachable collar, Soresina pairs beautifully with the tailored Oneta 0101 trousers, striking a balance between formality and comfort.

331.name: Soriano
331.description: Soriano is the embodiment of daring elegance and a contemporary reading of Luisa Spagnoli's classic codes. This luxurious winter jacket is crafted from high-quality faux fur with a striking 'animalier' spotted print, one of the season's key trends. The architectural cut is accentuated by a wide, deep-black contrasting collar, lending the piece particular graphic quality and aristocratic character. The piece is completed with a classic button closure and an exquisite satin lining, ensuring a perfect fit and exceptional comfort in wear. Fabric composition: 79% modacrylic, 21% polyester.

looks.title: Total Look 'Urban Safari' (Look 149)
looks.text: Soriano 3439 0101 0101 jacket paired with a Manos F 0101 cashmere pullover, trendy Oneta 0101 eco-leather trousers and Urbana 0101 leather ankle boots.

looks.title: Total Look 'Contrast Chic' (Look 83/84)
looks.text: Soriano 3439 0101 0101 jacket over a classic white Lucinda 0201 shirt (Data missing in official sources) in an ensemble with a Manos 0101 pullover and Oneta 0101 trousers.

advice: Direct the client's attention to the quality of the fur: Luisa Spagnoli's modern modacrylic is not only ethical, but also surpasses natural fur in lightness and moisture resistance.
Recommend Soriano as the perfect way to integrate an animal print into an everyday wardrobe — the black collar lends the piece a status-appropriate, understated elegance.
Suggest this model for creating 'Smart Casual' layered looks, pairing it with denim or leather to achieve a modern-luxury effect.

objections.q: I'm afraid the leopard print will look too bold.
objections.a: Point out the considered design: the wide solid-color collar and classic regular-fit silhouette »˜tame ' the print, elevating it to an aristocratic accent.

objections.q: Is this jacket warm enough for real winter weather?
objections.a: Clarify that Soriano falls into the warm outerwear category. Its high-density pile and satin lining provide excellent thermal insulation while keeping the piece lightweight.

objections.q: Faux fur might lose its look after just one season.
objections.a: Emphasize the brand's premium-quality materials. Modacrylic is prized for its high durability and its ability to retain its original sheen and softness even with extended wear.

objections.q: The cropped cut may visually widen the hips.
objections.a: Suggest trying the jacket with the Oneta trousers. The vertical closure line and clean shoulder line harmonize the proportions, creating a slender silhouette.

objections.q: This fur feels too dressy for everyday life.
objections.a: Showcase Look 149 with the essential Manos pullover. This proves that Soriano is a versatile piece that adapts effortlessly to an urban style.

332.name: Sostenuto
332.description: Sostenuto is the quintessence of evening elegance, embodied in a refined top-jacket from Luisa Spagnoli. Crafted from a high-quality blend of viscose and elastane, ensuring a soft sheen and a perfect fit. The principal stylistic accent is long sleeves in exquisite sheer lace, creating a play of textures and adding a note of aristocratic character to the look. The wrap construction (a portafoglio) is completed with an integrated decorative brooch that delicately secures the draping and accentuates the waistline. An understated bateau neckline completes this status-defining, feminine Regular fit silhouette. Composition: 95% viscose, 5% elastane.

looks.title: Total Look 'Sophisticated Noir' (Look 132 / Vetrina 132)
looks.text: Sophisticated Sostenuto 0101 top in an ensemble with elegant Olino 0101 trousers. The look is complemented by a luxurious Situazione 0101 cape and an Ialofane 0101 0002 evening clutch.

advice: Emphasize the lace sleeves: a key element of the 'night-out' wardrobe that allows for an elevated look without extra effort or additional accessories.
Recommend Sostenuto as a versatile investment: thanks to its understated black color and wrap-style cut, the top pairs equally well with tailored trousers or voluminous skirts.
Draw the client's attention to the integrated brooch — this detail removes the need to select jewelry and underscores the exclusivity of Luisa Spagnoli's design.

333.name: Spareggio
333.description: This luxurious Spareggio jacket from Luisa Spagnoli is a contemporary reading of military style, reimagined through the lens of high Italian fashion. Crafted from 100% high-quality natural leather with a pronounced grain texture, lending the piece a noble appearance and lasting durability. The architectural double-breasted cut is accentuated by exquisite tone-matched leather-covered buttons, while raglan sleeves ensure unparalleled comfort and softness in the shoulder line. The piece's key feature is an integrated waist drawcord, allowing the silhouette to be instantly transformed from a relaxed 'boxy' shape into an elegantly fitted one, underscoring the femininity of the look.

looks.title: Total Look 'Urban Safari' (Look 48)
looks.text: Spareggio 0996 jacket in a striking combination with the Magnesite 3568 pullover and Fidente 0996 leather skirt to create a textured monochromatic ensemble.

looks.title: Total Look 'Contemporary Heritage' (Look 49)
looks.text: Spareggio 0996 combination with a classic Liceali 3200 shirt and tailored Odini 1789 trousers.

looks.title: Total Look 'Casual Luxury' (Look 47)
looks.text: Spareggio 0996 jacket over a Cremona 3349 pullover paired with a Formazione 0996 skirt (Data not available in official sources).

advice: Emphasize the model's versatility: thanks to the adjustable waist drawstring, Spareggio adapts to any figure, allowing for both relaxed and more structured looks.
Highlight the status of the material — the use of natural grain-textured leather places this model among the wardrobe's investment pieces, which only grow more beautiful with age.
Recommend pairing different leather textures (as shown in Look 48) to showcase the season's key trend of layering and textural play.

objections.q: I feel the leather jacket may be too heavy.
objections.a: Clarify that the raglan sleeve cut distributes weight evenly across the shoulders, while the softness of the leather ensures ease and freedom of movement.

objections.q: The double-breasted cut visually widens the figure.
objections.a: Demonstrate how the waist drawstring works: it instantly removes excess volume, creating a clean, feminine silhouette.

objections.q: Brown shade 0996 is difficult to pair with other tones.
objections.a: Show Look 49, where this noble shade harmonizes with the pastel palette of the Liceali shirt, becoming a neutral, stylish base.

objections.q: Leather requires overly complex care.
objections.a: This model's grained texture is exceptionally resistant to minor scratches and abrasions, making Spareggio the ideal choice for an active city life.

objections.q: This style looks too sporty for a classic wardrobe.
objections.a: Point out the details: the leather-covered buttons and welt pockets lend the jacket an aristocratic feel, allowing it to be worn even with the classic Odini trousers.

334.name: Spartiti
334.description: This exquisite Spartiti leather jacket from Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of contemporary aristocratic style and flawless Italian taste. Crafted from 100% high-quality natural leather with a noble texture that underscores the piece's elevated status. The architectural cut with raglan sleeves ensures softness of line and absolute freedom of movement, while a classic notched collar lends the look structure. Striking flap patch pockets and contrasting seam finishing demonstrate the highest level of tailoring craftsmanship. The finishing touch is a metal zip closure with the signature logo and an elasticated gathered hem, creating an on-trend, dynamic silhouette.

looks.title: Total Look 'Urban Aristocracy' (Look 222)
looks.text: Spartiti 0101 jacket in a striking combination with a striped Liceali 3324 shirt and wide-leg Olla 1073 jeans. The look is completed by Uramaky 0101 loafers.

looks.title: Look 'Sophisticated Heritage' (Vetrina 17)
looks.text: Spartiti 0101 combination with a silk Linosa 3352 blouse and classic Occulto 2202 trousers.

advice: Direct the client's attention to the investment value: a jacket made from 100% natural leather is a timeless classic that grows ever more distinguished with age.
Highlight the versatility of the raglan sleeve — an ideal structural solution that ensures a flawless fit for any shoulder type and allows the jacket to be effortlessly layered with chunky knitwear.

Recommend Spartiti as a luxurious alternative to the classic blazer — thanks to its notch collar and patch pockets, it reads as suitably understated for the city while remaining thoroughly contemporary.

objections.q: I'm afraid the leather jacket will be too heavy.
objections.a: Clarify that Luisa Spagnoli uses a specially tanned leather that, despite its density, remains remarkably light and supple, ensuring comfort throughout the day.

objections.q: This style looks too sporty.
objections.a: Showcase the finishing details: the leather buttons and delicate seams elevate Spartiti from sportswear into »˜luxury casual ' territory, suitable even for the office.

objections.q: The gathered hem may visually add bulk to the hips.
objections.a: On the contrary, this cut combined with the raglan sleeves creates a modern hourglass silhouette, harmonizing the proportions and accentuating the waist.

objections.q: Black leather feels too aggressive.
objections.a: Suggest pairing it with the soft pastel tones of the Linosa blouses. The contrast between leather and silk softens the look, lending it refinement.

objections.q: Leather requires complex professional care.
objections.a: This particular leather is prized for its high durability and resistance to external elements. Stored properly on a hanger, the piece will retain its pristine look for many seasons.

336.name: Spettatore
336.description: The flawless double-breasted Spettatore jacket from Luisa Spagnoli is an ode to classic style, reimagined through the lens of contemporary luxury. Crafted from an exquisite blended tweed, where noble wool is harmoniously interwoven with delicate cotton and precious silk, creating a distinctive texture and subtle shimmer. The architectural fitted silhouette (linea sfiancata) and classic lapels underscore the status of the look, while angled framed welt pockets add dynamism and refinement. Fabric composition: 35% polyester, 25% acrylic, 15% wool, 13% cotton, 10% silk.

looks.title: Total Look 'City Heritage' (Look 60)
looks.text: Spettatore 3331 jacket in an ensemble with a classic Lucinda 0201 shirt, Manos 2246 pullover and Facoltoso 3331 skirt (Data not available in official sources). The look is accessorized with: Renno 0814 cap and Iago 2240 0002 bag.

looks.title: Total Look 'Sophisticated Textures' (Look 59)
looks.text: Combination of the Spettatore 3331 jacket with a sleek Logge 1133 top and Faggi 3331 skirt.

looks.title: Total Look 'Classic Elegance' (Look 151/154)
looks.text: Spettatore 3331 jacket over a Lucinda 0201 shirt with a Facoltoso 3331 skirt (Data not available in official sources) and Renno 0814 cap.

advice: Direct the client's attention to the composition: the addition of 10% natural silk gives the Spettatore tweed a distinctive softness and delicate sheen unattainable in ordinary wool tweed.
Recommend this model as a key piece of the 'Day-to-Night' wardrobe — the fitted cut and richly textured fabric make the jacket equally suited to the office and evening occasions.
Suggest creating a layered look with the Manos pullover to highlight the interplay of different knit and woven textures, a signature of the Luisa Spagnoli style.

objections.q: Tweed jackets often look too heavy and bulky.
objections.a: Point out the carefully tailored, regular-fit cut. The use of lightweight cotton and silk in the composition makes the Spettatore jacket remarkably supple and comfortable.

objections.q: The double-breasted closure may visually widen the silhouette.
objections.a: Thanks to the pronounced waistline (linea sfiancata) and the angled placement of the pockets, the jacket instead structures the figure, creating harmonious proportions.

objections.q: I'm concerned about the presence of synthetic fibers in the composition.
objections.a: The use of high-tech polyester and acrylic is essential for maintaining the intricate structure of the tweed weave, ensuring durability and protection against deformation while preserving all the qualities of natural wool and silk.

objections.q: This color (Grigio Panna) may be impractical.
objections.a: The melange texture of the tweed in this colorway is one of the most versatile: it beautifully conceals minor imperfections and serves as an ideal neutral backdrop for bold accessories or monochrome looks.

objections.q: Tweed is too conservative a fabric.
objections.a: Showcase the contemporary styling options from the lookbook, such as pairing it with preppy-style accessories (the Renno cap, to give the look a current, urban character.

337.name: Spidy
337.description: The elegant cropped Spidy jacket from Luisa Spagnoli is the quintessence of 'bon ton' style, reimagined for the contemporary woman. Crafted from a luxurious textured bouclÃ© (tessuto armaturato), lending the piece noble volume and depth. The architectural cut is accentuated by small, neat lapels and exquisite framed welt pockets. The principal decorative accent is radiant spherical buttons in gold-tone metal, which elevate the jacket to the status of a jewelry piece within the wardrobe. Fabric composition: 48% polyester, 26% acrylic, 20% wool, 3% cotton, 2% polyamide, 1% viscose.

looks.title: Look 'Sophisticated Urban' (Vetrina 56)
looks.text: Spidy 0101 jacket over a classic Limonaia E 0101 blouse in an ensemble with a Fioraliso 0101 skirt and the iconic Iago 0101 0002 bag.

looks.title: Look 'Sophisticated Urban' (Vetrina 56)
looks.text: Spidy 0101 jacket over a classic Limonaia E 0101 blouse in an ensemble with a Fioraliso 0101 skirt and the iconic Iago 0101 0002 bag.

looks.title: Look 'Formal Contrast' (Vetrina 110)
looks.text: Combination of the Spidy 0101 model with a Lidia 0202 blouse (URL) (Data not available in official sources for URL) and Orville 0101 trousers (URL) (Data not available in official sources for URL).

advice: Direct the client's attention to the cropped length: an ideal technique for visually elongating the legs, especially when paired with high-waisted skirts and trousers.
Highlight the value of the gold-tone hardware: the spherical buttons are a signature detail of the brand that eliminates the need for additional accessories near the face.
Suggest Spidy as a versatile investment: thanks to its black color and classic bouclé texture, the jacket transitions effortlessly from an office essential to an evening ensemble.

objections.q: I worry that the cropped style will look too casual.
objections.a: On the contrary, thanks to the structured bouclé fabric and gold buttons, Spidy reads as extremely polished. Showcase Look 246, where the jacket creates a sharp, elegant silhouette.

objections.q: The fabric composition contains synthetic fibers.
objections.a: Explain that the complex blended composition is essential for maintaining the bouclé's unique architectural form. Polyester and acrylic guarantee durability and prevent the jacket from losing its shape with wear.

objections.q: The gold buttons seem too flashy.
objections.a: Emphasize that this is a key trend of the season. They »˜illuminate ' the black fabric, lending the look a more dynamic, contemporary feel and standing in for a brooch or necklace.

objections.q: I'll find it hard to pair this jacket with trousers.
objections.a: Recommend trying it with classic high-waisted trousers. The jacket's cropped cut harmonizes the proportions, creating a modern »˜power dressing ' silhouette.

338.name: Spillatrice
338.description: The cropped Spillatrice car coat is a refined reading of winter classicism from Luisa Spagnoli, uniting architectural discipline with cozy luxury. Crafted from a high-quality wool blend in a traditional herringbone pattern (spigato), which serves as the flawless backdrop for striking wide lapels. The piece's principal accent is a collar trimmed with soft faux fur, lending the look an aristocratic quality and additional protection from the cold. A dropped shoulder line and patch pockets underscore the contemporary, relaxed character of the Regular fit silhouette, while fabric-covered buttons complete this status-defining ensemble. Composition: 34% wool, 28% acrylic, 19% virgin wool, 16% polyester, 3% other fibers.

looks.title: Look 'Urban Heritage' (Look 54)
looks.text: Spillatrice 3470 0913 coat in combination with a Macaria 0101 polo and classic Odini 0101 trousers ( Data not available in official sources). Accent — Iago 2240 0002 bag.

looks.title: Look 'Sophisticated Layers' (Look 55)
looks.text: Spillatrice 3470 0913 coat over an ensemble of a Lucinda 0201 shirt (Data not available in official sources), Manos F 0101 pullover and Morolo 0101 skirt. Final touch — Ls1928p A 0101 0038 bag.

advice: Emphasize the interplay of textures: the combination of herringbone wool cloth and voluminous eco-fur is a key styling device of the season, underscoring the piece's premium status.
Recommend Spillatrice as a versatile foundation for layered looks: thanks to the dropped-shoulder cut, chunky knitwear such as Manos F can be worn comfortably underneath the coat.
Highlight the advantageous length: the cropped car-coat silhouette visually elongates the figure, especially when paired with high-waisted trousers, creating an on-trend 'contemporary classic' look.

objections.q: The fabric composition contains synthetic fibers (acrylic and polyester).
objections.a: Explain that the complex blended composition is essential to maintain the distinctive graphic herringbone pattern and prevent the fabric from losing shape, while the high natural wool content (over 50%) guarantees warmth and comfort.

objections.q: I feel the cropped style won't be warm enough for winter.
objections.a: Point out the density of the wool cloth and the fur lapels, which securely protect the neck and chest area. The style is designed for an active city life and is ideal for driving.

objections.q: I prefer only natural fur.
objections.a: Emphasize the brand's ethical stance and the exceptional quality of the eco-fur (faux fur) used, which is tactilely and visually indistinguishable from natural fur, yet more durable and moisture-resistant.

objections.q: The dropped shoulder line may make the figure look too voluminous.
objections.a: Demonstrate how this constructive detail, combined with the cropped length, creates the right proportions, adding a note of French chic and effortlessness to the look.

objections.q: The herringbone pattern looks too traditional.
objections.a: Point out the contemporary contrast of black, white, and brown (3470 0913). The fur trim and the on-trend kaban cut instantly elevate this classic pattern into high fashion territory.

348.name: Strass
348.description: The cropped Strass jacket from Luisa Spagnoli is the embodiment of refined evening fashion and flawless Italian taste. Crafted from a luxurious blend of viscose and silk with a soft, velvety texture that creates a deep play of light. The architectural cut, with a round neckline and an elegantly rounded hem, underscores the femininity of the silhouette, while tone-matched buttons complete this status-defining look. Functional framed welt pockets add practicality to the piece while preserving the purity of the Regular fit lines. Fabric composition: 79% viscose, 18% silk, 3% elastane.

looks.title: Look 'Midnight Velvet' (Look 126)
looks.text: Strass 0101 jacket in combination with a classic Lidia 0101 shirt (Data not available in official sources) and Orfano 0101 trousers (Data not available in official sources). Accent — Ialofane 0993 0002 bag.

looks.title: Look 'Evening Sophistication' (Look 264)
looks.text: Strass 0101 jacket over a white Localita 0201 shirt with elegant Offida 0101 trousers. Additions: Iroise 0101 0002 bag, Norico 0001 0002 earrings, Norreni 0001 0002 bracelet and Unica A 0101 0002 shoes.

advice: Emphasize the distinctive composition: the presence of natural silk lends Strass velvet an incomparable softness and noble sheen characteristic of haute couture pieces.
Recommend this jacket as the perfect investment for an evening wardrobe — its cropped length and minimalist design allow for endless festive styling possibilities.
Suggest pairing it with the Offida 0101 trousers to create a status-defining monochrome ensemble in the 'quiet luxury' spirit.

objections.q: Velvet feels too demanding and complicated for everyday wear.
objections.a: Showcase Look 264, where the Strass jacket pairs beautifully with a basic white shirt. This proves the piece can serve as an elegant accent even in more understated city looks.

objections.q: The cropped style may visually shorten the figure.
objections.a: On the contrary, thanks to its rounded hem and regular-fit cut, the Strass jacket accentuates the waistline. Paired with high-waisted trousers such as Offida, it visually elongates the legs.

objections.q: I'm afraid silk velvet is very demanding to care for.
objections.a: Emphasize the exceptional quality of Luisa Spagnoli's materials. The addition of technical viscose and elastane makes the fabric more resistant to creasing and helps the piece retain its impeccable shape for many seasons.

objections.q: Black feels too conservative.
objections.a: Point out the play of textures: the deep black in velvet »˜comes alive ' in the light, becoming a rich, luxurious backdrop for gold or crystal accessories.

objections.q: I find it hard to imagine what else to wear this jacket with.
objections.a: Recommend wearing Strass over lightweight silk dresses or even paired with dark denim. Its clean, round-neck cut makes it one of the most versatile pieces in the evening collection.

353.name: Summit
353.description: The quilted Summit coat from Luisa Spagnoli is a flawless union of functionality and high fashion. Crafted from a high-tech water-repellent fabric, the piece masterfully reimagines the classic trench silhouette for the winter season. The architectural cut is accentuated by a double-breasted closure, an elegant mantellina yoke at the back, and a functional storm flap. Particular status is lent to the piece by a luxurious detachable eco-fur collar, while an integrated belt allows the waistline to be perfectly accentuated, creating a feminine Regular fit silhouette. Composition: 100% polyester.

looks.title: Look 'Elegant Noir' (Look 151)
looks.text: Summit 0101 coat in an ensemble with Ulisside 0101 0038 boots, Ricci 0101 hat and Uboldo 0101 0002 leather gloves. Additional accent — Navoncella earrings (Data not available in official sources for URL).

looks.title: Look 'Cioccolato Chic' (Look 172)
looks.text: Summit 0987 coat in combination with Uragano A 0986 ankle boots. Accents: Nagorno 0002 earrings and Xariel A 3307 0002 glasses.

looks.title: Layered look 'Urban Mint' (Look 98)
looks.text: Summit 0987 coat over Mirko 0506 and Manografo 0506 pullovers paired with Overt 0978 leather trousers and a Muni 0970 cap.

advice: Direct the client's attention to the unique '2-in-1' design: the Summit model combines the elegance of a timeless trench with the protection of a winter coat.
Highlight the value of the details: the detachable fur collar and back yoke allow the piece to be adapted to a wide range of occasions — from business meetings to evening events.
Focus on the practicality of the technical fabric: it not only reads as high-status, but also offers excellent water-repellent properties, ideal for an active city lifestyle.

objections.q: This coat is made of polyester; I prefer natural wool.
objections.a: Clarify that this is a next-generation, high-tech material. It offers a noble matte sheen and superior wind- and moisture-resistant properties that wool cloth cannot match.

objections.q: I feel the quilted cut will visually add volume.
objections.a: Point out the integrated-belt construction. It clearly structures the silhouette and accentuates the waist, preserving a slender figure.

objections.q: The double-breasted closure and epaulettes look too formal.
objections.a: On the contrary, these details evoke an aristocratic »˜heritage ' style. Showcase Look 98, where Summit is paired with vibrant knitwear, creating a relaxed, »˜luxury casual ' look.

objections.q: Will this style be warm enough for real frost?
objections.a: The Summit coat is fitted with modern insulation and finished with an eco-fur collar, which, combined with the dense fabric, provides outstanding thermal protection.

objections.q: Shade 0987 (Cioccolato) may be difficult to pair.
objections.a: This is one of the season's most coveted shades. It pairs beautifully with both classic black and the soft mint or pastel tones featured in the Luisa Spagnoli knitwear collection.

354.name: Supporre
354.description: Supporre is a triumph of winter elegance, presenting a flawless interpretation of the classic trench in a luxurious eco-shearling execution. The piece is defined by an architectural double-breasted cut, harmoniously completed with authentic details: a protective frangipioggia storm flap, an integrated belt for accentuating the waist, and exquisite cuffs. The soft texture of the ecomontone not only delivers exceptional warmth for the cold season but also underscores Luisa Spagnoli's commitment to contemporary aesthetics and comfort. The Regular fit silhouette ensures a flawless fit, making this piece a key element of the 'quiet luxury' wardrobe. Composition: 94% polyester, 6% elastane.

looks.title: Total Look 'Evening Sophistication' (Look 36)

looks.title: Total Look 'Urban Textures' (Look 98)
looks.text: Supporre 0995 trench coat in an ensemble with Mirko 0506 and Manografo 0506 pullovers, completed by Overt 0978 leather trousers.

advice: Emphasize the concept of ethical luxury: Luisa Spagnoli's eco-shearling combines the noble aesthetic of natural sheepskin with the practicality and lightness of modern materials.
Recommend Supporre as a 'Day-to-Night' investment piece — thanks to its classic trench silhouette, the model is equally at home in business and evening settings.
Highlight the functionality: the wind-guard placket and belt allow the fit and level of warmth to be adjusted, adapting the piece to any weather condition.

objections.q: Eco-fur may look insufficiently prestigious.
objections.a: This is a next-generation, high-tech material, visually and tactilely indistinguishable from natural shearling, underscoring the client's contemporary and conscious choice.

objections.q: I'm afraid the light shade 2328 will be impractical.
objections.a: The Supporre material is highly durable and easier to professionally maintain than natural leather, retaining its pristine look for many seasons.

objections.q: The double-breasted cut visually adds volume.
objections.a: On the contrary, the structural lines of the wind flap and the belt clearly define the silhouette, creating harmonious proportions and accentuating the waist.

objections.q: Will the trench be warm enough for real winter?
objections.a: This style falls into the »˜capo spalla pesanti ' (heavy outerwear) category. The dense eco-shearling texture provides outstanding thermal insulation, protecting against cold and wind.

objections.q: The long silhouette may restrict movement.
objections.a: The regular-fit silhouette and thoughtfully engineered pattern ensure complete freedom of movement, making Supporre an ideal choice for both walking and driving.

356.name: Svolta
356.description: The cropped Svolta jacket from Luisa Spagnoli is the quintessence of 'bon ton' style, reimagined for the contemporary woman. Crafted from an exquisite textured bouclÃ© wool blend (35% polyester, 25% acrylic, 15% wool, 13% cotton, 10% silk), lending the piece noble volume and a refined shimmer. The architectural cut is accentuated by neat, small lapels and exquisite framed welt pockets. The principal decorative accent is the iconic buttons bearing the LS heraldic logo, which elevate the jacket to the status of a true work of Italian tailoring artistry. The cropped length and Regular fit ensure a flawless silhouette and versatility in styling.

advice: Direct the client's attention to the jacket's cropped length: an ideal technique for visually elongating the leg line, especially when paired with high-waisted bottoms.
Highlight the value of the heraldic buttons: they serve as a jewelry-like touch that allows for minimal use of additional accessories while preserving the look's overall luxury.
Focus on the sophisticated fabric composition: the presence of 10% natural silk gives the material exceptional softness and the noble play of light characteristic of the luxury segment.

383.name: Casilda
383.description: This 'bon ton' top is the true embodiment of Luisa Spagnoli's refined aesthetic. Crafted from a noble blend of pure wool and cashmere, it envelops the wearer in softness and delivers exceptional comfort. The piece is defined by a flawless round neckline and elegant short sleeves, lending the look lightness and femininity. Particular charm is lent by contrasting edge trim, underscoring the graphic quality of the silhouette and the brand's attention to detail. Thanks to its Regular fit, this top sits perfectly on the figure, becoming an indispensable element of both the classic and the more contemporary wardrobe.

looks.text: For Casilda 0838 0202: Lookbook: The official total look offer includes a combination with Cuoricino jacket 0838 0202 and Osten E 0209 trousers.

Visual merchandising (Windows): On mannequins (Bambola 1) in showcases No. 27 and No. 27 A, the top is presented in layered looks with a Cuoricino jacket 0838 0202, Osten trousers 0202 and outerwear --- coat Super 0202 or caban Vigilante 0202. - For the Casilda 2203 option 0372:

looks.title: Lookbook
looks.text: The designers offer an elegant ensemble with the Cuoricino 2203 0372 jacket and Fenice B 2226 skirt.

advice: 1. Tactile excellence: Direct the client's attention to the wool and cashmere composition. This is not merely a garment, but an investment in unparalleled comfort and softness characteristic of the premium segment. 2. The Twin-Set concept: Suggest pairing the model with the matching Cuoricino cardigan. This combination creates a polished, status-defining look in the finest tradition of Italian style. 3. Bon Ton versatility: Highlight that, thanks to the contrast trim and clean-lined cut, the top adapts effortlessly — from a formal office dress code with the Osten trousers to a romantic evening look with the Fenice B skirt.

objections.q: The short sleeve isn't suitable for the cold season.
objections.a: Explain that the wool-and-cashmere blend provides excellent thermoregulation, and the piece is ideal for creating layered looks under a jacket or coat.

objections.q: The look is too classic.
objections.a: Point out the contrasting trim details, which lend the piece a modern, graphic accent, allowing it to be paired with on-trend denim styles or bold accessories.

objections.q: The composition is difficult to care for.
objections.a: Remind the client of the exceptional quality of Luisa Spagnoli's yarn; with proper care, the delicate wool-and-cashmere blend retains its shape and softness for years.

objections.q: Concerns about the regular fit.
objections.a: Reassure the client that the brand's pattern is designed to ensure freedom of movement without compromising the elegance of the silhouette, making the piece comfortable for any body type.

objections.q: The need to purchase a second piece (a cardigan).
objections.a: Demonstrate the top's self-sufficiency as a standalone piece: thanks to its finishing details, it looks complete even without a jacket layered on top.

384.name: Casistica
384.description: This luxurious pullover from Luisa Spagnoli is the true embodiment of artistic elegance and uncompromising comfort. Masterfully crafted from a noble blend of wool and cashmere, it delivers the gentlest touch against the skin and exceptional warmth. The piece is defined by a classic round neckline and a flawless Regular fit, making it a versatile foundation for any look. The principal decorative accent is striking contrasting embroidery, which transforms the understated silhouette into a true art object, while ribbed edge finishing at the hem (fondo a coste) ensures a perfect fit and finished form.

looks.text: Для варианта Casistica 1151 1181: Lookbook: Дизайнеры предлагают сочетать модель с пальто Segnalibro 3335 и вельветовыми брюками Olap 1119.

Витрины (Bambola): - На манекене 1 в витрине №8 пуловер представлен с рубашкой Limonaia 0202, брюками Olap 1119 и пальто Segnalibro 3335. - В витрине №38 (Bambola 2) предложен женственный образ с пальто Scansione 2046 и юбкой Festone 2046. - В витрине №39 (Bambola 2) модель дополнена пальто Stenografo 2716, рубашкой Lidia 0202 и классическими брюками Onesta 2710. - Для варианта Casistica 0101 2352:

looks.text: Рекомендуется ансамбль с накидкой Rivolo 3278 и брюками из чистой шерсти Optare 3326.
Витрины (Bambola): В витрине №18 (Bambola 1) пуловер эффектно дополнен накидкой Rivolo 3278, рубашкой Bacche 0201 и юбкой из экокожи Fabula 0101.

advice: 1. An investment in tactile luxury: Direct the client's attention to the garment's composition. The blend of wool and cashmere is the guarantee of durability and unparalleled comfort characteristic of Luisa Spagnoli's premium knitwear. 2. Visual focal point: Highlight the uniqueness of the contrast embroidery. It makes the pullover a statement piece on its own, allowing the client to create striking looks using only wardrobe essentials. 3. The art of layering: Suggest pairing the model with our classic shirts, such as Limonaia 0202 or Lidia 0202. This adds status to the look and allows the cozy knitwear to be adapted to a business dress code.

objections.q: The embroidery feels too ornate.
objections.a: Explain that the contrasting details are a stylish way to refresh a classic wardrobe. The embroidery pairs beautifully with the essential Olap 1119 or Optare 3326 trousers.

objections.q: Cashmere requires delicate care.
objections.a: Remind the client that, by following a few simple care guidelines, Luisa Spagnoli's high-quality yarn keeps its softness and shape for decades.

objections.q: Concern that the piece will add bulk.
objections.a: Point out the standard regular fit. It's designed to gently follow the body's lines without adding excess volume, making it ideal for layering under a coat.

objections.q: The piece seems too warm.
objections.a: Emphasize the natural properties of cashmere and wool — they provide ideal thermoregulation, ensuring comfort both outdoors and indoors.

objections.q: Difficulty choosing complementary pieces.
objections.a: Demonstrate the pullover's versatility: it looks equally luxurious paired with the bold eco-leather Fabula 0101 skirt or with the tailored Onesta 2710 trousers.

385.name: Cuoricino
385.description: This elegant 'bon ton' cardigan is the true embodiment of refinement and soft luxury inherent to Luisa Spagnoli's DNA. Crafted from a noble blend of wool and cashmere, it envelops the wearer in softness and delivers flawless comfort, underscoring its owner's status. An exquisite contrast in the edge finishing creates a graphic, contemporary silhouette, while the cropped length, combined with the Regular fit, allows the look to be accentuated with precision. Particular charm is lent to the piece by miniature patch pockets, adorned with enamel buttons bearing the LS logo, which serve as the jewel-like finishing touch to this stylish masterpiece.

advice: - Emphasis on an exclusive composition: Highlight that the use of cashmere not only makes the piece remarkably soft, but also provides exceptional warmth at a minimal weight. - Proportion correction: Recommend the cropped cut as an ideal tool for visually

objections.q: Too short a style.
objections.a: Explain that the cropped length is a current trend that helps balance the silhouette and accentuate the waistline without adding bulk to the hips.

objections.q: Looks too formal.
objections.a: Demonstrate the piece's versatility by suggesting it be tried with the Opaglio 0927 jeans, as shown in the brand's concept, for a relaxed yet chic look.

objections.q: I'm afraid the contrasting trim is too much of a statement.
objections.a: Emphasize that the contrasting piping is a style classic that makes accessorizing easier, allowing the cardigan to be paired with both light and dark wardrobe elements.

objections.q: The wool may be scratchy.
objections.a: Remind the client that the composition includes high-quality cashmere, which neutralizes the wool's scratchiness, making the fabric gentle even on the most sensitive skin.

objections.q: Difficult to choose a base layer.
objections.a: Suggest a ready-made solution from the brand's designers — the Casilda pullovers or Leila shirts, which are a perfect match in cut and color palette.

386.name: Fabula
386.description: The Fabula 0101 skirt is the embodiment of contemporary femininity and architectural style, characteristic of Luisa Spagnoli's new collection. Crafted from high-tech eco-leather with a delicate satin finish, lending the piece a noble shimmer. The refined ankle-grazing maxi silhouette comes to life through flat-pleated pleating that elegantly opens toward the hem, creating mesmerizing movement with every step. The flared cut, combined with the Regular fit and a concealed side zip closure, guarantees a flawless line at the hip and comfort, transforming this skirt into a key element of the contemporary woman's wardrobe.

looks.text: Based on the analysis of the lookbook and window displays, the skirt serves as a foundation for a multitude of high-status looks: Version 0101: In the lookbook: - An elegant knit set with the Marius 3361 polo. - A feminine look with the Maratea 0101 ruffled pullover. - A minimalist duo with the basic Manos F 0101 pullover. - A layered ensemble with the Cremina 0101 0101 jacket and the Caprese B 0101 pullover.
