advice: - Textural interplay: Recommend that the client pair matte eco-leather with soft cashmere or silk. The contrast between the 'strength' of leather and the tenderness of knitwear (for example, with Manos F 0101) creates a truly luxurious, richly layered loo

objections.q: The eco-leather looks too plain.
objections.a: Point out the satin finish. This is a premium material that replicates the finest natural leather finishing while remaining ethical and highly durable.

objections.q: The pleats add bulk.
objections.a: Point out the "piega piatta" (flat pleat) technique. The pleats are stitched to lie flat at the hips and only open up toward the hem, preserving elegant proportions.

objections.q: The maxi length is only for tall women.
objections.a: Explain that the ankle-grazing length, combined with the high waist and the vertical line of the pleats, actually helps to visually add a few centimeters of height.

objections.q: Difficult to care for pleats on leather.
objections.a: Explain that modern finishing techniques allow the pleats to retain their original shape even after extended wear, unlike pleats on natural fabrics.

objections.q: This style is only for cold winter.
objections.a: Showcase looks from the lookbook featuring the lightweight Marius 3361 polo, proving the skirt is just as relevant in the transitional seasons.

387.name: Fanny
387.description: The Fanny 3372 skirt is a refined reading of classic British style through the lens of Luisa Spagnoli's Italian elegance. The midi-length piece is crafted from noble pure virgin wool (pura lana vergine) in a traditional tartan motif, lending the look an aristocratic, cozy character. The piece's architecture is built on a wrap construction (a portafoglio), secured with status-defining buttons in a genuine horn effect. The flawless pencil silhouette comes to life through a deep side slit, which delicately reveals the leg line in movement, adding a note of contemporary sensuality to the classic look. The Regular fit guarantees comfort, making this skirt the ideal choice for both the business wardrobe and elegant evening occasions.

objections.a: Point out the pencil-skirt cut and the dark tartan tones. The wrap construction and the vertical slit "break up" the volume, creating balanced proportions.

objections.a: Explain that the wrap cut provides ample fabric overlap. The slit opens just enough to allow ease of stride while maintaining modesty.

objections.q: Pure wool may be scratchy.
objections.a: Remind the client that Luisa Spagnoli uses specially finished, high-quality wool prized for its softness. The piece is also fully lined in a silky fabric for maximum comfort.

objections.q: Hard to find a top for such a bold print.
objections.a: Showcase window-display pairings: the skirt works beautifully with the essential Leila 0201 shirt or the solid-color Manos 0951 knitwear, both of which balance out the plaid.

objections.q: The wrap construction may come undone in strong wind.
objections.a: Point out the secure button closure. The design ensures the wrap stays in place under any circumstances.

388.name: Fenice B
388.description: The Fenice B 2226 skirt is an aristocratic reading of leather pieces in the finest Luisa Spagnoli tradition. While a detailed technical description of the cut is not available in official sources, stylistic analysis and its membership in colorway group 2226 allow it to be classified as a premium nappa leather piece with a delicate vintage effect. The skirt embodies the concept of 'architectural femininity': the soft sheen of the leather, combined with a noble tobacco hue, creates the foundation for status-defining looks. This piece is a manifesto of confidence and style, designed for the woman who values the longevity of her materials and flawless execution.

objections.a: Show the lookbook styling with the Casilda knitwear. The soft textured knots and pastel tones of the cardigan neutralize the leather's "edge," creating a refined bon ton look.

objections.a: Point to the window-display pairings: the skirt harmonizes beautifully with white (the Leila 0201 shirt), black (the Slaturnio 2104 down jacket), and natural wool tones.

objections.q: Leather isn't suitable for cold winters.
objections.a: Showcase window display No. 51, styled with the Stenografo coat. Natural leather offers excellent wind protection, and layered with wool pieces, it delivers exceptional warmth.

objections.q: I'm afraid the leather will stretch out.
objections.a: Explain that Luisa Spagnoli uses premium-quality nappa leather, which holds its shape thanks to expert tanning and professional pattern-cutting.

objections.q: The vintage effect looks worn out.
objections.a: Explain that this is an intentional design choice — a "vintage treatment" — that creates the effect of a piece with history, a hallmark of the premium luxury segment.

389.name: Festone
389.description: The Festone skirt is a triumph of architectural cut and dynamism, created for the true connoisseurs of Luisa Spagnoli's Italian style. The ankle-grazing maxi-length piece is masterfully structured with knife pleats (pieghe a cannoncino) that originate from the waistline, creating a majestic yet feminine volume. The hidden intrigue of the cut is revealed in movement through a deep side slit, which adds a note of contemporary boldness and freedom to the look. The flawless line is supported by a concealed back zip closure, ensuring a perfect Regular fit and an accentuated waist, making this skirt the foundation for both formal and status-defining everyday ensembles.

objections.a: Recommend tucking in tops (such as the Barberino 0201 shirt) to highlight the waistband detail and maintain balanced proportions.

390.name: Flacone
390.description: The Flacone 4575 skirt is a true work of textile art, in which historical heritage meets contemporary 'bon ton' style. Crafted from a luxurious woven gobelin fabric with an exquisite floral motif reminiscent of antique tapestries. The piece's architecture is built on a wrap construction (a portafoglio), secured at the side with a striking eco-leather strap and a gold-tone buckle, adding a note of contemporary luxury to the look. The short, above-the-knee length, combined with the Regular fit and functional side pockets, creates a dynamic yet aristocratic silhouette that perfectly reflects the DNA of the Luisa Spagnoli brand.

objections.q: The jacquard fabric looks too heavy.
objections.a: Explain that the fabric's density is an advantage: the skirt holds its A-line shape perfectly and won't lose its structure with wear, staying flawless season after season.

objections.a: Point out the wrap construction. Luisa Spagnoli's design allows for ample fabric overlap, securely held by a tie belt and an interior button.

objections.a: Show ready-made window-display pairings: the skirt is beautifully tempered by the solid-color Manos 2435 knitwear or the classic white Lucinda 0201 shirt.

objections.a: Suggest styling the piece with opaque matte tights and the tall Ulisside 0101 0038 boots, as shown in the lookbook. This creates a stylish vertical line and visually smooths the length.

objections.q: Jacquard is associated with vintage.
objections.a: Emphasize the modern finishing touches — the eco-leather trim and gold buckle — which elevate the piece from "retro" into the fashion-forward "luxury heritage" category.

391.name: Florina
391.description: The Florina 0101 skirt is the embodiment of flawless Italian style and contemporary practicality, an integral element of Luisa Spagnoli's DNA. Crafted from a soft, noble viscose-based blend, this below-the-knee pencil silhouette (tubino) masterfully underscores the femininity of the figure while preserving the discipline of its lines. An elasticated waist insert guarantees a perfect fit and absolute comfort throughout the day, while a central back vent adds dynamism and a light aristocratic freedom to every step. This is a foundational wardrobe piece, featuring a Regular fit and capable of serving as the ideal base for a wealth of status-defining ensembles.

objections.q: The elastic waistband looks too plain.
objections.a: Explain that, in this style, it is engineered to be as flat and technical as possible. This design choice allows the skirt to sit like a "second skin" under fitted knitwear or tailored jackets, without adding bulk.

objections.q: Viscose may wrinkle.
objections.a: Point out that this is a high-quality blended fabric (misto viscosa). The addition of modern fibers allows the fabric to hold its "sheath" shape and resist creasing far better than pure viscose.

objections.q: The pencil skirt restricts movement.
objections.a: Point out the center back slit. It's engineered to allow complete freedom of stride while preserving the iconic narrow silhouette.

objections.q: This below-the-knee length doesn't suit me.
objections.a: Showcase Look 89. Paired with heels and the right proportions on top, this length is considered the epitome of elegance, as it conceals the knee while revealing the most flattering part of the leg.

objections.q: The design is too minimal.
objections.a: Emphasize that simplicity is this piece's strength. It allows for pairing with the collection's most elaborate textures — from the Samir 0101 eco-leather to the jacquard of the Cromatura 0101 jacket.

392.name: Fulvia
392.description: The Fulvia 3410 skirt is a triumph of graphic artistry and dynamism, embodied in Luisa Spagnoli's flawless Italian style. The below-the-knee piece masterfully plays with perception through a high-contrast optical print, lending the look a contemporary, almost architectural quality. Pleating (gonna a pieghe) fills every movement with air and grace, while a clean, solid-tone border at the hem serves as a stylish visual anchor, structuring the silhouette. Considered details â€” functional side pockets and a concealed back zip closure â€” ensure the perfect balance between runway-worthy aesthetics and absolute everyday comfort, remaining true to the house's Regular fit tradition.

objections.a: Explain that the solid-color border along the hem "calms" the pattern and keeps it from overwhelming the look. This makes the piece a timeless investment rather than a fleeting seasonal trend.

objections.q: The pleats may add volume to the hips.
objections.a: Point out the regular fit and the density of the fabric. The pleats are set to lie flat at the waist, opening only with movement, which preserves elegant proportions.

objections.q: The below-the-knee length requires heels only.
objections.a: Suggest styling the skirt with tall boots, as the brand often does. The vertical line of the print means the piece can also be worn with low-heeled shoes without losing height.

objections.q: Difficult to find a top for such a pattern.
objections.a: Showcase a ready-made window-display pairing: the black Solarita 0101 jacket and white Menelao 0101 top perfectly balance the skirt's graphic pattern.

objections.q: I'm afraid the pleats will lose their shape.
objections.a: Point out Luisa Spagnoli's exceptional craftsmanship. The pleating is executed using a special technique that guarantees the pleats hold their shape even after extended wear.

393.name: Foligno
393.description: The Foligno 3402 skirt is a refined embodiment of the aristocratic 'selleria' (equestrian style) spirit, one of the signature themes of the Luisa Spagnoli collection. Crafted from fluid, noble viscose with a unique stirrup-motif print, celebrating the aesthetic of horseback riding. The piece's architecture unites the majesty of a maxi length with the elegance of a pencil (tubino) silhouette, while a wrap construction (a portafoglio) lends the look contemporary dynamism. Stylish accents are provided by contrasting borders at the hem and wrap line, as well as flat gold-tone buttons that underscore the piece's status. A side slit delicately reveals the leg line in movement, lending this classically spirited wardrobe piece a truly vivid, sensual quality.

objections.a: Point out the "portafoglio" (wrap) construction, secured reliably with gold buttons. The generous fabric overlap ensures both a polished look and comfort whether walking or sitting.

objections.q: I'm afraid the maxi length will be uncomfortable.
objections.a: Point out the side slit and the regular fit. These details ensure complete freedom of movement while preserving an aristocratic silhouette.

objections.q: The look is too formal.
objections.a: Suggest pairing the skirt with the Manos 0101 knitwear or the cropped Meltina 0101 2246 jacket. The soft texture of the knitwear dials down the formality, creating a more relaxed look.

394.name: Francobollo
394.description: The Francobollo 3372 skirt is the embodiment of aristocratic comfort and flawless Italian style, a key piece of the 'Fashion Show' theme. Crafted from noble pure virgin wool (pura lana vergine), adorned with a classic tartan motif that brings a note of timeless elegance to the look. The model's architecture captivates with its dynamism: a flared silhouette, combined with a masterful paneled construction, creates a flowing volume that comes alive with every movement. The below-the-knee length and Regular fit ensure a perfect balance between the house's classic codes and contemporary comfort, while a concealed back zip closure guarantees clean lines and a flawless fit at the waist.

objections.q: The plaid may visually widen the hips.
objections.a: Point out the paneled construction and flared cut. Unlike a straight skirt, this silhouette "blurs" the figure's outline and gently drapes over the hips, creating a harmonious look.

objections.q: The wool seems too dense and heavy.
objections.a: Explain that Luisa Spagnoli's virgin wool is prized for its exceptional lightness and softness. The skirt is designed to be warm while still preserving "breathability" and fluidity in the fabric.

objections.q: Hard to find a top for such a bold print.
objections.a: Showcase window-display pairings: the skirt works beautifully with the classic Leila 0201 or Lucinda 0201 shirts, which balance the tartan for a more understated look.

objections.a: Suggest styling the skirt with tall boots, as shown in the brand's styling. Creating a single vertical line of color and texture visually elongates the silhouette.

objections.q: Tartan is too conservative.
objections.a: Show the lookbook styling with the Merende 2234 cardigan. Pairing traditional plaid with textured contemporary knitwear brings the look up to date and relaxes it.

395.name: Frascati
395.description: The Frascati 1227 skirt is the epitome of classic elegance, created for women who value flawless tailoring and noble materials. While the piece is referenced in official sources as an alternative to trousers in status-defining ensembles, its membership in the exclusive group of silk-and-viscose-blend pieces (according to the specifications of companion styles 1227) lends it a soft sheen and sensuous fluidity. This is 'quiet luxury' in its purest expression: the skirt's understated silhouette serves as the perfect canvas for the play of light on the fine fabric, ensuring a flawless fit and comfort worthy of a true Luisa Spagnoli lady.

objections.a: Point out the impeccable "classic" cut. The skirt's carefully engineered lines, combined with the fabric's noble sheen, create a vertical line that slims rather than adds volume.

396.name: Frizione
396.description: The Frizione 0101 0101 skirt is a triumph of ethereal lightness and absolute grace, embodied in pure natural silk (pura seta). The ankle-grazing maxi-length piece captivates with its fluid, flared line, brought to life through masterful pleating. Every movement in this skirt becomes an exquisite dance of fabric, creating an aura of status and refinement. The flawless architecture of the piece is underscored by a concealed back zip closure, ensuring a perfect Regular fit and an accentuated waist, making this piece a true masterpiece in the finest Luisa Spagnoli tradition.

objections.q: Pleats on silk may add volume at the hips.
objections.a: Explain that thanks to the fluidity and lightness of natural silk, the pleats don't hold their shape rigidly but fall softly along the body's contours, actually concealing imperfections.

objections.q: The maxi length seems too formal.

397.name: Fulcro
397.description: The Fulcro 4606 skirt is a true jewel of the collection, in which the masterful craftsmanship of Luisa Spagnoli's Italian textile artisans meets contemporary dynamism. The mini-length piece is crafted from luxurious woven gobelin fabric with an exquisite floral motif inspired by antique tapestries. Particular value is lent to the piece by masterful hand finishing: delicate micro-bead and bullion (cannette) embroidery that places radiant accents on the floral motifs, creating the effect of a three-dimensional textile. The skirt's architecture is considered down to the smallest detail â€” from belt loops to a status-defining aged-brass button bearing the LS logo, which, combined with the Regular fit, makes this piece a flawless embodiment of 'modern heritage' style.

objections.a: Explain that these are high-quality decorative elements, securely anchored to a dense base fabric. With proper luxury garment care, the embroidery will retain its brilliance.

objections.q: It 's difficult to pair a solid top with such an intricate print.
objections.a: Present the ready-made solution from display case No. 42 — the Manos 0951 pullover beautifully balances the richness of the tapestry, creating a harmonious look.

objections.q: This piece is suitable only for evening occasions.
objections.a: Demonstrate the pairing with the Strumento 1575/1575 parka, proving the skirt works beautifully in a "casual chic" register for daytime events and strolls

398.name: Gael
398.description: The Gael 4626 0202 0101 dress is an ode to romantic femininity and aristocratic style, a true jewel of the Luisa Spagnoli collection. The midi-length piece is crafted from a fluid fabric with a delicate floral print, creating a poetic, weightless look. The principal stylistic accent is a striking contrasting collar, completed with a luxurious organza bow that lends the dress a note of retro glamour and refinement. A fitted silhouette with a gathered waistline and a softly flowing skirt to mid-calf underscore the grace of movement. The look is finished with exquisite details: cuffs adorned with status-defining heraldic LS buttons, transforming this dress into a true object of fashion desire.

looks.text: The brand's designers and window stylists suggest viewing the dress as a self-sufficient art object, complementing it with prestigious accessories: Option 4626 0202 0101: In the lookbook (Look 98): the dress is presented in its pure form, focusing on the play of fabric textures and the organza collar, complemented by high boots to create a vertical silhouette.

looks.title: In the windows (Vetrina 62, Vetrina 63)
looks.text: the model is invariably displayed in combination with an elegant Idilliaco 0101 0002 bag, which underscores the formal and refined character of the ensemble.

advice: - The focal point of the face: Direct the client's attention to the organza bow collar. This detail beautifully frames the face and makes the look memorable, ideal for occasions where making an impression matters. - The magic of heraldry: Draw attention t

objections.q: The bow feels too voluminous.
objections.a: Explain that the bow is crafted from weightless organza. It adds a sense of airiness to the look without weighing down the silhouette, while remaining the season 's standout style statement.

objections.q: The floral print is unflattering.
objections.a: Point out that the print sits on a dark ground (0101), which visually disciplines the motif, while the midi length and fitted cut elongate the figure.

objections.q: A white collar seems impractical.
objections.a: Remind the client that a contrasting collar is a «bon ton » classic — it brightens the complexion and lends the look a more refined, elevated status.

objections.q: It 's difficult to find outerwear to match.
objections.a: Recommend pairing the dress with the brand 's classic coats (such as the Stenografo 0101), which won 't compete with the delicate collar.

objections.q: The dress looks too dressy for everyday wear.
objections.a: Suggest trying it with flat, tall boots, as styled in the lookbook. This tempers the formality while preserving the elegance

399.name: Generosità
399.description: The GenerositÃ 4625 dress is a true ode to evening grace and aristocratic sensuality as interpreted by Luisa Spagnoli. The maxi-length piece is crafted from precious velvet with exquisite jacquard embroidery in floral motifs that come alive in evening light. The bodice's architecture astonishes with its complexity: a captivating heart-shaped neckline is completed with a play of textures â€” slender straps and dramatically cascading off-shoulder sleeves that reveal the shoulder line. The fitted corseted section flows seamlessly into a floating, ankle-length skirt, while a partially open back with a concealed zip closure completes this majestic look, created for the most status-defining occasions.

looks.text: Based on an analysis of runway looks and window displays, the dress is proposed in the following ensembles: Option 4625: In the lookbook (Look 126): the dress is presented as an independent art object, emphasizing the flawlessness of the lines and the luxury of the texture.

looks.text: a modern and bold interpretation of evening classics through a contrast of textures --- combined with a cropped Svista 0101 jacket and an Inofane 2446 0002 or Inofane 0101 0002 bag.

looks.text: a majestic winter look combined with a classic Stenografo 0101 coat and an Inolita 0101 0002 bag.

advice: - Focus on a 'regal' texture: Highlight that velvet jacquard represents the pinnacle of textile craftsmanship. This dress is not merely a garment, but an investment in a wardrobe that will retain its relevance and luxurious appearance for decades to come.

objections.q: The off-shoulder neckline feels too exposed.
objections.a: Show the double-anchoring construction: slender straps combined with the off-shoulder sleeves ensure a secure fit and full freedom of movement.

objections.q: Velvet might add bulk.
objections.a: Point to the density of the jacquard weave and the tailored silhouette. Jacquard woven into velvet disciplines the fabric, allowing it to hold a corset-like shape and create a slimming effect.

objections.q: It feels too dressy, a one-time wear.
objections.a: Demonstrate the pairing with the Stenografo 0101 coat. Styled this way, the dress becomes part of a layered, elegant ensemble suited to a variety of occasions.

objections.q: I 'm concerned the maxi length will be uncomfortable.
objections.a: Explain that the ankle-grazing length, combined with the regular fit, ensures ease of stride and allows the shoes to make a statement.

objections.q: It 's difficult to accessorize.
objections.a: Suggest the ready-made pairings from the display — the Inofane or Inolita bags. Their understated design perfectly balances the richness of the jacquard motif

400.name: Geosfera
400.description: The Geosfera 1133 1133 dress is the embodiment of refined evening glamour and contemporary grace, created for the most momentous occasions. The piece's architecture captivates with a play of textures: a bodice fully embroidered with radiant sequins meets a fluid skirt, creating a dazzling contrast. A refined bateau neckline (scollo a barca) flows into an intriguing, partially open back, adding a note of sensuality to the look, while long sleeves with an on-trend raw-edge finish (fondo al vivo) underscore the piece's contemporary character. The finishing touch is an integrated fusciacca (sash) at the waist, which masterfully sculpts the silhouette before flowing into a floating skirt with a deep side slit, lending every movement freedom and artistry.

looks.text: The brand's designers and stylists suggest viewing this dress as a self-sufficient masterpiece, complementing it with minimalist yet prestigious accessories: Option 1133 1133: In the lookbook (Look 125): the dress is presented as the central element of the look paired with dressy heeled sandals, which emphasizes the majestic maxi length.

looks.title: In the windows (Vetrina 113, Bambola 3)
looks.text: the model is showcased in an ensemble with an elegant evening Inesias 0244 0001 0001 bag.

advice: - A balance of sparkle and simplicity: Direct the client's attention to how the pairing of a shimmering top with a matte, fluid skirt keeps the look elegant and uncluttered — the hallmark of a modern evening dress code. - Focus on the waist: Highlight the

objections.q: The open back feels too revealing.
objections.a: Explain that the depth of the neckline has been carefully calibrated to preserve a high-fashion aesthetic while ensuring a comfortable fit and allowing for specialised undergarments.

objections.q: The slit seems too high.
objections.a: Point to the fluidity of the skirt fabric — when standing still, the slit is barely noticeable; it delicately reveals the leg only in motion, lending the look dynamism rather than boldness.

objections.q: The sequins might be uncomfortable against the skin.
objections.a: Remind the client that Luisa Spagnoli pieces are known for their impeccable inner finishing. The dress features a soft lining that fully shields the skin from the decorative elements.

objections.q: It 's difficult to find outerwear to pair with it.
objections.a: Recommend completing the look with a classic wool coat-robe or a luxurious stole from the collection, which won 't disrupt the dress 's architecture and will keep the client warm en route to the event.

objections.q: This dress is only for one occasion.
objections.a: Emphasise the versatility of colour 1133. Thanks to its neutrality and noble sheen, this dress will remain relevant for years to come, becoming a sound investment in an evening wardrobe

401.name: Gervaso
401.description: The Gervaso 4622 dress is the embodiment of romantic aesthetics and flawless Italian femininity, characteristic of the Luisa Spagnoli DNA. The midi-length piece is crafted in a fluid silhouette with an exquisite floral print that lends the look a poetic, spring-like freshness even in the autumn-winter season. The piece's architecture is considered down to the smallest detail: an understated stand collar (colletto a listino) underscores its aristocratic quality, while elegant gold-tone buttons serve as a jewel-like accent. Particular charm is lent to the piece by a gathered waistline, creating a feminine silhouette, and delicate draping along the closure that fills every movement with soft dynamism and grace.

looks.text: The brand's designers and stylists suggest using the dress as a base for creating elegant and complete ensembles: Option 4622: In the lookbook (Look 88): the dress is presented as an independent art object paired with high leather boots with a reptile-effect embossed finish and a minimalist clutch, creating a strict yet sensual look.

looks.title: In the windows (Vetrina 24, Bambola 2)
looks.text: the model is styled in a sophisticated manner using a prestigious Idilliaco 0101 0002 bag, which emphasizes the noble palette of the print.

advice: - Masterful silhouette correction: Emphasize the elasticated waist gathering and vertical draping. This combination expertly shapes the figure, visually elongating the silhouette and concealing nuances, all while maintaining comfort. - Focus on the neckli

objections.q: The floral print reads as too summery.
objections.a: Explain that, thanks to the print 's dark ground and the fabric 's density, the Gervaso 4622 dress fits seamlessly into an autumn wardrobe, particularly when paired with tall boots and a coat.

objections.q: I 'm worried the draping will add extra volume.
objections.a: Point out that the draping runs along the button line and is made from an extremely light, fluid fabric. Rather than adding bulk, it creates a vertical line that visually slims the figure.

objections.q: The stand collar may shorten the neck.
objections.a: Suggest undoing the top button to create a V-neckline. The gold-tone buttons allow the depth of the neckline to be adjusted, tailoring the piece to any figure.

objections.q: The dress is too dressy for everyday wear.
objections.a: Demonstrate the lookbook styling: paired with understated boots free of embellishment, the dress becomes the epitome of «urban chic.

objections.q: It 's difficult to accessorize such a pattern.
objections.a: Recommend the ready-made solution from the display — the Idilliaco 0101/0002 bag. Its minimalist design and black colour perfectly balance the richness of the floral motif

402.name: Gessica
402.description: The Gessica dress is an ode to ethereal lightness and flawless femininity, embodied in fluid natural silk. The midi-length piece captivates with its fluid line, which softly follows every movement, creating an aura of aristocratic grace. The neckline area is accentuated by an exquisite lavalliÃ¨re bow collar, which can be tied to the wearer's preference, and delicate ruffles at the bodice, adding a note of romantic retro glamour to the look. Particular charm is lent to the dress by unlined long sleeves: the effect of light sheerness lends the skin a matte glow while preserving the restrained elegance inherent to 'bon ton' style.

looks.text: Based on lookbook data and window displays, the following refined ensembles are proposed: Option 2417: In the lookbook (Look 35): designers suggest accentuating the waist by pairing the dress with a wide Darsena 0101 0002 1115 leather bustier belt.

objections.q: The sleeves feel too sheer.
objections.a: Explain this is a deliberate design choice. The sheerness on the sleeves lends the look lightness and air, while the main body of the dress is fully silk-lined, ensuring complete coverage and confidence.

objections.q: Silk is too high-maintenance for everyday wear.
objections.a: Remind the client that Luisa Spagnoli uses high-density silk, which, with proper care, retains its fluidity and depth of colour for decades, making it a timeless investment.

objections.q: The ruffles at the neckline might add bulk.
objections.a: Note that the ruffles are crafted from very fine silk and arranged vertically. Rather than adding weight, they create textural interest in the upper body, drawing attention away from any figure concerns.

objections.q: The below-the-knee length requires height to carry.
objections.a: Suggest trying the dress with tall boots, as styled by the brand. Creating a single, continuous vertical line of colour and texture visually elongates the silhouette.

objections.q: This dress suits only formal occasions.
objections.a: Demonstrate the pairing with the Stenografo 0101 coat. Combined with classic outerwear and closed-toe shoes, the dress becomes the epitome of daytime elegance

403.name: Ghisalba
403.description: The Ghisalba 0202 0101 dress is the embodiment of refined graphic style and noble silk, created for the woman whose elegance requires no further words. The midi-length piece captivates with its striking 'color block' execution, where a flawless white top meets a clean-lined black bottom, creating an architecturally precise silhouette. The dress's natural-silk top, with soft gathering at the bust and a refined bateau neckline, is completed with an intriguing teardrop back neckline, lending the look a note of hidden sensuality. Particular attention is drawn to the voluminous sleeves, finished with cuffs featuring jewel-like buttons that stand in for jewelry. A pencil skirt with a high waistline and a neat back vent underscores the status and grace of every movement.

looks.text: The brand's designers and stylists suggest viewing this dress as the central element of the look, complementing it with high-status accessories: Option 0202 0101: In the lookbook (Look 131): the model is presented as a standalone, complete look where the focus is on the interplay of silk textures and the jewelry details of the cuffs.

objections.q: Silk feels too delicate for frequent wear.
objections.a: Explain that Luisa Spagnoli uses high-density silk, which, with proper care, holds its shape and colour vibrancy for years, making it an investment in a wardrobe for life.

objections.q: The contrasting white bodice may add volume at the bust.
objections.a: Draw attention to the soft gathering (arricciatura) at the bust. This design detail creates the right amount of volume and airiness without adding weight to the upper body.

objections.q: I 'm concerned the pencil skirt will restrict movement.
objections.a: Point to the back slit (spacco posteriore), engineered to allow full freedom of stride while preserving the strictness of the silhouette.

objections.q: The back neckline feels too exposed.
objections.a: Note that the teardrop-shaped opening is the epitome of restrained elegance. It reveals the back only partially, allowing the wearer to feel confident in any setting.

objections.q: The dress looks too formal.
objections.a: Suggest swapping the evening clutch for the more understated Inise 0101/0002 bag, as shown in the displays. This transforms the piece into an ideal outfit for a business cocktail or a formal lunch.

404.name: Gigliola
404.description: The Gigliola 3410 chemisier dress is a manifesto of graphic elegance and flawless Italian style. The midi-length piece is crafted from fluid viscose, adorned with a mesmerizing all-over optical print that creates an effect of dynamism and high contrast. The dress's soft, feminine silhouette is harmoniously completed with understated three-quarter sleeves that underscore the delicacy of the wrists, and a classic collar that lends the look an intellectual quality. Thanks to its mid-calf length and Regular fit, this dress becomes a versatile canvas for creating looks in the 'contemporary chic' style, celebrating the freedom of movement and artistry of the Luisa Spagnoli woman.

looks.text: The brand's designers and stylists suggest using the Gigliola dress as the centerpiece of a graphic capsule, complementing it with strict leather and wool textures: Option 3410: In the lookbook (Look 93): the dress is presented as a self-sufficient look, highlighting the rhythm of the print and the purity of the cut's lines.

advice: - Visual correction: Direct the client's attention to the 'high contrast' optical print. This pattern masterfully disciplines the silhouette, concealing minor figure nuances and creating a strong vertical line that makes the look more streamlined and slim

objections.q: The print feels too busy.
objections.a: Explain that the classic black-and-white palette and the shirt-dress 's clean tailoring balance the graphic pattern. The dress is easily tempered with solid-colour outerwear, such as the Stenografo 0101 coat.

objections.q: Three-quarter sleeves aren 't suited to winter.
objections.a: Point out that this sleeve length is ideal for showcasing a watch or bracelets. In colder weather, suggest completing the look with long leather gloves, which adds a note of aristocratic polish.

objections.q: Viscose creases easily.
objections.a: Remind the client that Luisa Spagnoli uses a specially woven, high-density viscose that holds its shape beautifully and is far more crease-resistant than standard fabrics.

objections.q: The midi length (mid-calf) shortens the figure.
objections.a: Recommend trying the dress with tall boots in a shade matching the black element of the print. This creates an unbroken vertical line that, in fact, visually elongates the silhouette.

objections.q: The dress looks too simple.
objections.a: Draw attention to the details — the collar, the cuffs, and the intricacy of the print itself. In this case, the simplicity of the cut is a hallmark of «Quiet Luxury, » where fabric quality takes centre stage

405.name: Girevole
405.description: The Girevole 3402 chemisier dress is the true embodiment of the aristocratic 'selleria' (equestrian style) spirit, one of the signature pieces of the new Luisa Spagnoli collection. The midi-length piece (to mid-calf) masterfully unites the discipline of a classic silhouette with the dynamism of an exclusive thematic print. The piece's architecture is considered down to the smallest detail: an understated solid-color collar creates a flawless accent at the neckline, while a row of elegant gold-tone buttons lends the dress jewel-like sheen and underscores its elevated status. Long sleeves and a Regular fit ensure comfort and freedom of movement, making this dress a flawless choice for the woman who values the brand's heritage and contemporary elegance.

The brand's stylists recommend complementing it with high boots made of smooth black leather Ulisside 0101 0038 and a high-status bag with gold hardware Iago 0101 0002, which perfectly emphasizes the noble palette of the print and the theme of "quiet luxury".

objections.a: Recommend trying the dress with tall boots in a shade matching the print 's base colour, as in the lookbook. This creates an unbroken vertical line that, in fact, elongates the silhouette.

objections.q: I 'm concerned the gold buttons will tarnish quickly.
objections.a: Point to the high quality of Luisa Spagnoli 's galvanised hardware finish, specifically engineered to preserve its shine in luxury-segment pieces over time.

objections.q: The dress looks too dressy for the office.
objections.a: Demonstrate the precision of the cut and the closed shoulder line. Paired with a classic coat (such as the Stenografo 0101), the dress becomes the epitome of «Quiet Luxury » business style.

objections.q: It 's difficult to accessorize such a pattern.
objections.a: Suggest minimalist leather pieces in black or brown (the Iago 0101/0002 bag), which won 't compete with the complexity of the print

406.name: Gradualita
406.description: The Gradualita 1037 dress is a refined reading of everyday luxury, where the utilitarian aesthetic of denim meets Luisa Spagnoli's masterful couture finishing. The midi-length piece, rendered in a noble grey hue, captivates with delicate hand embroidery at the collar, encrusted with radiant stones, crystals, and smoky 'fumÃ©' elements. The piece's architecture is considered to perfection: an understated chest pocket and small jewel-like buttons (bottoni a gioiello) transform the denim dress into a true art object. The waistline is accentuated by an integrated belt, which, combined with the mid-calf length and Regular fit, creates a flawlessly feminine, contemporary silhouette.

looks.text: The Gradualita model acts both as an independent center of the look and as a foundation for complex layered ensembles: Option 1037: In the lookbook (Look 24): the canonical look is presented in combination with high boots made of smooth black leather Ulisside 0101 0038, which emphasizes the aristocratic nature of the midi length.

objections.q: Denim feels too casual for my wardrobe.
objections.a: Point to the jewel-like details — hand-embroidered crystals and gem-set buttons. These transform the piece into an exclusive garment, worthy of the most prestigious occasions.

objections.q: The grey colour feels dull.
objections.a: Explain that grey denim is the most sought-after neutral canvas. The sparkle of the stones on the collar and the jewelled hardware illuminate the look, lending it a noble, luxurious quality.

objections.q: I 'm concerned the embroidery on the collar will be scratchy.
objections.a: Remind the client of Luisa Spagnoli 's craftsmanship. All decorative elements are securely fastened, and the inner facing of the collar is finished to ensure maximum comfort.

objections.q: Denim is too stiff a fabric for a dress.
objections.a: Invite the client to try it on. The special denim treatment used in the FW 26 collection ensures softness and pliability while preserving the crispness of the silhouette 's lines.

objections.q: It 's difficult to find shoes to match this length.
objections.a: Demonstrate the lookbook solution: the Ulisside 0101/0038 tall boots create an unbroken vertical line that visually elongates the figure and completes the look

407.name: Granulare
407.description: The Granulare dress is a true embodiment of evening magic and aristocratic sparkle from Luisa Spagnoli. The maxi-length piece captivates with a masterful play of textures: a weightless tulle bodice, fully embroidered with radiant tone-matched sequins, meets a fluid viscose-blend skirt. The piece's architecture is considered to create a status-defining look: a refined V-neckline flows into an intriguing teardrop back dÃ©colletage, while a high waistline, combined with three-quarter sleeves, underscores the delicacy and grace of the silhouette. This dress is created for the woman whose entrance should be marked by soft radiance and flawless taste, transforming every step into an elegant dance of fabric.

objections.a: Explain that the sequins on this piece are delicately sized with a matte sheen. Paired with the understated viscose skirt, this creates a balanced «Quiet Luxury » look.

objections.q: I 'm concerned the back neckline is too revealing.
objections.a: Point out that the neckline is cut in a teardrop (goccia) shape — a classic, restrained detail that adds a touch of sensuality while preserving an aristocratic sense of coverage.

objections.q: Viscose creases easily.

408.name: Graziosa
408.description: The Graziosa 1219 1136 dress is a masterful reimagining of everyday denim through the lens of Luisa Spagnoli's high fashion. The mini-length piece, inspired by the aesthetic of utility jackets (linea da utility jacket), is crafted from high-quality cotton denim that holds a crisp architectural shape. The piece's nobility is underscored by a play of contrasting textures: the collar and cuffs are crafted from soft velvet, instantly elevating the dress from the 'casual' category into the realm of 'luxury denim'. The look is completed with status-defining heraldic LS buttons and functional flap maxi-pockets, while the mezza abbottonatura (half-closure) adds dynamism and contemporary elegance to the silhouette.

objections.a: Point to the velvet trim and the gold LS heraldic buttons. These details signal belonging to the luxury fashion segment, elevating the piece.

objections.a: Suggest trying the dress with dense matte tights and tall boots, or wearing it as an elongated tunic paired with slim trousers, a styling the brand frequently uses.

objections.q: The patch pockets might add bulk.
objections.a: Explain that the dense denim cotton and the vertical closure line discipline the volume of the pockets, preserving the crispness of the silhouette.

objections.a: Demonstrate the ready-made solutions from the display: the piece pairs beautifully with both light-toned knitwear (Carpaccio 0201) and vibrant accessories (Idasola 3407).

409.name: Grosseto
409.description: The Grosseto 4575 dress is a true manifesto of bohemian luxury and Luisa Spagnoli's artistic heritage. The maxi-length piece, crafted from fluid viscose georgette, captivates with an exclusive 'tappezzeria' print inspired by antique tapestries. The piece's architecture celebrates freedom and femininity: a wide round neckline, framed with delicate ruffles, is easily adjustable, allowing the depth of the dÃ©colletage to be varied. The airy silhouette is accentuated by long ruffled sleeves and a striking flounce at the hem, lending every step an aristocratic dynamism. Thanks to adjustable ties that allow the volume to be softly controlled, and a comfortable Regular fit, this dress becomes the ideal choice for creating a look in the 'ethereal elegance' style.

advice: - Individuality of fit: Emphasize the functional details. The adjustable neckline and small ties allow the client to tailor the dress to her preferences and figure, creating a truly individual look. - Textile artistry: Draw the client's attention to the '

objections.q: The print looks too intricate and demanding.
objections.a: Explain that the intricate «tapestry » motif is a hallmark of «Quiet Luxury. » It is self-sufficient and requires nothing more than understated accessories.

objections.q: I 'm worried the dress will look too voluminous.
objections.a: Suggest trying the piece with the Darsena 0101 belt, as styled in the lookbook. This creates a clear waist definition, transforming the loose silhouette into an alluring hourglass shape.

objections.q: The ankle length is impractical for city wear.
objections.a: Point to the fluidity of the viscose. The dress is constructed to allow full freedom of movement, and the alla caviglia length pairs beautifully with both tall boots and elegant shoes.

objections.q: The ruffles and flounces feel too girlish.
objections.a: Emphasise that, as executed by Luisa Spagnoli, the ruffles are an element of «bon ton » and neo-romantic style which, paired with the print 's dark ground, reads as sophisticated and mature.

objections.q: The viscose georgette feels too thin.
objections.a: Remind the client that Luisa Spagnoli 's georgette is remarkably durable despite its weightlessness. It holds the shape of the flounces beautifully and provides excellent temperature regulation

410.name: Guanina
410.description: The Guanina dress is a precious jewel of the collection, in which an understated cut meets the dazzling brilliance of Italian textile craftsmanship. The mini-length piece is crafted from luxurious lamÃ© brocade with a delicate shimmer, adorned with a classic aristocratic Paisley motif. The dress's architecture draws inspiration from retro-glamour aesthetics: a high empire waistline (taglio vita a impero) masterfully sculpts the feminine silhouette, while small jewel-like buttons (bottoni gioiello) place exquisite accents, transforming the piece into a true art object. Functional side pockets and a Regular fit add contemporary ease to the look, making this dress the ideal choice for formal occasions where status and impeccable taste must be underscored.

objections.q: The mini length feels too bold.
objections.a: Suggest trying the dress with dense matte tights and the Ulisside 0101 tall boots in smooth leather. This balances the length and lends the look a more composed, contemporary character.

objections.q: The brocade feels too dressy for daily life.
objections.a: Demonstrate the styling from display case No. 136 with the Scatto 0202 coat. Wool outerwear tempers the shine of the brocade, allowing the dress to be worn to cocktail gatherings or brunches.

objections.q: I 'm concerned the paisley print is too conservative.
objections.a: Point to the contemporary above-the-knee length and the side pockets. Combined with the classic print, these details create an on-trend «Contemporary Heritage » style.

objections.q: The lamé sheen may visually add volume.
objections.a: Explain that the paisley motif in this piece has a vertical orientation, and the dense brocade structure disciplines the silhouette, functioning like a corset.

objections.q: It 's difficult to find outerwear to match.
objections.a: Recommend the companion Stenia coat in the same fabric. This foolproof «coat-and-dress » pairing is the epitome of high-society elegance

411.name: Lama
411.description: The Lama top-tunic is an ode to the masterful artistry of Italian lace-makers and the quintessence of Luisa Spagnoli's romantic chic. The piece captivates with exquisite lace craftsmanship, finished with delicate scalloped edges on the short sleeves that lend the look ethereal lightness. The piece's interior architecture is considered down to the smallest detail: an integrated structured corset on slender straps ensures flawless support and purity of line, allowing the lace to drape softly over the silhouette without creating excess volume. An elegant peplum (baschina) at the hem, combined with an understated bateau neckline, underscores the aristocratic delicacy of the feminine figure, transforming this top into the ideal choice for the most status-defining evening occasions.

objections.q: The lace feels too sheer.
objections.a: Point to the built-in, colour-matched corset lining. It ensures full confidence and coverage in key areas, leaving the play of light visible only on the sleeves and peplum.

objections.q: I 'm concerned the peplum will add volume to the hips.
objections.a: Explain that, thanks to the lace pattern 's vertical rhythm and the softness of the material, the peplum drapes delicately over the figure without adding structured bulk — instead, it accentuates the waist.

objections.q: It 's too dressy an option — I 'm not sure where to wear it.
objections.a: Demonstrate its versatility: the tunic works beautifully layered under a tailored blazer. The lace peeking out from the lapels softens a business look for a cocktail event.

objections.q: The short sleeve isn 't suited to winter.
objections.a: Recommend completing the look with a classic coat or a cashmere wrap from the collection (such as the Rivolo 3278). Indoors, the lace sleeve highlights the lightness and occasion of the moment.

objections.q: It 's difficult to find a bottom to match such a statement top.
objections.a: Suggest the brand 's ready-made solutions: the Origgio trousers or the Frizione skirt. They match perfectly in tone and fabric weight, creating a polished total look

Serving as the ideal companion to the collection's signature jackets and suits, this Regular fit (vestibilitÃ regular) piece ensures a flawless architecture to any look. Its understated cut and purity of line allow the status of textured materials, such as jacquard or virgin wool, to be showcased, forming the connecting thread between classic business etiquette and contemporary femininity. This piece is an indispensable base upon which the most intricate, elegant ensembles of the FW 26 season are built.

413.description: The Legale B shirt is the quintessence of flawless Italian style and the foundation of the contemporary woman's wardrobe as interpreted by Luisa Spagnoli. This piece belongs to the exclusive carry-over category, confirming its status as a benchmark item whose relevance transcends time. The clean lines and precisely calibrated architecture of the cut allow it to serve as the perfect canvas for creating the widest range of ensembles â€” from disciplined business tailoring to relaxed urban looks. This is 'quiet luxury' embodied, where the focus shifts to the nobility of the texture and the purity of execution, making the shirt an indispensable element of the investment wardrobe.

420.name: Lisiana
420.description: The Lisiana 0202 0101 top is a refined embodiment of neo-romanticism and graphic purity, created for the most status-defining evening occasions. The design's central element is a majestic scalloped collar (colletto smerlato) with a fluted edge, which flows into a striking decorative bow in a smooth, contrasting fabric. The black-and-white aesthetic is underscored by tone-matched buttons and completed with an included silk lining on slender straps, ensuring flawless delicacy and comfort in wear. This piece is a true jewel-like accent for the wardrobe, uniting the traditions of Italian lace-making with contemporary, dynamic design.

421.description: The Lisio silk blouse is a masterful embodiment of intellectual style and graphic expression within the Luisa Spagnoli aesthetic. Crafted from pure natural silk (pura seta), adorned with a mesmerizing optical print that lends the look dynamism and a contemporary edge. The blouse's architecture is considered down to the finest nuance: an exquisite round neckline with soft gathering (collo a giro arricciato) creates delicate volume in the neckline area, while sleeves with a subtle puff effect underscore the delicacy and femininity of the silhouette. Particular aristocratic character is lent to the piece by a teardrop back neckline, fastened with a miniature button, making the blouse a flawless piece for both a disciplined business ensemble and an elegant evening occasion. Thanks to its Regular fit and the fluidity of the silk fabric, Lisio becomes an ideal investment for the wardrobe of a woman who values the balance between classicism and avant-garde.

428.description: The Lusia shirt is an aesthetic manifesto inspired by the noble world of equestrian sport and Italian leathercraft traditions, an integral part of the Luisa Spagnoli DNA. Crafted from the finest pure natural silk (pura seta), which lends the look exceptional nobility and a soft matte sheen. The understated straight cut (linea dritta) and Regular fit ensure flawless purity of line, while contrasting striped trim (bordi a righe) at the piece's edges places contemporary graphic accents. 432.description: The Mamas 0101 jacket is the embodiment of contemporary luxury and a jewelry-inspired approach to knitwear, characteristic of the Luisa Spagnoli aesthetic. A construction with open cuff slits and a concealed hook closure ensures flawless purity of line and a contemporary Regular fit. This jacket is the perfect balance between classic French chic and dynamic Italian temperament.

The piece, in the classic 'serafino' style (a serafino), is crafted from pure virgin wool (pura lana vergine), which delivers unparalleled tactile pleasure and a noble warmth. The design masterfully plays with textures: disciplined rib details (dettagli a coste) meet airy, feminine flounces (volant), creating a contemporary, romantic silhouette. The piece's status is underscored by an elegant closure with the house's signature gold-tone buttons, transforming an understated pullover into a jewel-like accent of the look. 434.name: Marius
434.description: The Marius pullover is a masterful reading of classic polo style, in which sporting aesthetics meet the aristocratic softness of Luisa Spagnoli's premium knitwear. Crafted from smooth-knit pure virgin wool (pura lana vergine), ensuring flawless comfort and a noble texture. The principal decorative element is an intelligent argyle intarsia motif across the front of the piece, lending the look graphic finish in the spirit of 'Heritage'. The piece's femininity is underscored by short sleeves with delicate gathering at the cuffs, while genuine mother-of-pearl buttons, precisely tone-matched, attest to the piece's limited-production character. Thanks to a soft cut (linea morbida), the pullover creates a relaxed yet status-defining silhouette, perfectly suited to layered ensembles.

435.name: Mascal
435.description: The Mascal dress is a triumph of refined understatement and Luisa Spagnoli's architectural artistry. The midi-length piece is crafted from pure virgin wool (pura lana vergine), which lends the look a noble texture and flawless warmth. The design masterfully unites different knitting techniques: a wrap-effect bodice (top incrociato) is accentuated by diagonal ribbing (coste diagonali) that flows seamlessly into a deep V-neckline. Particular artistry is lent to the piece by batwing sleeves (maniche a pipistrello) with snugly fitted cuffs, creating striking volume at the top, while the skirt is crafted in classic smooth knit (maglia rasata). This dress is the embodiment of intellectual femininity and status, perfectly suited to creating elegant daytime and evening ensembles.

436.name: Mascate
436.description: The Mascate tunic is the quintessence of contemporary elegance and Luisa Spagnoli's intellectual minimalism. Crafted from high-quality wool yarn, the piece captivates with the noble texture of an intricate punto stoffa weave, which lends the piece flawless density and the ability to hold an architectural shape. The understated 'boxy' silhouette (linea a scatolina), combined with an exquisite high turtleneck collar (dolcevita), creates a status-defining look in the spirit of 'Quiet Luxury'. Particular refinement is lent to the piece by three-quarter sleeves finished with open cuff slits, bringing a note of artistic freedom to the disciplined design. The Regular fit guarantees absolute comfort, transforming the tunic into the ideal foundation for creating layered urban ensembles.

438.description: The Meissa jacket-blazer is a perfect symbiosis of tailoring craftsmanship and knitwear comfort, embodying the intellectual luxury of Luisa Spagnoli. Crafted from pure virgin wool (pura lana vergine) using an intricate punto stoffa weave technique, which lends the piece the density and stability of classic woven fabric while preserving the pliancy of knitwear. The jacket's architecture is considered down to the smallest detail: slender lapels (sottile revers) and elegant pocket flaps underscore the purity of line, while the fitted silhouette (linea sfilata), combined with a tone-matched two-button closure, forms a flawlessly slim look. Thanks to the Regular fit, this blazer becomes the ideal choice for the woman who values impeccable style without sacrificing freedom of movement.

441.name: Menola
441.description: The Menola cardigan is a signature piece, part of the Fashion Show runway line and the quintessence of a contemporary reading of Luisa Spagnoli's heritage. The piece, styled as a 'blouson', is crafted from pure virgin wool (pura lana vergine), whose noble texture is completed with a classic notched collar (rever) and a double-breasted button closure that masterfully emulates genuine horn. 442.name: Merende
442.description: The Merende jacket-cardigan is a refined embodiment of 'Heritage' style and country chic, reimagined within the context of Luisa Spagnoli's contemporary urban elegance. The piece, styled as a 'blouson', is crafted from an exquisite wool blend where the mastery of knitwear takes center stage: masterful diagonal knitting (lavorazione diagonale) meets a classic herringbone motif (motivo a spina) on the front panel of the piece. The piece's architecture is considered down to the smallest detail â€” a stand collar (lupetto) and raglan sleeves (maniche raglan) ensure a soft, natural fit, while high elasticated cuffs structure the volume. The piece's status is underscored by genuine horn buttons (vero corno), transforming this cozy cardigan into a fully-fledged outerwear piece for the transitional seasons. The Regular fit guarantees flawless comfort, making the Merende model indispensable for intellectual layered looks.

443.name: Meritare
443.description: The Meritare pullover is the embodiment of refined minimalism and tactile luxury, created in the finest traditions of Luisa Spagnoli's knitwear artistry. Crafted from the finest pure virgin wool (pura lana vergine), whose noble texture is underscored by a flat-rib weave (coste piatte). The piece's architecture is considered down to the smallest detail: open pintucks (pinces) at the waist lend freedom of movement and create noble volume, while a perfectly pressed crease (piega stirata) forms a disciplined vertical line that visually elongates the silhouette. Traditional French pockets and elegant back welt pockets (a filetto) underscore the piece's status. Thanks to the classic Regular fit (vestibilitÃ regolare) and belt loops, the Odini trousers become the flawless foundation for creating both status-defining two-piece business suits and relaxed 'City Chic' looks.

The piece masterfully unites the ease of high-quality cotton denim (denim di cotone) with the discipline of an architectural 'palazzo' cut (linea a palazzo). The purity of the lines is underscored by a straight leg (gamba dritta), which, combined with the Regular fit, forms an endless vertical line to the silhouette. Particular status is lent to the piece by a jewel-like accent â€” the signature heraldic LS button in gold-tone metal, while an exclusive tone-matched patch (salpa), adorned with delicate embroidery, completes the look. These jeans are created for the woman who values 'Quiet Luxury' and seeks the perfect balance between runway-worthy chic and everyday functionality.

objections.q: Suede requires overly complex upkeep.
objections.a: On the contrary, Luisa Spagnoli's quality suede is highly durable. What's more, the leather collar protects the piece's most contact-prone area from abrasion, prolonging its flawless appearance. |

objections.q: Brown is difficult to pair with my wardrobe.
objections.a: This shade (0908) is the season's 'new neutral.' As shown in Look 51 and Display Case 70, it pairs beautifully with both blue denim and intricate tartan prints. |

objections.q: The jacket looks too voluminous.
objections.a: The Regular fit and architectural shoulder cut are designed to 'gather in' the silhouette. The visible topstitching creates additional vertical lines that discipline the volume. |

objections.q: The nappa collar feels too contrasting.
objections.a: This is the season's key stylistic accent, lending the look a contemporary edge. It elevates the jacket from a basic wardrobe staple to runway-worthy design. |

objections.q: I'm concerned the heraldic buttons will feel too formal.
objections.a: The gold-tone LS buttons serve as a delicate jewel-like touch. This allows accessories to be kept minimal, leaving the look clean and status-defining.

462.name: Oplite
462.description: The Oplite 1078 trousers are a masterful embodiment of the concept of 'denim as art' as interpreted by Luisa Spagnoli. Crafted from high-quality cotton denim, which, thanks to its deep hue and flawless finishing, takes on a sartorial discipline. The piece's architecture is built on contrast: a snugly fitted leg (gamba asciutta) in the upper section flows into a striking flared hem (fondo svasato), creating a dynamic, feminine flared silhouette. The principal jewel-like accent is an integrated belt, adorned with a luxurious jewel buckle (fibbia gioiello) that transforms the classic five-pocket piece into an object of evening luxury. These jeans are created for the woman who chooses the comfort of denim without wishing to forgo the sparkle and status of high fashion.

objections.a: On the contrary, the gently fitted line (linea leggermente avvitata) and the vertical row of buttons on the Schedario model visually gather in the silhouette, creating a slim, composed look. |

objections.q: The viscose content might wrinkle.
objections.a: This fabric has a special textured weave (armaturato) that makes it more stable and wrinkle-resistant compared to smooth materials. |

objections.q: The jacket looks too formal.
objections.a: Demonstrate Display Case 40: paired with Manos knitwear and wide-leg trousers, the jacket instantly transitions into relaxed Business Casual style. |

objections.q: The horn-effect buttons feel a little plain.
objections.a: This is a key element of 'Heritage' style. Such details underscore the authenticity and nobility of the materials, placing the piece firmly in the realm of timeless classics. |

objections.q: It's difficult to find a bottom to match this texture.
objections.a: The ideal solution is a 'Total Look' with the Olite trousers, crafted from the same fabric. This is a ready-made formula for flawless style, curated by our designers.

463.name: Optare
463.description: The Optare 3326 trousers are a manifesto of timeless aristocratic style and flawless Italian tailoring, deeply rooted in the Luisa Spagnoli DNA. Crafted from noble pure virgin wool (pura lana vergine) with an exquisite herringbone motif (lavorazione spigata), which lends the fabric a rich texture and status-defining depth. The piece's architecture is built on classic codes: a straight silhouette, completed with a perfectly pressed crease (piega stirata), forms a flawless vertical line that visually elongates the legs and disciplines the look. Traditional French pockets and belt loops underscore the piece's functionality, while the Regular fit guarantees a comfort in tune with the dynamic pace of the contemporary woman's life. This is an investment in the intellectual wardrobe, where the discipline of masculine fabric meets the feminine grace of the cut.

objections.a: On the contrary, the built-in belt and fur collar lend the piece femininity. Suggest completing it with the Lusia 3406 silk piece, as in Display Case 44, to create a refined contrast of textures. |

objections.q: I'm concerned the eco-fur looks cheap.
objections.a: The Luisa Spagnoli collection uses premium, high-tech eco-fur that is visually and tactilely indistinguishable from natural fur, while being more sustainable and durable for city wear. |

objections.q: The jacket feels heavy because of the layering.
objections.a: The quilted lining is crafted from lightweight materials that retain warmth without adding bulk. The weight of the piece is balanced to ensure comfort throughout the day. |

objections.q: Green shade 1729 is difficult to pair.
objections.a: This shade is the collection's 'new neutral.' As shown in our displays (Cases 41, 44), it pairs beautifully with beige, cognac, and sand-toned accessories. |

objections.q: Such an elaborate piece must be difficult to care for.
objections.a: The jacket is crafted from practical materials. The detachable collar simplifies cleaning, and the quality hardware (zipper and buttons) is built for long-lasting use.

464.name: Origgio
464.description: The Origgio 1227 trousers are an ode to minimalism and refined luxury, created for the most formal evening occasions. Crafted from an exquisite blend of silk and viscose (seta e viscosa), which lends the fabric exceptional pliancy and a noble sheen. The piece's design is devoted to the idea of absolute purity of line: the absence of pockets and a concealed side zip closure (zip invisibile) achieve a flawlessly smooth fit that does not overburden the silhouette. A straight leg (gamba dritta), combined with the Regular fit, creates a floating, 'fluid' vertical line, transforming every movement of the woman into a graceful performance in the Luisa Spagnoli style.

objections.q: A coat without buttons feels impractical.
objections.a: Explain that a wrap cut is the gold standard of elegance. The belt secures the coat reliably, and the dense wool-blend fabric guarantees warmth thanks to the deep overlap of the front panels. |

objections.q: The herringbone pattern feels too traditional.
objections.a: On the contrary, this is a 'new neutral.' Demonstrate Display Case 41: paired with the Mirziana dress and the contemporary Rotterdam hat, the classic texture looks striking and artistic. |

objections.q: I'm concerned the patch pockets will add volume to the hips.
objections.a: The patch pockets on the Segnalibro model are positioned to balance the wide lapels and raglan sleeves. They discipline the soft silhouette, lending it structure. |

objections.q: The wool blend might pill.
objections.a: Luisa Spagnoli fabrics undergo special treatment. The dense weave and high fiber quality ensure durability and preserve the flawless appearance of the 'spigato' pattern for many seasons to come. |

objections.q: The coat looks too relaxed for the office.
objections.a: It all comes down to styling. Suggest the option from Display Case 13 with the Clips polo and Olap trousers — proof that this piece fits perfectly within a formal business dress code.

465.name: Ornago
465.description: The Ornago trousers are a refined reading of everyday luxury, where the functionality of five pockets meets the nobility of sartorial materials. Crafted from an exceptionally soft cotton-and-modal velvet blend (velluto di cotone e modal), featuring a delicate fine-rib pattern (coste fini). The intelligent fabric composition lends the piece not only a pleasing matte sheen but also unparalleled pliancy, allowing the slim silhouette to trace the lines of the figure flawlessly. The single yet significant embellishment is a flat gold-tone button bearing the LS logo, serving as a jewel-like accent against the textured fabric. These trousers are created for the woman who chooses the dynamism of city life while remaining true to the 'Quiet Luxury' aesthetic.

466.name: Ortiga
466.description: The Ortiga 3261 trousers are the embodiment of contemporary 'Power Dressing' in the Luisa Spagnoli aesthetic, where classic sartorial discipline meets exceptional comfort. Crafted from high-tech stretch viscose (viscosa stretch), ensuring a flawless fit and freedom of movement throughout the day. The fabric's surface is adorned with a graphic pinstripe motif (disegno gessato), which lends the look a dynamic rhythm and aristocratic restraint. The piece's design is oriented toward creating an architecturally precise vertical line, transforming a traditional business wardrobe staple into a symbol of feminine confidence and elevated style.

467.name: Ory
467.description: The Ory trousers are an ode to contemporary femininity and Luisa Spagnoli's evening aesthetic. The piece is a benchmark of sartorial purity, where every line is devoted to the idea of a flawless silhouette. Crafted from a noble viscose-blend fabric (misto viscosa), which lends the fabric a 'fluid' pliancy and a delicate matte sheen. A characteristic architectural detail is vertical relief seams (nervature) running along the entire leg: they not only discipline the volume but also create a powerful optical vertical line that endlessly elongates the legs. The design is completed with French pockets and a concealed side zip closure (zip invisibile), achieving a perfectly smooth fit at the waist and hips without overburdening the look with excess detail. The Regular fit ensures that very runway-worthy ease of movement that transforms every step into a graceful statement.

objections.q: A vest isn't a practical piece for winter.
objections.a: The vest is a key element of intelligent layering. It serves as an additional warming layer between the shirt and outerwear, retaining heat and adding depth to the look.

468.name: Ostiolo
468.description: The Ostiolo trousers are the embodiment of flawless sartorial mastery and timeless classicism as interpreted by Luisa Spagnoli. The piece is defined by an architecturally precise slim cut (vestibilitÃ slim), which delicately traces the silhouette while preserving discipline of line. The traditional design is underscored by a perfectly pressed crease (piega stirata), creating a powerful vertical line for visually elongated legs. The trousers feature functional French pockets, belt loops, and a classic zip-and-hook closure. This piece is a foundation of the contemporary woman's wardrobe, masterfully balancing status-defining business style with runway-worthy chic.

469.name: Ottile
469.description: The Ottile 3360 trousers are an ode to flawless Italian tailoring and Luisa Spagnoli's aristocratic heritage. Crafted from noble pure virgin wool (pura lana vergine), adorned with an exquisite herringbone motif (motivo spigato) that lends the fabric depth and status-defining texture. The piece's architecture celebrates classic codes: a disciplined straight silhouette is completed with a perfectly pressed crease (piega stirata), forming an endless vertical line and underscoring the grace of every step. Functional French pockets and a traditional waistband with belt loops complete the look, while the Regular fit guarantees exceptional comfort, transforming the piece into the ideal foundation for the intellectual winter wardrobe.

470.name: Ovada
470.description: The Ovada 3312 trousers are the embodiment of a jewelry-inspired approach to tailoring and Luisa Spagnoli's artistic luxury. Crafted from a magnificent brocade with a Paisley motif (tessuto broccato dal disegno Paisley), where the textured cotton-blend fabric comes alive through the delicate shimmer of metallic threads (riflessi metal). The piece's architecture is built on a flawless slim fit with a tapered leg (gamba asciutta), which, combined with a perfectly pressed crease (piega stirata), creates a majestic vertical line that visually elongates the silhouette. The piece's sartorial status is underscored by French pockets and a classic waistband with belt loops, transforming these trousers into the centerpiece of the evening or status-defining daytime wardrobe.

objections.a: Point to the leather details and the heraldic LS buttons. Combined with the sartorial cut, these elements lend the Silicone jacket a dressy, premium quality. |

objections.q: The contrast stitching feels too pronounced.
objections.a: Contrast topstitching is a classic hallmark of premium denim. It underscores the architecture of the cut and lends the silhouette a crisper, more composed line.

471.name: Sagari
471.description: The Sagari 3372 jacket is a majestic manifesto of Italian tailoring and British heritage, reimagined within the Luisa Spagnoli aesthetic. Crafted from noble pure virgin wool (pura lana vergine), adorned with a classic tartan motif (disegno tartan) that lends the fabric aristocratic depth and status-defining texture. The piece's architecture is built on pronounced confidence: a double-breasted cut, combined with generous peaked lapels (generosi revers) and structured shoulders, forms a silhouette that is both commanding and graceful. Particular attention is given to feminine proportions â€” a fitted waistline (vita sfilata) masterfully balances the volume of the wool fabric, while horn-effect buttons and functional flap pockets serve as the finishing touches of true 'Quiet Luxury'.

472.name: Sancire
472.description: The Sancire 4575 jacket is a majestic ode to sartorial artistry and Luisa Spagnoli's aristocratic heritage. Crafted from luxurious gobelin fabric with an exquisite 'tapisserie' motif (tessuto gobelin a disegno tappezzeria), which transforms the piece into a true art object. The piece's architecture is built on a canonical double-breasted cut and a masterfully accentuated waistline (vita sfilata), achieving a flawlessly feminine, statuesque silhouette. Particular status is lent to the piece by contrasting red velvet profile details, which frame the classic lapels and flap pockets, adding depth and tactile luxury to the look. The Regular fit guarantees a perfect balance between the discipline of historic textiles and the comfort of contemporary luxury.

473.name: Sarat
473.description: The Sarat 2710 jacket is the quintessence of contemporary 'Power Dressing', in which the discipline of menswear-inspired tailoring meets the refined femininity of Luisa Spagnoli. Crafted from noble pure wool (pura lana), whose flawless texture ensures architectural crispness of line and lasting durability. The design is built on striking sartorial codes: peaked lapels (revers a lancia) and structured shoulders form a confident, statuesque silhouette, while a masterfully fitted line (linea sagomata in vita) delicately underscores the grace of the figure. The piece's status-defining character is confirmed by the signature heraldic LS buttons and functional flap pockets. Thanks to a medium-short length and Regular fit, the jacket becomes a versatile tool for creating flawless ensembles in the 'Quiet Luxury' style.

474.name: Sarmoneta
474.description: The Sarmoneta shirt-jacket is a bold and refined embodiment of 'urban safari' style as interpreted by Luisa Spagnoli. Crafted from magnificent smooth leather (ricca pelle liscia), whose flawless texture lends the piece softness and a noble matte sheen. The design is built on the on-trend overshirt concept: a classic notched collar and functional flap patch pockets are paired with a contemporary tone-matched snap-button closure. Sartorial mastery is underscored by flawless buttoned cuffs and the Regular fit, which allows the piece to be worn as a standalone wardrobe element or as a striking outer layer. Sarmoneta is created for the woman whose confidence needs no further embellishment, underscoring her status through the exceptional quality of her materials.

475.name: Scanio
475.description: The Scanio 2219 0908 car coat is a true embodiment of luxury and the adventurous spirit of the Luisa Spagnoli collection. Crafted from magnificent, top-quality suede (ricca pella scamosciata), whose velvety nap contrasts beautifully with the accent notched collar in aged nappa leather (nappa invecchiata). The piece's architecture is completed with status-defining heraldic LS buttons, transforming a functional element into a jewel-like adornment. Sartorial perfection is underscored by contrasting topstitching and an intricate pocket structure â€” both patch and welt. Concealed within is an exquisite Paisley-motif lining (fodera Paisley), which delivers a sense of exclusivity to its wearer with every movement, while the Regular fit ensures flawless comfort amid the dynamism of the city day.

476.description: The Schedario jacket is the quintessence of intellectual elegance and flawless Italian tailoring, the architectural centerpiece of the Luisa Spagnoli collection. Crafted from a noble viscose-blend fabric with a pronounced textured weave (misto viscosa armaturato), which lends the piece depth and sartorial stature. The design is built on a canonical double-breasted cut, which, as interpreted by the house, takes on a contemporary lightness through a gently fitted silhouette (linea leggermente avvitata). Traditional details â€” a breast pocket, classic flap pockets, and horn-effect buttons â€” underscore fidelity to the traditions of 'Quiet Luxury', while the Regular fit guarantees flawless comfort, making this blazer an ideal investment piece for the business and social wardrobe.

477.name: Scrittoio
477.description: The Scrittoio 1729 0992 car coat is a masterful reading of Field Jacket aesthetics, where utilitarian functionality meets Luisa Spagnoli's refined luxury. The piece is created for the woman who values practical chic: a quilted, padded interior lining (fodera interna trapuntata e imbottita) guarantees protection from the winter chill without weighing down the silhouette. The look's principal accent is a luxurious detachable eco-fur collar (ampio collo staccabile in ecopelliccia), which allows the jacket to be instantly transformed from distinctly casual to elegantly urban. The brand's sartorial mastery is revealed in the details: a double zip-and-button closure, an intricate architecture of welt and patch pockets, and an integrated belt that masterfully accentuates the waistline even within a layered winter ensemble.

478.name: Segnalibro
478.description: The Segnalibro 3335 coat is the embodiment of effortless luxury and intellectual style, a signature piece of the Luisa Spagnoli collection. Crafted from a noble wool-blend fabric, adorned with a classic sartorial herringbone motif (motivo spigato) that lends the texture depth and aristocratic restraint. The piece's design celebrates soft femininity: the relaxed robe-coat cut (linea a vestaglia) with a belt allows the silhouette to be masterfully sculpted, while raglan sleeves (maniche raglan) ensure flawless comfort and ease of movement.
