479.name: Segreteria
479.description: The Segreteria 1751 car coat is a majestic interpretation of classic loden style, where the rugged aesthetic of alpine heritage meets Luisa Spagnoli's jewel-like sparkle. Crafted from dense wool-blend loden fabric (tessuto loden misto lana), possessing a unique ability to protect against the elements while preserving an aristocratic stature. The piece's design is rich with sartorial detail: decorative frog fastenings (alamari) at the sleeves and shoulders nod to military-chic style, while a structured, overlapping shoulder line creates a commanding, architectural silhouette. Particular charm is lent to the piece by jewel-like buttons (bottoni gioiello), transforming the car coat into a precious wardrobe object. Functionality is underscored by a detachable hood with a contrasting lining, a back yoke (carrÃ©), and patch pockets, while the interior finish in shimmering saglia cangiante twill delivers a sense of hidden luxury with every movement.

480.name: Selettivo
480.description: The Selettivo 1224 vest is a masterful reading of 'Urban Country' style, where the practicality of denim meets Luisa Spagnoli's aristocratic aesthetic. Crafted from high-quality cotton denim, whose architecture is underscored by contrasting topstitching, creating a graphic, contemporary look. The piece's sartorial code is expressed in a flawlessly fitted silhouette (linea avvitata), which, combined with an adjustable back martingale strap, allows the waist to be masterfully accentuated while preserving a comfortable Regular fit. Status-defining heraldic LS buttons and functional flap pockets elevate this vest from a basic staple into a signature wardrobe object, projecting confidence and Italian chic.

481.name: Semaforo
481.description: The Semaforo 4575 vest is a refined embodiment of floral romanticism and elevated Italian style, a true jewel of the Luisa Spagnoli collection. Crafted from luxurious gobelin fabric (tessuto gobelin) with a meticulously rendered floral fantasy that lends the piece depth and status-defining texture. The house's sartorial code is underscored by the signature heraldic LS buttons, serving as jewel-like accents. The reverse of the piece is crafted from noble satin (raso) and completed with an elegant adjustable martingale strap that masterfully sculpts the silhouette, accentuating the delicacy of the waist. The Regular fit ensures a flawless balance between the architectural form of the gobelin and freedom of movement, transforming the vest into an indispensable element for creating status-defining layered ensembles.

482.name: Serafica
482.description: The Serafica jacket is an architectural masterpiece of the Luisa Spagnoli collection, in which the classic double-breasted cut takes on a new, deeply feminine geometry. The piece's principal stylistic feature is a masterful diagonal overlap (sormonto diagonale), forming an exquisite V-shaped hemline that lends the silhouette dynamism and visual lightness. Sartorial excellence is underscored by structured shoulders and flawless welt pockets (tasche a filetto), creating a statuesque, confident look. Precisely tone-matched buttons ensure purity of line and aesthetic cohesion, while the Regular fit delivers comfort without sacrificing the discipline of the form. This blazer is the embodiment of contemporary classicism for the woman who chooses intellectual luxury.

483.name: Sigle
483.description: The Sigle trench coat is a monumental embodiment of Luisa Spagnoli's timeless elegance, in which the discipline of British tradition meets Italian sense of style. Crafted from high-quality cotton gabardine (gabardina di cotone), possessing a noble matte texture and exceptional durability. The piece's architecture is built on a canonical double-breasted cut (doppiopetto), completed with authentic sartorial details: shoulder epaulettes (mostrine), a storm flap (patta frangipioggia), and horn-effect buttons. The model's principal secret and artistic accent is a contrasting lining (foderato a contrasto), which lends the classic silhouette contemporary dynamism. An integrated belt allows the waistline to be masterfully accentuated, preserving a flawless Regular fit and creating a statuesque, confident look.

Crafted from high-quality cotton denim, whose architecture is underscored by contrasting topstitching, creating a graphic, contemporary look. The true character of Luisa Spagnoli is revealed in status-defining accents: a collar and cuffs crafted from noble leather add textural depth to the piece, while the signature heraldic LS buttons transform a functional element into a jewel-like adornment. Thanks to the Regular fit and an elegant rounded hem, the Silicone model serves as the perfect hybrid of a light jacket and a status-defining shirt for the dynamic urban wardrobe.

485.name: Sognatrice
485.description: The Sognatrice 3360 jacket is a flawless embodiment of aristocratic style and Luisa Spagnoli's sartorial mastery. Crafted from noble pure virgin wool (pura lana vergine), adorned with a classic herringbone motif (tessuto spigato) that lends the piece's texture depth and timeless relevance. Thanks to the Regular fit, the jacket delivers a sense of confidence and comfort, becoming the perfect centerpiece for both the business and the elegant everyday wardrobe.

Thanks to the Regular fit, the Sommaria 4606 0943 jacket becomes the perfect balance between architectural form and flawless comfort.

489.description: The Sportivo 2226 bomber jacket is a manifesto of refined ease and Luisa Spagnoli's elevated 'Sporty Chic' style. Crafted from luxurious soft suede (ricca pelle scamosciata), whose velvety texture lends the look depth and status-defining warmth. The piece's architecture is considered for maximum comfort in movement: raglan sleeves (maniche raglan) ensure a soft shoulder line, while an adjustable drawcord at the hem (fondo con coulisse regolabile) allows the silhouette to be masterfully varied from straight to more gathered and voluminous. A classic notched collar, an understated zip closure, and buttoned cuffs underscore the piece's functional character while preserving flawless elegance and the Regular fit.

491.name: Stafilo
491.description: The Stafilo 3261 jacket is the embodiment of contemporary sartorial aesthetics and flawless taste, deeply rooted in the Luisa Spagnoli DNA. Crafted from high-quality stretch viscose (viscosa stretch), which delivers exceptional comfort without restricting freedom of movement, while perfectly preserving the architectural crispness of the lines. The noble pinstripe motif (disegno gessato) lends the look status and intellectual chic, transforming the jacket into a key wardrobe element in the 'Power Dressing' style. The design is built on classic codes: a double-breasted cut with a tone-matched four-button closure and striking peaked lapels (revers a lancia) form a statuesque, confident silhouette. Considered flap pockets and the Regular fit make this blazer a flawless choice for the woman who values the harmony between traditional Italian tailoring and the demands of a dynamic day.

493.name: Statuaria
493.description: The Statuaria blouse is a true triumph of sculptural cut and evening aesthetics within the Luisa Spagnoli DNA. The piece's name fully justifies its architectural silhouette: crafted from a noble silk blend (misto seta) that allows for the creation of intricate, sculpted forms. The blouse's bodice is adorned with masterful draping (corpetto drappeggiato) that flows into a semi-structured peplum (baschina semirigida), masterfully sculpting a feminine hourglass silhouette. Particular status-defining character is lent to the piece by integrated shoulder pads (spalline integrate), creating a crisp upper line, and jewel-like accents â€” gioiello buttons and a belt with a decorative statement buckle. Thanks to the Regular fit, the Statuaria model delivers a sense of exceptional luxury without sacrificing freedom of movement.

494.name: Statuetta
494.description: The Statuetta husky jacket is a refined embodiment of 'Country Chic' style, where the utilitarian aesthetic of British heritage meets Luisa Spagnoli's Italian sense of luxury. Crafted from quilted fabric (tessuto trapuntato) with flawless geometric lines that underscore the graphic quality of the silhouette. Particular charm is lent to the piece by fine-wale corduroy details (velluto a costine): a classic notched collar and delicate profile finishing create a rich interplay of textures. The brand's sartorial excellence is underscored by gold-tone buttons bearing the LS logo, which serve as jewel-like accents. The design is completed with a double zip-and-button closure, as well as a functional ensemble of welt and flap patch pockets, ensuring a perfect balance between practicality and high fashion within the Regular fit.

495.name: Stenia
495.description: The Stenia coat is a true embodiment of artistry and formal elegance from Luisa Spagnoli. Crafted from luxurious brocade fabric (broccato), whose texture is masterfully illuminated with metallic highlights (riflessi metal), creating an effect of living shimmer. The piece's architecture is built on a flawlessly straight cut (linea dritta), which, combined with an aristocratic stand collar (collo a listino), forms a statuesque, elongated silhouette. Sartorial attention to detail is revealed in elegant welt pockets with flaps (tasche a filetto con pattina), preserving purity of form. Thanks to the Regular fit, this coat becomes not merely an outerwear piece, but a precious wardrobe object, designed for the most exceptional social occasions.

496.name: Stenografo
496.description: The Stenografo coat is a true ode to winter elegance, in which softness of form meets Luisa Spagnoli's flawless sartorial discipline. Crafted from high-quality wool-blend cloth (panno di misto lana), possessing a noble texture and exceptional warmth retention. The principal aesthetic feature is luxurious shawl lapels (revers sciallati), which flow seamlessly into a wrap-front cut (chiusura a vestaglia). An integrated belt masterfully accentuates the waist, allowing the silhouette to be individually sculpted, while pronounced piped seams (nervature in evidenza) lend the piece architectural crispness and runway-worthy polish. Thanks to the Regular fit, the Stenografo coat becomes the versatile finishing touch to any look â€” from an intellectual business set to a formal evening occasion.

497.name: Stromboli
497.description: The Stromboli parka is a monumental embodiment of winter comfort and functional luxury from Luisa Spagnoli. The piece is a long parka coat, crafted from high-quality quilted fabric (tessuto trapuntato) with generous interior padding (generosa imbottitura), making it the ideal ally against the harshest winter conditions. The piece's architecture is considered down to the smallest detail: a voluminous detachable hood and a double zip-and-button closure ensure absolute protection from the elements, while an integrated belt allows the silhouette to be masterfully sculpted, underscoring femininity even in the warmest of looks. Particular attention is given to comfort details â€” enveloping knit cuffs (polsini avvolgenti in maglia) sit softly against the wrists, retaining warmth, while functional flap pockets complete the statuesque, contemporary look within the Regular fit.

498.name: Strumento
498.description: The Strumento parka is a conceptual masterpiece by Luisa Spagnoli, embodying the idea of intellectual layering and flawless comfort. The piece is a masterful '2-in-1' ensemble: an exquisite outer coat in noble wool cloth (panno di lana) is harmoniously completed with an interior 100-gram quilted jacket featuring a fixed hood. The piece's design is imbued with the aesthetic of functional luxury: an adjustable waist drawcord allows the silhouette to be masterfully sculpted, while patch pockets with contrasting piping and the signature gold-tone LS buttons place status-defining accents. The model's uniqueness lies in its modularity â€” both elements can be worn together or separately, transforming the Strumento parka into a versatile tool for creating flawless looks in changeable weather, all while preserving the Regular fit.

499.name: Suggestivo
499.description: The Suggestivo 3312 jacket is a true embodiment of runway artistry and evening magnificence from Luisa Spagnoli. Crafted from luxurious brocade fabric (broccato), whose intricate texture is masterfully illuminated with metallic highlights (riflessi metal), creating an effect of living, precious shimmer. The design's culmination is a classic Paisley motif, which, combined with a single-breasted cut and classic lapels, transforms the jacket into an object of high sartorial art. Particular status-defining tonality is lent to the look by jewel-like gioiello buttons, which function as standalone adornments, and functional patch pockets that add contemporary dynamism to the architectural silhouette.

500.name: Zagarolo
500.description: The Zagarolo 0428 jacket-cardigan is a masterful embodiment of the 'Easy Luxury' concept, where the softness of knitwear meets the flawless architecture of a classic blazer. Crafted from a noble viscose-blend fabric (misto viscosa), delicately illuminated with metallic threads that create an effect of living, shimmering radiance. The piece's design cites the codes of high tailoring: a double-breasted cut (doppiopetto), striking blazer-style lapels, and functional flap pockets form a statuesque, confident silhouette. Particular attention is given to the details â€” fabric-covered buttons (bottoni rivestiti) in a tone matching the fabric underscore the monochrome aesthetic and premium status of the piece, while the Regular fit guarantees exceptional comfort throughout the day.

501.name: Zagra
501.description: The Zagra 3192 pullover is a masterful embodiment of contemporary dressy knitwear within the Luisa Spagnoli aesthetic. Crafted from a noble viscose-blend fabric (misto viscosa), whose texture is artistically illuminated with metallic threads (riflessi metallici), creating an effect of living, shimmering radiance. The piece's design is built on a harmony of architectural form and softness: striking three-quarter balloon sleeves (maniche balloon) and a delicately gathered shoulder line (spalle arricciate) form a feminine, statuesque silhouette. Traditional rib-knit edge finishing (bordi a coste) underscores the piece's structure, ensuring a flawless Regular fit and transforming this pullover into the ideal statement piece for status-defining occasions.

502.description: The Zambrone 0470 top is a precious accent within the Luisa Spagnoli collection, embodying the aesthetic of 'shimmering knitwear'. Crafted from a noble viscose-blend fabric, masterfully interwoven with metallic threads that create an effect of delicate shimmer. The piece's architecture celebrates refined femininity: short sleeves with a softly gathered shoulder line form a delicate, graceful silhouette, while an elegant lavalliÃ¨re collar allows the look to be interpreted individually â€” from a voluminous, formal bow to a relaxed knot. Thanks to the Regular fit, the Zambrone pullover is flawlessly balanced, offering the comfort of knitwear alongside the refinement of an evening blouse.

503.name: Zano
503.description: The Zano 0428 polo is a masterful embodiment of contemporary luxury, where a classic sporty silhouette is reimagined through the lens of Luisa Spagnoli's refined shimmer. Crafted from weightless knitwear in a viscose blend (misto viscosa), interwoven with precious metallic threads that create an effect of living, delicate shimmer. The piece's architecture is flawless: a classic notched collar and precisely tone-matched buttons underscore the sartorial purity of the lines. Particular artistry is lent to the look by open sleeve slits (fondo manica aperto con spacchetto), adding dynamism and airiness to the silhouette. Thanks to the Regular fit and unlined construction, the Zano 0428 polo delivers unparalleled tactile comfort, becoming the perfect accent for both intellectual daytime and status-defining evening ensembles.
